1.Title: Wrizz
1.Rule: Guild members are able to donate one guild activity point for every normal activity point they acquire. The number of guild points that can be accumulated per day is limited to the number of members that are currently in the guild.

2.Rule: The Guild Master or Guild Deputy can use guild activity points to open events such as "The Lost Soul" via Wrizz and are refreshed daily.

3.Rule: For a period after the Boss is reset, all Guilds will be able to raid it twice, free of charge.

4.Rule: Players will be able to manually control their heroes' ultimates.

5.Rule: Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

6.Rule: Defeating the boss can reward you with gold coins, diamonds and gear.

7.Rule: Grand Master's Treasure: When the event ends, the player who dealt the most damage to the boss will gain extra rewards for fellow Guild members who participated.

8.Rule: Any guild coins collected can be used at the guild store.

1.Title: Soren
1.Rule: Guild members are able to donate one guild activity point for every normal activity point they acquire. The number of guild points that can be accumulated per day is limited to the number of members that are currently in the guild.

2.Rule: The Guild Master or Guild Deputy can use guild activity points to open events such as "The Lost Soul" via Wrizz and are refreshed daily.

3.Rule: For a period after the Boss is reset, all Guilds will be able to raid it twice, free of charge.

4.Rule: Players will be able to manually control their heroes' ultimates.

5.Rule: Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

6.Rule: Defeating the boss can reward you with gold coins, diamonds and gear.

7.Rule: Grand Master's Treasure: When the event ends, the player who dealt the most damage to the boss will gain extra rewards for fellow Guild members who participated.

8.Rule: Any guild coins collected can be used at the guild store.

1.Title: Arcane Labyrinth
1.Rule: The Arcane Labyrinth will be refreshed every 48 hours. All monsters, buildings and rewards will be reset.

2.Rule: Players can explore their current and surrounding tiles.

3.Rule: Be careful when choosing your route, because each time you step onto a new grid, the adjacent grids will be destroyed.

4.Rule: If you're able to defeat the defenders of the Labyrinth, you'll be rewarded with Labyrinth tokens that can be used to purchase goods at the Labyrinth store!

5.Rule: Enemies within the Labyrinth may drop relics that you can collect. Each relic has unique properties.

6.Rule: Relics can only take effect within the Arcane Labyrinth.

7.Rule: If the Labyrinth is reset, all relics that you've acquired thus far will disappear.

8.Rule: Arcane Labyrinth enemies are real players' Arena of Heroes formations which have been corrupted.

9.Rule: Complete Stage 38-60 to unlock Level Sweep, which can be used for the first tile of the Labyrinth.

10.Rule: With Level Sweep, you can clear multiple stages at once and earn corresponding rewards.

1.Title: Hero Ascension
1.Rule: You can ascend heroes to increase their tier.

2.Rule: You have to spend a certain number of certain heroes or Soul Gems to ascend heroes.

3.Rule: The aforementioned sacrificed heroes will then be disintegrated and lost forever. Any armor, experience and resources will be placed back in the player's bag.

4.Rule: When you have a higher-tier hero, lower-tier versions of that hero cannot be ascended.

5.Rule: Heroes with an initial tier of Common or Rare cannot be ascended.

6.Rule: The following guide shows the number of items required to ascend Four Faction heroes, starting at an initial tier of Elite.

1.Title: Retire Heroes
1.Rule: You can retire surplus Elite cards to get the corresponding Soul Gems.

2.Rule: Heroes at Legendary+ tier cannot be retired. Celestials, Hypogeans, and Dimensionals also cannot be retired.

3.Rule: After retiring a hero the hero will disappear, however all resources and equipment used to develop the hero will be placed back in the player's bag.

1.Title: King's Tower
1.Rule: You will be rewarded for defeating the enemies on each floor and thus permitted to ascend to the next floor.

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Bounty Board
1.Rule: Your heroes can undertake quests at the Bounty Board. Once you have selected a quest for a hero to embark on, you must dispatch them to complete the quest. Once they have completed the quest, you will receive the bounty.

2.Rule: There are two types of quests: solo and team quests. Team quests require several heroes to band together to start.

3.Rule: Some quests may require you to select certain faction heroes or may have level requirements that must first be met to begin these quests. A hero cannot undertake more than one quest at a time.

4.Rule: You can refresh solo quests that have not yet been started by spending diamonds or, alternatively, you can wait one day for the quests to be automatically refreshed.

5.Rule: You will be given a new team quest every day. Team quests can be rolled over to the next day if not completed but if they are not completed within 7 days they will disappear.

1.Title: Arena of Heroes
1.Rule: The Arena of Heroes is a league wherein you can accumulate ladder points and win rewards. Your ladder points will rise or fall depending on the outcome of your battles.

2.Rule: No Arena Ticket is consumed for the first two challenges in the Arena of Heroes every day, while each subsequent challenge costs an Arena Ticket. Once you reach Chapter 25, the number of free challenges per day will be converted into an Arena Ticket of an equal amount. You can claim it after entering the Arena of Heroes.

3.Rule: Each season will last for two weeks which will have daily rewards and seasonal rewards. Over the course of the two weeks you will be judged on your daily ranking as well as your final season ranking and rewarded accordingly.

4.Rule: Once the season has ended you must re-enter the Arena of Heroes to start participating again in the next season.

5.Rule: Each arena season is two weeks. Once the season has concluded, players rankings will be calculated and given rewards based on their overall ranking.

6.Rule: Players must enter the arena once each new season in order to receive ladder points and a ranking.

1.Title: Friends
1.Rule: A maximum of 40 friends can be added to your friends list.

2.Rule: You can tap on the "Challenge" button to pit your heroes against a friend's heroes!

3.Rule: You can send up to 40 friends Companion Points and also collect them from 20 friends, which can be used at the Tavern to summon new heroes.

4.Rule: You can use Companion Points to summon heroes at the Noble Tavern.

1.Title: Reset Heroes
1.Rule: You can use diamonds to reset a hero in return for resources. You can reset heroes for free before reaching Chapter 5.

2.Rule: After resetting a hero their level will be reset and the gear used by this hero including all accumulated resources and experience will be given back to you.

1.Title: Hero Union
1.Rule: Choose a friend's heroes or your own heroes to form a union.

2.Rule: Different combinations of heroes can form different types of unions, increasing your formation's total power.

3.Rule: Higher tier heroes are able to activate stronger unions.

4.Rule: You can choose what heroes you'd like to give to your friends via the "My Assist Heroes" page.

5.Rule: If a player has not been online for over 7 days or a designated hero is lost, the hero will automatically become unavailable as an Assist Heroes on the 1st and 15th day of every month.

6.Rule: Raise your heroes to their highest union tier to permanently activate specific Hero Unions.

1.Title: Resonating Crystal
1.Rule: The 5 highest level heroes will automatically be placed upon the Crystal Pentagram.

2.Rule: Resonance heroes will be upgraded to the lowest level on the Crystal Pentagram. However, a hero's maximum level is still limited by the highest ascension tier that they can reach.

3.Rule: The maximum level limit for the Resonating Crystal can be raised when 5 heroes have reached Lvl 360.

4.Rule: Once the Resonating Crystal's maximum level limit has been unlocked, heroes' levels will be directly influenced by the current level of the Resonating Crystal. Starting from Lvl 360, the actual level of the Crystal Pentagram shall become Lvl 1, from which point onwards, the players will be able to receive its level-up effects.

5.Rule: When the maximum level limit of the Resonating Crystal has been unlocked, players can use resources to raise the Crystal level, simultaneously raising the Combat Ratings and levels of all heroes that are occupying the Resonating Crystal slots.

6.Rule: Once the max level of the Crystal has been unlocked, only heroes capable of reaching the Ascended tier may break the level 360 limit. Other ascension-tiered heroes may only reach the maximum level that is determined by their ascension tier.

1.Title: Dura's Tears
1.Rule: Dura's Tears can be used to restore the health and energy of heroes on the Crystal Pentagram or those who were hired at the Abandoned Wagon while they are exploring the Arcane Labyrinth.

2.Rule: Dura's Tears can be acquired by completing weekly quests.

3.Rule: Unused Dura's Tears will not disappear when the Labyrinth is reset.

1.Title: Peaks of Time
1.Rule: Players can acquire many treasures while exploring the Peaks of Time.

2.Rule: Peaks of Time consists of Historic Ventures and Wondrous Pouch.

3.Rule: Players can open and close Historic Ventures as they please, and reopening an adventure will reset it.

4.Rule: Enemies within the Historic Ventures mode do not grow stronger and are unaffected by the player's own strength.

5.Rule: Only one mercenary can be used per formation in Historic Ventures, but the number of times that a mercenary can be used is unlimited.

6.Rule: Wondrous Pouch adventures can be played at any time and do not need to be opened or closed by the player.

7.Rule: Rewards can only be claimed one time per adventure.

1.Title: Guild Wars
1.Rule: To be eligible for Guild Wars, all guilds must be level 2 and above and are required to have a minimum of 10 guild members. Guild wars can be initiated by the Guild Master or Guild Deputy by pressing the "Enroll" button, guild members may then press the "Join" button to participate in the Guild Wars.

2.Rule: When a team enters the matchmaking queue the system will attempt to find another team in the queue with an identical matchmaking value. If one is found, the two teams will be entered into a guild war with each other. If a guild does not possess enough members they will be merged together with other guilds that also lack a sufficient amount of members.

3.Rule: Guild Wars is comprised of 3 stages: Enrollment (lasts 48 hours), Matchmaking (lasts 1 hour) and Battles. The battle stage is comprised of 5 rounds of which the first round lasts for 23 hours and the following 4 rounds last for 24 hours each.

4.Rule: Guild Wars is a best-of-five competition. Team round scores are based on the highest rank each member was able to achieve during the round. The side with the highest number of total points wins the round.

5.Rule: Only heroes that are Elite ascension tier and above may be used in Guild Wars. All heroes used will automatically be raised to level 160 and will start with Mythic tier gear, any factional bonuses on a hero's gear will be ineffective. Heroes will start with max union bonuses but will be unable to wield any artifacts.

6.Rule: All guild members can field up to 3 formations where each formation can only fight once. Players can only challenge players that are ranked higher than themselves

7.Rule: All battles require the expenditure of one battle ticket to begin. Once a new round starts 5 battle tickets will be given to each player. Once the round has concluded any remaining battle tickets will lose efficacy.

8.Rule: After each battle has ended, if a player's ranking rises, their guild will receive a higher amount of points.

9.Rule: If one side loses a round, their players will be granted an Combat Rating buff for the next round.

10.Rule: There are three types of rewards: Battle Rewards, Round Rewards and Victory Rewards.

1.Title: Stargazer
1.Rule: Stargazing Cards can be used to stargaze. Players can acquire heroes, EXP, and gear by stargazing.

2.Rule: There is a chance to acquire a significant amount of diamonds when stargazing.

3.Rule: The prize pool hero is consistent with the same Stargazer Hero chosen by the player.

1.Title: Legends' Championship
1.Rule: Only Ascended tier heroes may participate in the Legends' Championship

2.Rule: Legends' Championship is a cross-server tournament. All heroes will have their levels adjusted to 360. All gear used will be unenhanced Mythic T1 with Faction Bonuses. If a hero is already equipping gear that is Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained. Hero Union Bonuses will be maxed out. Signature Item, Exclusive Furniture, The Elder Tree and Eternal Engravings bonuses are permitted. Artifacts are not permitted.

3.Rule: The top 10 players every season with the most "Challenger Points" that possess 5 Mythic+ tier heroes will qualify for the Legends' Championship Tournament group stage.

4.Rule: Players that perform well in the Legends' Challenger group will progress to the group stage of the Legends' Championship Tournament. If players in a group finish with an equal amount of points, their overall Combat Ratings will be used to determine which player progresses. Group stage formations may not be altered 3 hours before the tournament's commencement.

5.Rule: The Legends' Championship will run once per day, for one week. Once the week has ended, there will be an interim period that of one week. Once the interim period has ended the Legends' Championship will be re-opened again in order for a new tournament to begin. Formations will be locked 1 hour prior to the battle's start. Once locked, players can check both side's formations by tapping the competitors' avatars.

6.Rule: Legends' Championship Round of 64 competitors, Quarter Finalists, Semi Finalists and Champions will be rewarded with a special avatar frame.

7.Rule: The Legends' Championship Tournament is a last man standing format competition. Surviving heroes of each round will continue into the next round, maintaining the same amount of health with which they finished with in the previous round. The amount of teams required for the tournament will differ based on the player's region. The number of participating teams is directly related to each region's own tournament settings.

8.Rule: During the Legends' Championship last man standing competition, victors will enter the next round suffering the effects of "Exhaustion". While in a state of exhaustion, heroes shall deal less damage and receive more damage. Each time the same team participates in a last man standing battle, another level of Exhaustion is stacked upon the team.

9.Rule: The number of participating teams shall increase based on the total number of seasons which have been played on specific regions.

10.Rule: If the battle timer runs out of time, the team with the most of heroes on the battlefield will be victorious. If both teams have an equal number of heroes on the battlefield when the timer runs out of time, the team with the highest percentage of remaining health will be considered victorious. Once the victor has been determined, the losing team's remaining heroes will be classed as dead.

11.Rule: Legends' Championship Round of 64 competitors, Quarter Finalists and Champions will be rewarded with a rare limited time Honorable Reward Medal.

12.Rule: Players that reach the Round of 32 or further in the Legends' Championship will win a Fortune Chest for their guild, that contains Gladiator Coins after the results have been calculated.

1.Title: Wall of Legends
1.Rule: The Wall of Legends showcases the highest-ranked players in various leaderboards on the server.

2.Rule: The Guild Leaderboard ranks all guilds by their total Combat Rating, calculated by summing up the Combat Ratings of all their members.

3.Rule: The Milestones record the pioneers of various historic achievements on this server since its launch.

4.Rule: All players can claim a one-time diamond reward from Milestone records.

5.Rule: After claiming the reward, players can like the record once per day.

1.Title: Legends' Challenger Tournament
1.Rule: The Legends' Challenger season lasts for 2 weeks and is categorized into 7 divisions, ranging from 'Novice' all the way to 'Champion'.

2.Rule: The quantity of Gladiator Coins a player receives is based upon their current division, with higher divisions offering higher amounts of coins. Players are also able to receive Challenger Points if they are able to reach the Champion division.

3.Rule: At the end of the season, the top 10 players with the most Challenger Points will qualify for the Legends' Championship Tournament. (The Championship Tournament has specific tier requirements, for more details check the "Challengers Leaderboard" in the top left corner)

4.Rule: After a season has ended all "Challenger Points" will be reset to 0.

5.Rule: The accumulation of "Gladiator Coins" is based on the player's ranking and are acquired hourly. Gladiator coins will be automatically placed into the Challenger Chest located at the top of the leaderboard and can be collected at any time.

6.Rule: Player can hold up to a maximum of 500,000 gladiator coins. Coins will no longer be accumulated once the maximum quantity has been reached. Players can exchange their gladiator coins for items within the Challenger Store.

7.Rule: The Legends' Challenger Tournament is a best of three style competition. Players can adjust their defensive formation by selecting the 'Formation' button.

8.Rule: Players can select 3 formations. Each formation must possess at least one hero. The first player to win two battles is victorious.

9.Rule: Battles are won once all of the opponent's heroes have been slain.

10.Rule: If the battle timer runs out before all heroes have been slain, the challenging player loses the battle.

11.Rule: Players that have not logged in for an extended period of time will not be able to progress through to the Legends' Championship phase of the tournament.

1.Title: Legends' Challenger Tournament
1.Rule: The Legends' Challenger season lasts for 2 weeks and is categorized into 7 divisions, ranging from 'Novice' all the way to 'Champion'.

2.Rule: The quantity of Gladiator Coins a player receives is based upon their current division, with higher divisions offering higher amounts of coins. Players are also able to receive Challenger Points if they are able to reach the Champion division.

3.Rule: At the end of the season, the top 40 players with the most Challenger Points will qualify for the Legends' Championship Tournament. (The Championship Tournament has specific tier requirements, for more details check the "Challengers Leaderboard" in the top left corner)

4.Rule: After a season has ended all "Challenger Points" will be reset to 0.

5.Rule: The accumulation of "Gladiator Coins" is based on the player's ranking and are acquired hourly. Gladiator coins will be automatically placed into the Challenger Chest located at the top of the leaderboard and can be collected at any time.

6.Rule: Player can hold up to a maximum of 500,000 gladiator coins. Coins will no longer be accumulated once the maximum quantity has been reached. Players can exchange their gladiator coins for items within the Challenger Store.

7.Rule: The Legends' Challenger Tournament is a best of three style competition. Players can adjust their defensive formation by selecting the 'Formation' button.

8.Rule: Players can select 3 formations. Each formation must possess at least one hero. The first player to win two battles is victorious.

9.Rule: Battles are won once all of the opponent's heroes have been slain.

10.Rule: If the battle timer runs out before all heroes have been slain, the challenging player loses the battle.

11.Rule: Players that have not logged in for an extended period of time will not be able to progress through to the Legends' Championship phase of the tournament.

1.Title: Battle Wager
1.Rule: Players are able to place battle wagers on Legends' Championship competitors. All players are able to choose a competitor to support in each round of the tournament whom they think will be victorious. If the competitor that they supported is victorious, then the player wins the bet. If the competitor they supported loses, the player in turn loses the bet. Players that are competing in the tournament finals may only support themselves.

2.Rule: The choice of competitors available to bet on are determined by the game's system. The system will prioritize competitors that share the same guild or same language as the player that is placing the bet.

3.Rule: Players must possess 2 days worth of gold from AFK Rewards in order to place a wager.

4.Rule: If the supported competitor wins the round, the player will win back double the amount of gold originally placed as a wager. Players can receive their winnings via their inbox.

1.Title: (Old) Regal Rewards
1.Rule: Regal Rewards become available 8 days after the creation of a new account profile.

2.Rule: Regal Rewards is a time-limited reward system which lasts for 49 days.

3.Rule: More Regal Rewards can be unlocked by using Medals of Valor, which can be acquired from the 'Dailies' and 'Weeklies' quest chests.

4.Rule: Any claimable Regal Rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Regal Rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: When the Regal Rewards feature is refreshed, its Perk Level increases. Perk Levels start with an initial level of 1 and can be raised up to level 5. The higher the Perk Level, the more numerous the Regal Rewards become.

6.Rule: Once the new max Perk Level adjustment has been implemented, the original Regal Rewards will be displayed as "(Old) Regal Rewards", and once the old Regal Rewards expire, they will no longer be refreshable.

7.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Medals of Valor in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Regal Rewards' reset date.

8.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

9.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

1.Title: Brutal Citadel
1.Rule: You may only use Mauler heroes here. Defeat your enemies and ascend the tower!

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: World Tree
1.Rule: You may only use Wilder heroes here. Defeat your enemies and ascend the tower!

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Tower of Light
1.Rule: You may only use Lightbearer heroes here. Defeat your enemies and ascend the tower!

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Forsaken Necropolis
1.Rule: You may only use Graveborn heroes here. Defeat your enemies and ascend the tower!

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Wishlist
1.Rule: You can add up to 5 heroes per faction to your hero wishlists for a total of 20 heroes.

2.Rule: Elite heroes have a greater chance of matching your wishlist heroes if any Elite heroes are produced however the overall odds of Elite heroes being produced is not affected.

3.Rule: Removing all heroes and leaving only one hero in the wishlist will not increase the odds of that wishlist hero being produced.

4.Rule: Hypogean and Celestial heroes cannot be added to wishlists.

5.Rule: When selecting heroes for your wishlists, newly added heroes will have the word "New" displayed on their portraits, to help you more easily find and add the newest heroes to your wishlists.

1.Title: Legends' Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Legends' Leaderboard shows each region's top players according to their performance in the 'Road to Glory'.

2.Rule: Rankings are predominantly based upon the time that players acquire avatar frames. If players are equally ranked in terms of frame quantities, the player with the highest overall Combat Rating will claim the higher ranking.

3.Rule: The Legends' Leaderboard only displays the top 50 performing players.

1.Title: Feast of the Beasts
1.Rule: Feast of the Beasts will last for a total of 10 days of which there will be 8 days where cornucopias may be acquired from Labyrinth Praetorian stages and 100 point daily quest chests.

2.Rule: Adjustments to Daily Gift Sets have been made so that some will include cornucopias while the event is underway.

3.Rule: After gifting friends cornucopias you shall receive an equal amount of dragonberries back from them which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards.

4.Rule: You can receive "Nature's Blessings" when you press "Share" for the first time of each new day while the event is underway.

5.Rule: Cornucopias and dragonberries will be null and void once the Feast of the Beasts event has been concluded.

6.Rule: Once the event has concluded, cornucopias and dragonberries will be recalled in exchange for a certain quantity of diamonds.

1.Title: Feast of the Beasts
1.Rule: The amount of "Nature's Blessings" a player receives is equal to the amount of cornucopias they have received from other players.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined according to the total amount of "Nature's Blessings" players receive during the event. Based on their leaderboard ranking, players will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition "Feast of the Beasts" avatar frame once the event has been concluded. Avatar frames will be sent to players via their mailbox, if portraits are not collected in a timely manner they will be deleted.

3.Rule: The Feast of the Beasts "Friends" leaderboard includes players' friends and guild members.

4.Rule: If several players possess the same amount of "Nature's Blessings", then rankings will be determined according to which player first attained that amount.

5.Rule: Once the event has concluded, excess cornucopias and dragonberries will be recalled in exchange for a certain quantity of diamonds.

1.Title: Short-Term Mercenaries
1.Rule: Players can send mercenary hiring requests to their friends or their guild's "Exemplar". If they approve the request, their heroes may be hired out to the requesting player.

2.Rule: Heroes of the same name can only be lent to one friend at a time. Friends can hire mercenary heroes for a maximum duration of one week. At 00:00 UTC on Sunday all heroes will be returned automatically to the original hero owner.

3.Rule: You can only hire Legendary tier or higher heroes from friends. Hired heroes can each be used in battle once in the King's Tower, Faction Towers, and campaign stages if you are victorious, or more than once if you are defeated. Only one mercenary can be used at a time while 'Team Hunting'. However, there is no usage limit for mercenaries.

4.Rule: The amount of times a mercenary hero can be used will only be deducted if victory is achieved.

5.Rule: Players can simultaneously hire 3 mercenary heroes per week and may also send 5 hiring requests at a time.

6.Rule: Signature Items, Ascension Tiers, Artifacts and Furniture of hired heroes are determined by their base attributes and effects. Hero level, equipment, and the Elder Tree depend on how well the borrower trains and upgrades their own heroes.

7.Rule: Players cannot hire heroes from friends that have not been online in the past 7 days.

8.Rule: Each time a player loans out a hero, they shall receive 10 Companion Points. A maximum of 50 Companion Points can be attained per week by loaning out heroes. The weekly limit for the accumulation of Companion Points resets every Sunday at 00:00 UTC.

1.Title: Legends' Prestige
1.Rule: Rankings will be recorded everyday at 01:00, 09:00, 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Battle Chests will be sent to the players which achieved the highest rankings in each of the three daily rank recordings via the mailbox every day at 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

3.Rule: Players that have still not opened the Legends' Challenger feature will still receive a small quantity of Battle Chests via the mailbox, every day at 17:00 while the event is underway.

4.Rule: Battle Chests contain Battle Badges, which may be exchanged on the Prestigious Prizes page for prizes.

5.Rule: Once the event has ended, Battle Chests and Battle Badges will be ineffective and will be recalled in exchange for a certain quantity of diamonds.

1.Title: Revert Heroes
1.Rule: Unlocked when players possess two or more duplicate Ascended Tier Heroes of differing tiers which are higher than Elite+. The duplicate hero with the lowest tier can be reverted.

2.Rule: Reverting a hero will return the Elite+ heroes that were required to ascend it. The equivalent amount of Rare heroes consumed in ascension will also be returned to the player, which shall be of the same faction.

3.Rule: In case of Celestials and Hypogeans, when you have two heroes of the same name, you can revert the lower-tiered hero once they reach Elite+. Reverting Celestial or Hypogean heroes shall return an equivalent amount of Elite tier heroes to you.

1.Title: Event Details
1.Rule: Explore the world and acquire an assortment of loot and rewards while the event is underway.

2.Rule: After each battle has been concluded, the health and energy levels for heroes and enemies will not be reset.

3.Rule: If a battle timer runs out, the attacking side's heroes will be wiped out.

4.Rule: Players may restart the adventure at any time. Resetting the adventure will return all heroes and enemies to their original state.

5.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change once the event has begun.

6.Rule: Rewards may only be collected once per event.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

6.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

7.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

8.Rule: Players can exchange Poe Coins and Glacial Lullaby Set skins once the Oak Inn is unlocked.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

11.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

1.Title: (Old) Champions of Esperia
1.Rule: The Champions of Esperia can be opened after completing Stage 8-20 when the Arcane Labyrinth is refreshed.

2.Rule: The Champions of Esperia event has a duration of 44 days.

3.Rule: Heroic Merits can be acquired by defeating Kane on every floor of the Arcane Labyrinth. You can unlock more rewards on the 'Champions of Esperia' page by acquiring more Heroic Merits.

4.Rule: Any claimable Champions of Esperia rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Champions of Esperia rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Once the new "Change Reward" function becomes available, the original Champions of Esperia feature will be displayed as "(Old) Champions of Esperia", and once the old feature expires it will no longer be refreshed.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Heroic Merits in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the reward reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

1.Title: Heroes of Esperia
1.Rule: Heroes of Esperia is a league competition that is divided into 7 separate league divisions. League division rankings are determined by the amount of trophies that a player acquires. League divisions are divided as such: Bronze League, Silver League, Gold League, Diamond League, Star League, Masters League and Legends League.

2.Rule: Players can increase their standings by winning trophies. A higher trophy count directly corresponds to a higher league standing and subsequently a higher quantity rewards.

3.Rule: Leagues make use of the Martial Rating system and all heroes start with a uniform level of 360. A hero's final level may be increased. The value of the level increase is determined by the hero's base level.

4.Rule: Players within the Masters league are able to challenge Legends league players. If a Masters league player claims a victory against a Legends league player they will be promoted to the Legends league. Trophy counts are not affected when a Masters league player faces off against a Legends league player.

5.Rule: Victorious players will directly swap rankings with the players that they defeated.

6.Rule: The bottom 800 players within the Legend division are at risk of being challenged by Master division players.

7.Rule: At the start of new seasons, players' initial division placements will be determined by their current combat ratings.

8.Rule: Players will be required to field more team formations the higher their league standing rises. The player with the most victorious teams will win the matchup.

9.Rule: Players can press the 'Formation' button to arrange their defensive formations.

10.Rule: Each formation must contain at least one hero. Empty formations will be dealt an automatic loss.

11.Rule: If the battle timer has run out of time, the defending player will be victorious.

12.Rule: Heroes of Esperia rewards are determined by the difficulty level of the current Mystery Player you are facing.

13.Rule: There are only a certain amount of single battle rewards that can be acquired daily. Once these rewards have all been claimed you will not be able to claim any more single battle rewards on that day. Trophies and division rankings will not be affected.

14.Rule: Players that obtain a top 2000 rank on the Heroes of Esperia leaderboard shall win a Fortune Chest that contains a large amount of Diamonds once the season's results have been calculated. Guilds can obtain a maximum of one Fortune Chest per Heroes of Esperia season. If multiple guild members obtain a Heroes of Esperia rank, the Fortune Chest will be based upon the highest ranked member.

1.Title: League Points
1.Rule: Players shall receive Heroes of Esperia League Points based on their division at the end of the season.

2.Rule: Heroes of Esperia League Points can be used to unlock more rewards.

3.Rule: Heroes of Esperia League Points will be retained for use in subsequent seasons.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Celestial keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players are required to choose their ultimate reward on each new island before they can begin opening slots.

3.Rule: Once a floor's ultimate reward has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

4.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 250k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Pillage & Plunder
1.Rule: Only players that own an encampment are eligible to participate in this event.

2.Rule: Arcane Ponds found within players' encampments are active while the event is underway and will generate resources that can be harvested.

3.Rule: Resources generated by Arcane Ponds are determined by the player's campaign progress. Once the event has begun this quantity will remain fixed.

4.Rule: During the event, players can place down defensive structures to fend off other players' attacks.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including parts not worn) are Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses, but are unenhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses that they possess shall remain in effect. Artifact and Union bonuses do not have any effect within the Trials of God.

7.Rule: Players can use the Balloon to find and then challenge other players of similar strength. Reaching their Arcane Ponds grants rewards.

8.Rule: Attacking another player's Arcane Pond will reward resources equal to a certain amount of that player's own Arcane Pond resource output.

9.Rule: Balloon Fuel is required to attack other players. All Arcane Ponds will produce one bottle of Balloon Fuel.

10.Rule: When challenging another player's territory, you may only fight a limited number of times. Each time a battle commences, one battle attempt will be consumed.

11.Rule: Players that leave their guild while the event is in progress still have a chance to be attacked by other players up until the event has ended.

12.Rule: All event rewards that were not collected before the conclusion of the event will be mailed to the player's inbox for collection.

13.Rule: While the event is active, players can dispatch heroes to reinforce their guildmates. Dispatching heroes will not affect the player's own encampment defenses.

1.Title: Phantom of Horror's Eve
1.Rule: Players are able to do battle with Demonic Nemora twice per day while the event is running.

2.Rule: You can acquire 'Creepy Candy' by defeating Demonic Dreafs, which are summoned by Demonic Nemora.

3.Rule: Demonic Nemora is impervious to attacks and she cannot be controlled or killed during battle.

4.Rule: Players can collect 'Creepy Candy', which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards.

5.Rule: The strength of Demonic Nemora and her minions is determined according to the player's own combat rating.

6.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

7.Rule: Players must possess at least one Mythic hero in order to be able to exchange sigils for Mythic gear enhancement resources.

8.Rule: Sigils can be exchanged for Legendary Choice Chests after stage 20-1

1.Title: Box of Fortunes
1.Rule: The newest heroes will be available for a limited time from the 'New Heroes' tab.

2.Rule: 1 Stargazing Card or 500 Diamonds will be consumed for every 1 square that is opened.

3.Rule: You may change your desired hero by changing pages, using the left and right arrows. Each desired hero can only be acquired a maximum of 8 times. Each Box of Fortunes is guaranteed to contain your desired hero which you selected.

4.Rule: Players may switch between desired heroes at any given time.

5.Rule: Once the player's desired hero has been found within the current Box of Fortunes, they will be presented with a new Box of Fortunes.

1.Title: Rise of Arenas Event Rules
1.Rule: Only one redemption code per player account may be generated.

2.Rule: Only one event frame may be redeemed per account. If an event frame already exists on an account, players will not be able to redeem the item again.

3.Rule: Redemption codes are valid up until December 5th 23:59:59 UTC.

4.Rule: Regions where AFK Arena has not been launched are ineligible to partake in this event.

1.Title: Midwinter Surprises
1.Rule: Glacial Keys may be acquired by completing Midwinter Feast quests or defeating Ice Shemira.

2.Rule: Players are required to choose their ultimate reward on each new page before they can begin opening presents.

3.Rule: Once a floor's ultimate reward has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

4.Rule: Remaining Glacial Keys will be recalled for 250k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Midwinter Feast
1.Rule: There are a total of 7 quests. Quests are refreshed daily. You will receive one Winter Feast for every quest that is completed.

2.Rule: Each quest requires 5 formations in order to be started. Each formation must include 2 mandatory heroes. Players also have the choice to add 3 optional heroes to their formations. Quests can be undertaken as soon as 2 mandatory heroes have been selected. The more optional heroes that are selected will lead to more rewards being received.

3.Rule: Once the quest dispatch requirements have been met, the Guild Master or Guild Deputy can choose whether or not to dispatch the heroes on a quest.

4.Rule: After a quest has been completed, all guild members may claim their rewards from the quest page. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to players' inboxes after the event has ended.

5.Rule: Players may unexpectedly be faced with 'Emergencies'. Helping to complete these emergences will reward guild members with additional rewards.

6.Rule: When a hero is dispatched the hero's owner will receive 60 Contribution Points (CP). Completing an 'Emergency' quest will reward the hero's owner with 80 Contribution Points.

7.Rule: Guild members can view their Contribution Points by viewing the 'Contributors' page.

8.Rule: Guild members will receive a bonus reward which will be determined by their guild's overall Midwinter Feast progression after the event has ended.

9.Rule: You will still receive rewards via mail for quests that your heroes were dispatched on even after leaving a guild.

1.Title: Soul Fusion
1.Rule: Dimensional heroes can only increase their Ascension tier through Soul Fusion.

2.Rule: All dimensional heroes can be fused together with any non-dimensional faction hero. Once fused, the dimensional hero will share the same Ascension tier and level as the non-dimensional target hero.

3.Rule: Any resources used to normally level up a dimensional hero will be returned to you when they become fused. While in a fused state, dimensional heroes may not be leveled up normally.

4.Rule: Dimensional heroes may not be used simultaneously in battle with their fused target heroes.

5.Rule: Two fused heroes may be unfused at any time, however this process requires 100 diamonds. Once unfused, the dimensional hero will revert back to their original Elite Ascension tier and their level will be reset back to level 1. Dimensional heroes may also be normally ascended and leveled up as is the case with other heroes.

6.Rule: If the fused target hero is consumed in some way, the dimensional hero will be automatically reverted to its original state without the expense of any diamonds.

1.Title: Ice Shemira
1.Rule: Players are able to do battle with Ice Shemira once a day while the event is running.

2.Rule: Ice Shemira can suffer damage and will drop Gold and Glacial Keys

3.Rule: Glacial Keys can be used to open presents on the Midwinter Surprises page.

4.Rule: Ice Shemira's difficulty is determined by each player's own combat rating.

5.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

1.Title: Assembly of Heroes
1.Rule: Accumulate a designated number of Elite heroes to complete stage targets.

2.Rule: All heroes classed as 'Elite' and above will count towards stage targets. Differing hero tiers each have a different effect on the progression bar.

3.Rule: Ascending Rare+ tier heroes into Elite tier heroes at the Temple of Ascension will count towards your overall progression. However, ascending heroes that are already above Elite tier will not affect your progress.

4.Rule: Reverting eligible heroes will decrease the amount of progress made towards stage targets.

1.Title: 封测返利
1.Rule: 参加曙光删档测试且付费的玩家，可以在原平台下载游戏后，使用同一账号登录游戏领取返利。

2.Rule: 返利规则：根据玩家在曙光删档测试期间的累计充值，返还玩家100%代金券以及等值的钻石（最多可以领取50000钻石）。

3.Rule: 玩家可以选择任意服务器创建角色，并领取返利。

4.Rule: 返利仅可以领取一次，请慎重选择角色领取。

5.Rule: 不同账号的充值，将分别返利至对应的账号。

1.Title: Twisted Realm
1.Rule: The Twisted Realm may be opened once every 2 days.

2.Rule: The floor that players are placed on is based upon the average value of their 5 heroes which are currently standing upon the Pentagram within the Resonating Crystal. After reaching a Resonating Crystal level of 360, floor placement will then be based upon the Resonating Crystal level and no longer based upon average level of Pentagram heroes. Players currently on the same floor will compete against one another on the same leaderboard.

3.Rule: Players on the same floor of the Twisted Realm will have all of their heroes set to the same level, however, heroes' Gear and Ascension Tiers will remain as they originally were.

4.Rule: Players may only use mercenaries, dimensional heroes and heroes which are within the Resonating Crystal.

5.Rule: Only one mercenary may be used per formation within the Twisted Realm, however, the number of times that a mercenary can be used is unlimited.

6.Rule: Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

7.Rule: Within each new Twisted Realm session, players are able to challenge bosses 5 times for free, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may challenge bosses a maximum of 99 times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

8.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

9.Rule: At the end of each Twisted Realm session players will receive two (guild and individual rewards) mails that include their rewards.

10.Rule: Players with an exceptional Fabled Realm ranking will be rewarded with a limited-time Honorable Rewards Medal.

11.Rule: Players within the Fabled Realm will win a Fortune Chest for their guild, which contains Twisted Essence after the results have been calculated.

1.Title: Rewards
1.Rule: Rewards displayed here are an indication of your final session rewards, which are determined by the highest amount of damage you have currently dealt, as well as your current ranking. The final amount of rewards you receive will be determined at the end of the session and may differ slightly from the above number.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rank rewards (excluding Twisted Sigils) are determined by a player's division and Twisted Realm floor level. Twisted Sigils are only determined by a player's division.

3.Rule: Guild mates within the Legend division whom participate in boss challenges will contribute Legend Points to their guild.

4.Rule: Guild members which have participated in boss challenges will receive guild rewards that are based upon the total amount of Legend Points contributed by all guild members.

5.Rule: Members that have not participated in a boss challenge will not receive any guild rewards.

6.Rule: Players that leave their guild before session rankings have been calculated will not receive their guild rewards.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: The top 50 ranked players with the highest damage will be entered into the Legend Division.

2.Rule: The target damage for Diamond, Gold, Silver and Bronze divisions is determined by the target achieved in the previous Twisted Realm sessions ( up to a maximum of 5 previous sessions). The session target damage may vary depending upon the player's current floor and boss.

3.Rule: Excluding the Legend division, all other divisions are split into 5 smaller divisions. For example: Diamond 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

4.Rule: Players are able to view the replay and formation of battles in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

5.Rule: Real-time rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

6.Rule: If there are no players occupying the lower divisions of the leaderboard, then those divisions will not be viewable on the leaderboard.

1.Title: The Elder Tree
1.Rule: Flawless Droplets may be obtained when an Elite hero is acquired for the first time or when Elite heroes are ascended (duplicates of Elite heroes will not reward Flawless Droplets).

2.Rule: Flawless Droplets can be used at the Elder Tree to increase its level.

3.Rule: Attributes gifted by the Elder Tree will impact all heroes' attributes.

4.Rule: Dura's Virtues will be unlocked after completing Chapter 12 and reaching level 15 with the Elder Tree. Each virtue represents a hero class. The classes represented by Dura's Virtues are as follows: Tank, Warrior, Ranger, Mage and Support.

5.Rule: Each individual Virtue branch of the Elder Tree can be leveled up with the use of Twisted Essence. Leveling up a virtue will increase the attributes it gives to heroes.

1.Title: Burning Brute
1.Rule: Players may do battle with the Burning Brute once per day while the event is running.

2.Rule: Injuring the Burning Brute will cause it to drop event items called Astrobells.

3.Rule: Astrobells can be collected and exchanged for a variety of rewards.

4.Rule: The Burning Brute's strength is determined by each player's own combat rating.

5.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

1.Title: Winter Bounties
1.Rule: Astrobells can be acquired while the event is running.

2.Rule: Players must possess at least one Mythic hero in order to be able to exchange sigils for Mythic gear enhancement resources.

3.Rule: Sigils can be exchanged for Legendary Choice Chests after stage 20-1

4.Rule: Astrobells will be recalled for 15k Gold per bell once the event has concluded.

1.Title: A Sweet Romance
1.Rule: Redeem Mehira's Chocolate Heart for rewards during the event. Drops will last 8 days and redemptions 10 days.

2.Rule: You can find Mehira's Chocolate Heart in Daily Quest Chests, a Labyrinth or Gift Shop.

3.Rule: Players must possess at least one Mythic hero in order to be able to exchange sigils for Mythic gear enhancement resources.

4.Rule: Stargazing Cards can be exchanged after stage 15-40 or VIP13.

5.Rule: Twisted Essence, which is used to increase item stats at the Elder Tree may be exchanged after players have completed Stage 8-40.

6.Rule: Surplus items will be automatically refunded after the event for 40K Gold coins/item.

1.Title: Floral Flirtation
1.Rule: You can send flowers by visiting other players' profile page during the 10 day event. Flower drops last 8 days.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined according to the total amount of "Mehira's Roses" players receive during the event. Players will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition Valentine's frame based on their leaderboard ranking once the event has been concluded, which will be sent to players via their mailbox.

3.Rule: You can find Mehira's Roses in the Labyrinth, but only on subsequent playthroughs.

4.Rule: Receive extra roses for free when purchasing Mehira's Chocolate Hearts at the Gift Shop.

1.Title: The Soul Reaver
1.Rule: Players will have the opportunity to challenge Azmonath once per day.

2.Rule: Players will be able to acquire the event items the 'Vibrant Bloom' flowers by inflicting damage upon Azmonath.

3.Rule: Vibrant Bloom flowers may be exchanged for a multitude of rewards.

4.Rule: Azmonath's difficulty will be determined by each player's own combat rating.

5.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

1.Title: Legends' Prestige
1.Rule: Rankings will be recorded everyday at 01:00, 09:00 and 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

2.Rule: The amount of Battle Chests received by a player is based upon their highest daily ranking. Battle Chests will be sent via the in-game mailbox.

3.Rule: Players that have still not opened the Legends' Challenger Tournament feature will still receive a small quantity of Battle Chests via their inbox everyday at 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

4.Rule: During the Legends' Challenger Tournament, all heroes will start with a hero level of 360. A hero's overall level when fighting within the Legends' Challenger Tournament may then be increased based upon their own base level. Battles within the Legends' Challenger Tournament will no longer display player Combat Ratings.

5.Rule: Battle Chests contain Battle Badges, which may be exchanged on the Prestigious Prizes page for prizes.

6.Rule: Any remaining Battle Chests and Battle Badges will be recalled for 10k/3k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Prestigious Prizes
1.Rule: Players may exchange Battle Badges for rewards up until the event ends (10 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire Battle Chests and Battle Badges by playing the "Legends' Prestige" and "Gladiatorial Merits" game modes.

3.Rule: Players must possess at least one Mythic hero in order to be able to exchange sigils for Mythic gear enhancement resources.

4.Rule: Players may use Reset Scrolls in order to reset the factional affiliation of Mythic tiered and above equipment after they have completed Stage 17-1.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

6.Rule: Any remaining Battle Chests and Battle Badges will be recalled for 10k/3k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gladiatorial Merits
1.Rule: Players can acquire Battle Badges by completing quests on the Gladiatorial Merits page.

2.Rule: Battle Badges can be exchanged on the Prestigious Prizes page for rewards.

3.Rule: Any remaining Battle Chests and Battle Badges will be recalled for 10k/3k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Righteous Riches
1.Rule: Unlocked reward tiers are determined by the duration a player has been inactive for.

2.Rule: The Righteous Riches event will run for a total of 17 days.

3.Rule: Acquire more Savior's Medallions from Daily and Weekly Quest Chests to unlock more Righteous Riches rewards!

4.Rule: Any Righteous Riches rewards that were unlocked by the player, but were unclaimed, will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Righteous Riches event is reset.

5.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Savior's Medallions in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Righteous Riches reward reset date.

6.Rule: Unlocking the Righteous Riches Premium Pass also grants the equivalent value of VIP Experience.

7.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one event cycle and are not permanent.

8.Rule: Players will receive the equivalent value of Savior's Medallions when they purchase any bundle or set (excluding Subscriptions and Noble Privileges) 5 days prior to the event's conclusion.

1.Title: Righteous Riches
1.Rule: Unlocked reward tiers are determined by the duration a player has been inactive for.

2.Rule: The Righteous Riches event will run for a total of 17 days.

3.Rule: Acquire more Savior's Medallions from Daily and Weekly Quest Chests to unlock more Righteous Riches rewards!

4.Rule: Any Righteous Riches rewards that were unlocked by the player, but were unclaimed, will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Righteous Riches event is reset.

5.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Savior's Medallions in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Righteous Riches reward reset date.

6.Rule: Unlocking the Righteous Riches Premium Pass also grants the equivalent value of VIP Experience.

7.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one event cycle and are not permanent.

8.Rule: Players will receive the equivalent value of Savior's Medallions when they purchase any bundle or set before the event ends.

1.Title: Blooms of Spring
1.Rule: Participate in the Soul Reaver event to claim Vibrant Blooms

2.Rule: Players are required to choose their ultimate reward on each new page before they can begin opening presents.

3.Rule: Once a floor's ultimate reward has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

4.Rule: Excess Vibrant Blooms will be automatically refunded after the event for 35K Gold coins/item.

1.Title: One Year Anniversary
1.Rule: Event lasts for 14 days. Receive an anniversary gift everyday for the first 7 days.

2.Rule: Players can receive a final, large anniversary gift after all 7 smaller gifts have been claimed.

1.Title: Spring Bloom
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new gemstone. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a gemstone will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Complete all quests to acquire Tasi's Exclusive Skin: The Spring Bloom

1.Title: (Old) Twisted Bounties
1.Rule: Twisted Bounties event will be available after the Twisted Realm is unlocked.

2.Rule: The Twisted Bounties event has a duration of 44 days.

3.Rule: Acquire more Twisted Sigils and receive more Twisted Bounties during this event! Twisted Sigils can be acquired via Twisted Realm rank rewards.

4.Rule: Any Twisted Bounties rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Twisted Bounties system is reset.

5.Rule: Once the new "Change Reward" function becomes available, the original Twisted Bounties feature will be displayed as "(Old) Twisted Bounties", and once the old feature expires it will no longer be refreshed.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Twisted Sigils in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the reward reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Players can acquire Celestial Keys via AFK Rewards, completing Daily Quests or playing The Depths of Time II adventure.

2.Rule: Players are required to choose a high-value reward on each new island before they can begin opening slots.

3.Rule: Once an island's high-value reward has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next island/floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current island. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current island will disappear.

4.Rule: During the Celestial Isles event, players are able to unlock one ultimate reward every 10 floors/islands.

5.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 35k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Furniture Wishlist
1.Rule: Up to 10 Hero Icons can be added to the Furniture Wishlist.

2.Rule: When drawing 10 Furniture cards, if a Mythic item is produced, it has a greater chance of matching a hero icon currently in your wishlist but will not increase the overall chances of Mythic items being produced.

3.Rule: Clearing slots in the furniture wishlist will not increase the chance of other hero icons appearing.

4.Rule: On the Hero Selection menu, the Mythic Furniture tags below the Hero's avatar represents the number of Mythic Furniture with active affinity tags placed in the Hero's room.

1.Title: Field of Stars
1.Rule: "Field of Stars" includes many constellations, each of which includes multiple starbursts.

2.Rule: Fulfill the corresponding requirements to unlock starbursts, which grant a variety of resource bonuses.

3.Rule: Unlocking starbursts requires time and gold coins.

4.Rule: Starbursts within a single constellation can only be unlocked one at a time.

5.Rule: VIP Level and Subscription (Noble) Privileges do not influence the effects of Starbursts in any way.

6.Rule: Conditions to unlock Starbursts do not include dimensional heroes, trial heroes or mercenaries.

1.Title: Dreamland Doubles
1.Rule: <text|Event Rules:|activity_weekly_text_normal><changeLine><text|During the event, all ranking rewards for this Dream Realm are |activity_weekly_text_normal><text|doubled|activity_weekly_text_special><text|.|activity_weekly_text_normal>

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Grotesque Mage event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Grotesque Mage
1.Rule: Players will have the opportunity to challenge the Grotesque Mage once per day.

2.Rule: Players will be awarded Magic Tickets according to the amount of damage done to the Grotesque Mage.

3.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

4.Rule: The Grotesque Mage's difficulty will be determined by each player's own combat rating.

5.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

1.Title: Special Monthly Bundle
1.Rule: Heroes found within the Special Monthly Bundle will not change unless the bundle is refreshed.

2.Rule: A new-hero exclusive Special Monthly Bundle shall become available each time a new non-dimensional hero is launched. This bundle will only be available for the duration of the month it is released, and will not be refreshed the following month.

1.Title: Arena of Trials
1.Rule: When a hero's Bountiful Trial begins, their Arena of Trials will be reset.

2.Rule: Once reset, multiple battle stages become available in the Arena of Trials, and players can earn rewards for each battle they win. Once all battle stages are completed, players can claim the final reward chest.

3.Rule: After the event has ended, players can replay battles, but no new rewards will be available.

4.Rule: Enemies are reset each time a player re-enters the Arena of Trials.

5.Rule: All heroes used in the Arena of Trials have a default ascension tier of 5-Star Ascended and hero level of 360. Heroes are equipped with non-upgraded Mythic T1 gear without Faction Bonuses.

1.Title: Arena of Trials
1.Rule: <text|Heroes: |normal_yellow_stroke_20><text|Only heroes that have been pre-selected by the formation system may be used. Trial heroes are selected by default.|normal_white_20>

2.Rule: <text|Hero Grading:|normal_yellow_stroke_20><text| All heroes are |normal_white_20><text|Ascended|skill_desc_green><text| tier and possess a hero level of |normal_white_20><text|240|skill_desc_green><text|.|normal_white_20>

3.Rule: <text|Gear:|normal_yellow_stroke_20><text| All heroes use|normal_white_20><text|Mythic T1|skill_desc_green><text| non-upgraded gear without factional bonuses.|normal_white_20>

4.Rule: <text|Signature Items: |normal_yellow_stroke_20><text|All heroes are equipped with a level|normal_white_20><text| 30|skill_desc_green><text| Signature Item by default.|normal_white_20>
