1.Title: Misty Valley
1.Rule: Acquire an abundance of rewards by exploring the Misty Valley during the event period.

2.Rule: For each new battle, all player-owned heroes and enemy heroes shall start with full health and zero energy.

3.Rule: The teleportation pad for the Treasure Trove island is situated behind Stage 20. Players must defeat the enemies in Stage 20 to enter the island.

4.Rule: The number of reward slots available within the Treasure Trove is based upon a player's progression in the main campaign. Players can set rewards as they please, but rewards can only be retrieved by traveling to the Treasure Trove island.

5.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

6.Rule: If a player is unable to complete a particular stage, they can request help from their friends or guild mates. However, if requesting help, friends and guild mates may only help complete 'Stone' tier challenges, and cannot help with 'Silver' or 'Gold' tier challenges.

7.Rule: Requesting help from friends will consume diamonds. However, if a player independently completes the stage in question before their friend accepts their request, then the diamonds used will be returned to the player.

8.Rule: The Misty Valley cannot be reset, and all rewards can only be claimed once.

1.Title: Honorable
1.Rule: Honorable Enrollees are required to spend Diamonds.

2.Rule: Honorable-enrolled players will only be placed with other Honorable players during the event, and shall not encounter any Casual players.

3.Rule: Difficulty for the Vault of Time for Honorable Enrollees is more difficult than Casual. However, Honorably Enrolled players shall receive more rewards for ranking up their Title. Players that reach the title of Duke and Prince will receive an additional reward of Diamonds.

4.Rule: Only Honorably Enrolled Militias may compete on the leaderboard.

5.Rule: Once enrolled for an Honorable expedition, the decision cannot be reverted.

1.Title: Treasure Hunters
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Every single victory of multi-formation Campaign battles that occur after Chapter 31 or onwards will count towards the summer event.

5.Rule: Complete all quests to acquire Lucius' Exclusive Skin: The Mariner

1.Title: Ocean Treasures
1.Rule: Players may exchange Wishing Bottles for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire lots of Wishing Bottles in the Treasure Hunters and Summer Delights events.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Poe Coins after unlocking the Oak Inn feature.

5.Rule: Excess Wishing Bottles will be recalled for 10k Gold per bottle once the event has concluded.

6.Rule: Players can select the Miss Midsummer skin from the Noble Tavern's 'Skins' page after acquiring it.

1.Title: Labyrinth of Limbo
1.Rule: <text|During this event: |activity_weekly_text_normal><changeLine><text|Arcane Labyrinth|activity_weekly_text_normal><text| rewards will be doubled. |activity_weekly_text_special><text||activity_weekly_text_normal><text|(All items except gear sold by the Arcane Labyrinth's 'The Roamer' will be doubled)|activity_weekly_text_special>

1.Title: Rewards
1.Rule: Rewards displayed here are an indication of your final session rewards, which are determined by the highest amount of damage you have currently dealt, as well as your current ranking. The final amount of rewards you receive will be determined at the end of the session and may differ slightly from the above number.

2.Rule: Once the event has concluded, guild members that are ranked high on the Boss Challenge Leaderboard shall receive avatar frame rewards, which shall be sent to the player's inbox.

3.Rule: Only one Honorable Statue can be claimed per guild per Abyssal Expedition season.

1.Title: Event Rules
1.Rule: Players can claim and trial the Miss Midsummer skin for 7 days during this event.

2.Rule: Players can exchange Wishing Bottles in the Ocean Treasures event to permanently acquire the Miss Midsummer skin during this event.

3.Rule: Players can choose the Miss Midsummer skin from the Noble Tavern's 'Skins' page.

1.Title: The Summer Vow, A Cordial Exchange
1.Rule: Players may exchange Pledge Stones for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire Pledge Stones via Daily Quest Chests, AFK Rewards and the Voyage of Wonders. Pledge Stones shall drop from Daily Quest Chests and AFK Rewards for a duration of 12 days. A player's campaign progress directly affects the rate of which Pledge Stone are dropped at.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 8-40.

5.Rule: Players may use Reset Scrolls in order to reset the factional affiliation of Mythic tiered and above equipment after they have completed Stage 17-1.

6.Rule: You can exchange event items for Poe Coins after unlocking the Oak Inn feature.

7.Rule: Surplus items will be automatically refunded after the event for 40K Gold coins/item.

1.Title: Pearly Presents
1.Rule: You can send gifts to other players via their "Player Info" page during the event.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined by the total amount of "Pristine Pearls" players receive during the event. Players will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition Summer frame, which is determined by their final leaderboard ranking. Frames shall be sent to the player's inbox at the end of the event.

3.Rule: Players may claim Pristine Pearls from the Voyage of Wonders and AFK Rewards. Pristine Pearls will drop for 12 days and can be given away for 14 days. A player's campaign progress directly affects the rate of which Pristine Pearls are dropped at.

4.Rule: Players which purchase Pledge Stones from the store shall receive extra Pristine Pearls for free.

1.Title: Hero Growth Bundles
1.Rule: Unlock the Hero Growth Bundles entrance by illuminating Taeda - The Distant Torch within the Field of Stars feature.

2.Rule: During this event, players can unlock different tiers of reward bundles by acquiring specific heroes and increasing their ascension tier. The unlockable reward bundles tier is determined by the highest recorded ascension tier of specific heroes.

3.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of less than 5 can initially view Hero Growth Bundles up to [Legendary+] tier.

4.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of between 5 and 12 can initially view Hero Growth Bundles up to [Ascended] tier.

5.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of 13 or higher can initially view all Hero Growth Bundles.

1.Title: Suggested
1.Rule: Recommend will automatically calculate the optimal selections, allowing players to arrange their overall set-up with a single tap.

2.Rule: Furniture will be allocated to High Priority heroes ensuring maximization of active tags within the group of heroes labeled as High Priority.

3.Rule: When the number of activatable tags on a hero within a group of multiple heroes is equal, the hero with higher ascension and greater Combat Rating will be allocated the furniture.

4.Rule: New heroes are automatically assigned to Medium Priority by default.

5.Rule: "Optimize" will automatically swap out old furniture and replace it with the new optimal furniture. (Please note: Auto-place will only modify the furniture in the room currently selected)

6.Rule: When "Auto-Place" is on, furniture will be automatically placed with Recommend. When "Auto-Place" is off, or there is no space for furniture, it will be placed in the warehouse.

7.Rule: Once the "Mythic Furniture Lock" feature becomes available, appointed heroes shall have priority when receiving Mythic Furniture recommendations.

1.Title: Rapid Strengthen
1.Rule: When a hero equipped with 9 pieces of Mythic Furniture still has additional unused Mythic Furniture in your bag, they can be upgraded with the "Rapid Strengthen" function.

2.Rule: Tap the hero's avatar to enter their room and upgrade a furniture type.

3.Rule: "Upgrade" will prioritize the low-level Mythic Furniture among the particular type of Exclusive Furniture.

4.Rule: "Upgrade All" will prioritize the low-level Mythic Furniture among all of the hero's Exclusive Furniture.

1.Title: Legends' Prestige
1.Rule: Rankings will be recorded everyday at 01:00, 09:00 and 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

2.Rule: The amount of "Esperian Idol" Voting Tickets received by a player is based upon their highest daily ranking. "Esperian Idol" Voting Tickets will be sent via the in-game mailbox.

3.Rule: Players that have still not opened the Legends' Challenger Tournament feature will still receive a small quantity of rewards via their mailbox.

4.Rule: During the Legends' Challenger Tournament, all heroes will start with a hero level of 360. A hero's overall level when fighting within the Legends' Challenger Tournament may then be increased based upon their own base level. Battles within the Legends' Challenger Tournament will no longer display player Combat Ratings.

1.Title: Trading Hub
1.Rule: The Trading Hub is divided into Militia Trading and the Global Auction.

2.Rule: Dragon Crystals can be used at the Militia Trading Hub and Global Auction. Bound Dragon Crystals and Diamonds may not be used at either of the above places.

3.Rule: Rewards received from the Abyssal Expedition - Militia Feats feature shall be entered into the this Militia's Trading Hub, where all Militia Members can bid upon the items.

4.Rule: The Militia Trading Hub uses an auction house system for purchasing items. Players can roll for items using Dragon Crystals. The player with the highest number on their die will successfully receive the item. Player's that failed to win an item sold at auction shall have their Dragon Crystals returned to them.

5.Rule: Once bidding has ended, the player which has rolled the most shall receive their item via their mailbox.

6.Rule: Every item at the Militia Trading Hub has a 24 hour bidding time limit.

7.Rule: If an item that is up for auction at the Militia Trading Hub does not get sold, it shall be placed in the Global Auction House at a higher price, where players across all servers have the chance to bid upon it.

8.Rule: The Global Auction uses a "Dutch Auction" mode of bidding, meaning the item begins with a high asking price in the case of selling, and is lowered until a participant accepts the price, however, the price cannot fall lower than the original Militia Trading Hub price.

9.Rule: Prices of goods in the Global Auction House will fall once every 12 hours. If unsold within 5 days, the sale will be discontinued.

10.Rule: For every Militia Reward that is sold at the Militia Trading Hub or Global Auction House, the equivalent amount of Bound Dragon Crystals shall be awarded to the original Militia in the form of a Militia Chest.

11.Rule: Bound Dragon Crystals found within Militia Chests will be divided 70 times and the amount each player receives is random. Players with a title rank of Earl or higher are entitled to 1 part of the 70 random divisions of the Militia Chest.

12.Rule: Bound Dragon Crystals cannot be used at the Militia Trading Hub or Global Auction House, but can be exchanged for any items found at the Exchange Store.

13.Rule: Militia Chests will become unclaimable 8 days after the Abyssal Expedition event has finished, and any unclaimed Militia Chests will not be reissued.

1.Title: Militia Chest
1.Rule: For every Militia Reward that is sold at the Militia Trading Hub or Global Auction House, the equivalent amount of Bound Dragon Crystals shall be awarded to the original Militia in the form of a Militia Chest.

2.Rule: Bound Dragon Crystals found within Militia Chests will be divided 70 times and the amount each player receives is random. Players with a title rank of Earl or higher are entitled to 1 part of the 70 random divisions of the Militia Chest.

3.Rule: Bound Dragon Crystals cannot be used at the Militia Trading Hub or Global Auction House, but can be exchanged for any items found at the Exchange Store.

4.Rule: Militia Chests will become unclaimable 8 days after the Abyssal Expedition event has finished, and any unclaimed Militia Chests will not be reissued.

1.Title: Dragon Crystal
1.Rule: Players can purchase Dragon Crystals at the Dragon Store.

2.Rule: A corresponding amount of Dragon Crystal Buy-Back orders shall be generated for each purchase of Dragon Crystals.

3.Rule: Each Buy-Back order is valid for a duration of 5 days. During the buy-back period, players can exchange a certain number of Dragon Crystals for coupons.

4.Rule: Coupons can be used to buy items of equal value (excluding Dragon Crystals) at the Merchants.

5.Rule: Once a Buy-Back order's buy-back period has ended, the corresponding amount of VIP Experience shall be sent to the player's mailbox.

1.Title: Dragon Crystal
1.Rule: Players can purchase Dragon Crystal Entrance Tickets from the Dragon Store.

2.Rule: After collecting Dragon Crystal Entrance Tickets from their mailbox, players can find them inside their bag and use them to enter the stage to acquire Dragon Crystals.

3.Rule: A corresponding amount of Dragon Crystal Buy-Back orders shall be generated for each purchase of Dragon Crystals.

4.Rule: Each Buy-Back order is valid for a duration of 5 days. During the buy-back period, players can exchange a certain number of Dragon Crystals for coupons.

5.Rule: Coupons can be used to buy items of equal value (excluding Dragon Crystals) at the Merchants.

6.Rule: Once a Buy-Back order's buy-back period has ended, the corresponding amount of VIP Experience shall be sent to the player's mailbox.

1.Title: Dragon Crystals Buy-Back
1.Rule: A corresponding amount of Dragon Crystal Buy-Back orders shall be generated for each purchase of Dragon Crystals.

2.Rule: Each Buy-Back order is valid for a duration of 5 days. During the buy-back period, players can exchange a certain number of Dragon Crystals for coupons.

3.Rule: Coupons can be used to buy items of equal value (excluding Dragon Crystals) at the Merchants.

4.Rule: Once a Buy-Back order's buy-back period has ended, the corresponding amount of VIP Experience shall be sent to the player's mailbox.

1.Title: New Trial Hero
1.Rule: During the New Trial Hero period, players can use the new hero for free.

2.Rule: However, Trial Heroes are NOT owned by the player and are only available for use.

3.Rule: Players are able to use this hero for their full trial time. They will be automatically recalled when the hero's trial time has ended.

4.Rule: Trial Heroes' levels, Eternal Engravings level, ranks, gear and signature items acquired will be automatically converted to those of the original character owned by the player. Trial Heroes cannot be upgraded, neither can their gear be improved or changed.

5.Rule: Trial heroes cannot enter the Inn and can only make use of certain furniture bonuses, of which those bonuses will be decided by the furniture attributes of the hero currently owned by the player.

1.Title: Esperian Idols
1.Rule: During the voting stage, players can choose 8 of their favorite heroes. The 8 heroes with the most votes shall be entered into the main draw.

2.Rule: During the main draw, heroes will go head to head with one another, with the hero with the most votes claiming victory.

3.Rule: During the main draw, players can answer questions on the Daily Quiz page to acquire "Esperian Idol" Voting Tickets. Players can also acquire tickets by participating in the Legends' Prestige event.

4.Rule: The total number of voting tickets submitted by a player directly increases the player's "Voting Rewards". Each time a voting milestone is reached, players can claim more rewards.

5.Rule: The final vote result is the total sum of all global regions' votes combined (excludes pioneer server votes).

6.Rule: Surplus items will be automatically refunded after the event for 10 Gold coins/item.

7.Rule: The hero which wins the contest shall receive a tailor-made skin and exclusive avatar frame. Advance notice of this item shall be given via the mailbox before it goes online.

1.Title: Trials of God
1.Rule: Before the Trials of God instance begins, players can choose multiple different trials, with each one becoming active once the instance opens.

2.Rule: Each trial has effects that will make it incredibly tough, make sure to choose wisely!

3.Rule: Each trial has its own difficulty points. The overall trial level of the instance is the sum total of all difficulty points combined.

4.Rule: When in the instance, you can reduce the difficulty at any time, but it will also reduce your final trial level.

5.Rule: Players will obtain rewards based on the highest trial level cleared.

1.Title: Soul Bond
1.Rule: When Soul Bonding is in effect, slaying a boss will cause the other bonded boss to lose 50% of their max health. However, the bonded boss shall not die as a result of this damage and shall retain at least 1 Health point.

2.Rule: Damage that is dealt as a result of Soul Bonding will be displayed on the Militia Damage Leaderboard but shall not be displayed on the individual player damage leaderboard.

1.Title: Dimensional Hero Trial
1.Rule: During the Dimensional Hero Trial period, players can use the new Dimensional hero for free.

2.Rule: However, Dimensional Trial Heroes are NOT owned by the player and are only available for use.

3.Rule: Players are able to use this hero for their full trial time. They will be automatically recalled when the hero's trial time has ended.

4.Rule: Dimensional trial heroes' levels, Eternal Engravings level, gear and signature items acquired will be automatically converted following other heroes owned by the player. Trial Heroes cannot be upgraded, neither can their gear be improved or changed.

5.Rule: Dimensional Trial Heroes can be fused together with any non-dimensional faction hero. Once fused, the Dimensional Trial Hero will share the same Ascension tier and level as their non-dimensional target hero.

6.Rule: Dimensional Trial Heroes cannot enter the Inn and can only make use of certain furniture bonuses, of which those bonuses will be decided by the furniture attributes of the heroes currently owned by the player.

7.Rule: Duplicate Dimensional heroes and their trial counterpart of the same name may exist simultaneously. However, when fusing a hero's soul, one must choose which of the two hero's they wish to Soul-Fuse.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: Magic Tickets can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 1k Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Players can exchange Poe Coins and Glacial Lullaby Set skins once the Oak Inn is unlocked.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Excess Beastly Pendant will be recalled for 30k Gold per pendant once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Replace Heroes
1.Rule: Reach the maximum tier with any Celestial/Hypogean hero to unlock this function.

2.Rule: Maximum ascension must first be reached by any Celestial or Hypogean Heroes before these surplus heroes can be exchanged for any non-dimensional Hero of the player's choice.

3.Rule: In order for surplus Celestial or Hypogean heroes to be consumable, they must possess an Elite ascension tier. Heroes that already have a higher ascension tier than Elite must first be reverted.

1.Title: Dimensional Hero
1.Rule: Whenever multiple Dimensional heroes belonging to a certain IP series are released, the first Dimensional hero will be sold at a discounted price of 85% during the event.

2.Rule: If only one Dimensional hero belonging to an IP series is released during an event, the discount shall not be applicable.

3.Rule: This discount is only valid during IP crossover events.

4.Rule: All player profiles belonging to the same account may enjoy this discount.

5.Rule: Dimensional heroes which are not limited-edition can still be purchased for the original price after the Limited Offer event has ended by navigating to 'Merchants - Merchant Ship - Dimension Deals'.

1.Title: Special Weekly Bonus
1.Rule: Heroes found within the Special Weekly Bonus will not change unless it is refreshed.

1.Title: Battle of Blood
1.Rule: When entering the event for the first time, players will be given a differing number of initial points, which is based upon the player's current campaign progress.

2.Rule: During this event, players will make use of heroes drawn from a uniform hero pool. Heroes from this pool cannot be affected by players in any way.

3.Rule: All heroes used are level 360, 5-Star Ascended heroes.

4.Rule: All heroes will by default equip Mythic T4 equipment without bonus attributes.

5.Rule: All heroes are equipped with a level 30 Signature Item by default.

6.Rule: All heroes are equipped with 9 pieces of Mythic Exclusive Furniture.

7.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Elder Tree attributes and skills by default.

8.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Engravings by default.

9.Rule: Heroes do not make use of any Artifact attribute bonuses or Union Attribute Bonuses.

10.Rule: Players can choose to fight competitively against similarly ranked players or spar with their guildmates and friends.

11.Rule: At the start of battles, both players shall be allocated 10 random, unique heroes.

12.Rule: When preparing for battles, players shall choose 5 desired heroes out of 10 for their formations. The preparation phase is split into 3 stages, during the first stage players will choose 2 heroes, for the second stage another 2 heroes shall be chosen and in the third stage, 1 final hero will be chosen to finalize the formation.

13.Rule: During the battle preparation phase, heroes selected for battles shall appear on the left side of the battlefield. However, once a battle begins, a player's heroes may enter from the right side of the battlefield as a result of the system's matchmaking process.

14.Rule: Players can complete Battle of Blood quests to obtain Activity Points. Obtain more Activity Points to unlock more rewards.

15.Rule: Players that obtain a top 1000 rank on leaderboard shall win a Fortune Chest that contains large amount of Hero's Essences. Guilds can obtain a maximum of one Fortune Chest. If multiple guild members obtain a rank, the Fortune Chest will be based upon the highest ranked member.

16.Rule: Sparring with friends and guildmates does not affect a player's leaderboard points and does not grant any rewards.

17.Rule: If the battle timer reaches zero without a definitive winner, the side with the most surviving heroes still on the battlefield will claim victory. If the number of heroes on either side are equal, the side with the highest combined percentage of health remaining will claim victory.

18.Rule: If a player has failed to place any heroes in formation before a particular round's countdown timer ends, the system will automatically place their heroes for them, and Autoplay mode will be initiated in the next round. When Autoplay is on, the system will automatically select heroes to be used in formation. Players can tap the screen at any time to disengage Autoplay.

1.Title: Warrior's Glory
1.Rule: Players may exchange Beastly Pendants for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire lots of Beastly Pendants from the Battle of Blood event.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

7.Rule: Excess Beastly Pendant will be recalled for 24k Gold per pendant once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Martial Rating
1.Rule: <text|Heroes: |normal_yellow_stroke_20><text|During this event, players will make use of heroes drawn from a uniform hero pool. Heroes from this pool cannot be affected by players in any way.|normal_white_20>

1.Title: Dismal Maze
1.Rule: Each Dismal Maze round has a duration of 48 hours, after which it is refreshed. Each time the maze is refreshed, all enemies, rewards and structures within it are also refreshed.

2.Rule: Only one type of maze mode may be chosen per round. Once a mode is selected, the other mode will be unavailable.

3.Rule: Negative Dismal Luck effects and Factional restrictions are refreshed once every 4 rounds.

4.Rule: If a player misses a round of the Arcane Labyrinth, the player will still enjoy a reward bonus in the next round of the Dismal Maze, but rewards will not be calculated after missing the Arcane Labyrinth more than 1 time.

5.Rule: When playing the Dismal Maze mode, the hero with the highest Ascension tier and Combat Rating shall take precedence when duplicate heroes exist.

6.Rule: Defeating Relic Guardians rewards players with a specific Relic. Defeating Bosses allows players to choose one Relic from several random Relics.

7.Rule: Dura's Tears may only be used up to 3 times per round while playing the Dismal Maze mode. If a round is missed, the maximum number of times Dura's Tears can be used will be increased accordingly.

8.Rule: Enemy formations can be refreshed 3 times per round in Dismal mode. Refreshing resets the enemies' Health and Energy back to their initial state.

9.Rule: Subscription Privileges shall take effect in the current round of the Dismal Maze if you already possess them before entering.

10.Rule: Complete Stage 38-60 to unlock Level Sweep, which can be used for the first tile of the Labyrinth.

11.Rule: With Level Sweep, you can clear multiple stages at once and earn corresponding rewards.

1.Title: Monthly Card
1.Rule: Activating the Monthly Card allows players to instantly obtain the corresponding amount of diamonds.

2.Rule: Every time a Monthly Card is purchased, its duration is extended by 30 days.

3.Rule: Activate the Monthly Card to obtain exclusive rewards and activate corresponding special perks. Rewards are refreshed on a daily basis. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the player's mailbox.

4.Rule: Activate the Deluxe Monthly Card to make purchases in the Deluxe Monthly Card Perk Store, where items refresh every 30 days.

5.Rule: Activating the Deluxe Monthly Card multiple times can increase the Monthly Card Perk Level and unlock more items.

6.Rule: Once your Monthly Card expires, you can no longer purchase items from the Perk Store. However, your Perk Level will be preserved and will be reactivated once you reactivate your Monthly Card.

1.Title: Popularity Boards
1.Rule: All heroes on the Popularity Boards are sorted in order of their popularity, which is based on a range of differing players' choices at different stages of the campaign.

2.Rule: On the Popular Heroes board, heroes with high popularity rankings are used more frequently than other heroes for a particular type of battle.

3.Rule: Beasts with high popularity rankings on the Popular Beasts leaderboard are used more frequently than other beasts.

1.Title: Forest Mania
1.Rule: Stages will become unlocked based on the player's Campaign progress.

2.Rule: Players can claim one-time rewards every time they complete a stage for the first time.

3.Rule: Players are able to obtain a certain number of stars according to their stage score. By reaching a higher number of stars, players are able to unlock more chests and claim even more rewards.

4.Rule: Players can attempt to surpass their current high scores by replaying stages. Stage scores will contribute to the player's ranking on the 'Friends' and 'Server' leaderboards.

1.Title: Forsaken Winter
1.Rule: Players may battle once per day while the event is running.

2.Rule: Shemira, Daimon and Niru all have separate health bars and skills.

3.Rule: Dealing damage against Shemira, Daimon or Niru during battles produces Glacial Keys.

4.Rule: Defeating 2 of the 3 bosses shall cause the final remaining boss to disappear and release all of its remaining rewards.

5.Rule: Glacial Keys can be used to open treasures on The Frosty Isles page.

6.Rule: Shemira, Daimon and Niru's difficulty will be determined by each player's own strength.

7.Rule: Players can choose to repeat battles without the deduction of any battle attempts, however the rewards earned in the previous battle will subsequently disappear.

1.Title: The Frosty Isles
1.Rule: Players can acquire Glacial Keys via the Forsaken Winter event, completing Daily Quests or playing The Snowy Front adventure.

2.Rule: Players are required to choose an ultimate reward on each new floor before they can begin opening slots.

3.Rule: Once an island's ultimate reward has been discovered, players can advance to the next floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

4.Rule: During the Frosty Isles event, players are able to unlock one ultimate reward every 10 floors.

5.Rule: Remaining Glacial Keys will be recalled for 5000 gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: War of Wits
1.Rule: When entering the event for the first time, players will be given a differing number of initial points, which is based upon the player's current campaign progress.

2.Rule: During this event, players will make use of heroes drawn from a uniform hero pool. Heroes from this pool cannot be affected by players in any way.

3.Rule: This event includes a certain number of relics, as well as 4 factions: Lightbearers, Maulers, Wilders and Graveborn. A total of 40 heroes shall be available. 2 of each card can be found within the central card deck. The central card deck shall shared between both players.

4.Rule: 1 type of Faction card and 1 type of Class card will be randomly prohibited from being used after each new match-up has commenced. These cards will not be available throughout the whole duration of that match.

5.Rule: All heroes will possess Health, Attack Rating and Defense Rating attributes. Hero levels will vary from 3 to 9. The higher a hero's level, the higher their attributes will be.

6.Rule: Players can choose to fight competitively against similarly ranked players or spar with their guildmates and friends.

7.Rule: At the start of battles, a coin will be tossed to determine which player gets to pick the first card. Afterwards, the player and the opponent shall both respectively receive 2 hero cards; a level 4 and a level 5 hero.

8.Rule: Both players will then select 1 card from the 4 cards placed in the middle during their turn, with the player that won the coin toss selecting the first card.

9.Rule: Once the player has made a selection, their opponent will then pick a card. Meanwhile, any remaining, unselected cards will all be upgraded by 1 level.

10.Rule: Unselected cards can be upgraded 3 times, if an unselected card is upgraded for a 4th time, it will be automatically destroyed.

11.Rule: Before making a card selection, if there are fewer than 4 selectable cards, random cards will be generated to bring the number of cards up to 4.

12.Rule: If an identical card is selected, the two cards will be combined, resulting in an upgraded card with the sum level of both cards combined, but cannot exceed the maximum level of 9.

13.Rule: All relic cards will automatically take effect in battles.

14.Rule: When there are 3 or more heroes of the same faction or hero class in a formation, they will all receive a special Union bonus that will take effect during battles.

15.Rule: Both players are able to view their opponent's cards and what choices they have made.

16.Rule: Once each player has made 8 card selections, the battle preparation stage will commence.

17.Rule: During the battle preparation phase, heroes selected for battles shall appear on the left side of the battlefield. However, once a battle begins, a player's heroes may enter from the right side of the battlefield as a result of the system's matchmaking process.

18.Rule: Activatable Battle Effects: Relic Card Effects, Factional Advantages, Union Bonuses for certain factions or hero classes.

19.Rule: During the event, players can claim resource rewards after each complete match-up, which is limited to 20 times.

20.Rule: Players can gain additional rewards after completing a certain number of match-ups. These additional rewards will be gradually unlocked over time. Players can see reward details and claim them from the main event page.

21.Rule: Sparring with friends and guildmates does not affect a player's leaderboard points and does not grant any rewards.

22.Rule: If the battle timer reaches zero without a definitive winner, the side with the most surviving heroes still on the battlefield will claim victory. If the number of heroes on either side are equal, the side with the highest combined percentage of health remaining will claim victory.

1.Title: Snowbound Riches
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: Complete all quests to acquire the Celestial hero Alna - The Frozen Mother.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard points can be obtained by occupying hunting camps, completing hunting challenges, challenging gate bosses, killing Adrax, and going AFK.

2.Rule: Only the highest recorded points throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: When a season ends, players can claim individual leaderboard rewards that are based upon the highest points reached out of every individual hunt they participated in. If a player participated in multiple hunts, only the hunt with the highest score will be ranked on the leaderboard.

4.Rule: Players that reach designated ranks shall receive corresponding Fortune Chests, Honorable Rewards and Medal Rewards (excludes spectators). Rewards will not be issued during test seasons.

5.Rule: Rewards shall be based on the player with the highest leaderboard ranking if there are two or more players belonging to the same squad which have the same number of points.

2.Rule: Diamonds shall only be deducted if the specified number of attempts set have been reached. If automatic battles are halted before the number of attempts you set have been reached, only the diamonds for battles that were reached shall be deducted.
