1.Title: Reinforcements
1.Rule: Players are able to select or change trial heroes while the 'Reinforcements' event is running.

2.Rule: Once a trial hero has been selected, players will be unable to modify their choice for free for 48 hours.

3.Rule: Players can spend 500 diamonds to swap trial heroes before the 48 hour cooldown period has ended. Once a hero has been successfully swapped, the cooldown period shall then be reset again to 48 hours.

4.Rule: Trial heroes can only be test played and do not belong the player. Heroes' Ascension tiers displayed within the hero selection list represent their actual tiers.

5.Rule: Once the Trial Period is over, the Hero will automatically be removed.

6.Rule: Trial Heroes' levels, tiers, gear and signature items acquired will be determined by the heroes currently owned by the player. Trial Heroes cannot be upgraded, neither can their gear be improved or changed.

7.Rule: Trial heroes cannot enter the Inn and can only make use of certain furniture bonuses, of which those bonuses will be decided by the furniture attributes of the hero currently owned by the player.

1.Title: Customizable Bundles
1.Rule: After the event has started, players may change their hero selection and preview each hero's corresponding Customizable Bundle.

2.Rule: On the hero selection page, each hero's tier corresponds to the tier of the hero which is already owned by the player. Heroes that a player does not possess will be displayed as Elite tier.

3.Rule: Once a player has locked in their hero selection they will be unable to modify their choice. Simultaneously, a portion of the hero's bundles will be unlocked according to the selected hero's Ascension tier.

4.Rule: During the event, players can unlock different bundles by acquiring certain heroes, as well as by ascending their tiers. The tier for a hero is based on the highest tier that they have previously achieved.

1.Title: Heart's Desires
1.Rule: Players may exchange Heart's Desires for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can earn tons of Heart's Desires from daily quests, Fiery Days and the Fields of Ice.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

10.Rule: Remaining Heart's Desires will be recalled for 40k Gold per item once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Phoenix Flowers
1.Rule: You can send gifts to other players via their "Player Info" page during the event.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined by the total amount of "Phoenix Flowers" players receive during the event. Players will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition Spring Spree frame, which is determined by their final leaderboard ranking. Frames shall be sent to the player's inbox at the end of the event.

3.Rule: Players that reach Gold division during the Legends' Challenger Tournament can obtain Phoenix Flowers.

4.Rule: Players will get extra Phoenix Flowers when they buy Heart's Desires from the Merchant's page.

1.Title: Phoenix's Calling
1.Rule: Rankings will be recorded everyday at 01:00, 09:00 and 17:00 UTC while the event is underway.

2.Rule: The amount of rewards received by a player is based upon their highest daily ranking received (out of three daily ranks), and will be sent to players via the in-game mailbox. Players that reach Gold division will be sent Phoenix Flowers.

3.Rule: Players that have still not opened the Legends' Challenger Tournament feature will still receive a small quantity of rewards via their mailbox.

4.Rule: During the Legends' Challenger Tournament, all heroes will start with a hero level of 360. A hero's overall level when fighting within the Legends' Challenger Tournament may then be increased based upon their own base level. Battles within the Legends' Challenger Tournament will no longer display player Combat Ratings.

1.Title: Hunting Challenge
1.Rule: Hunting challenges will consume Challenge Seals; these can be obtained by increasing the hunting squad's level, or through gifts between hunting squad members.

2.Rule: Damage will accumulate progress for the corresponding treasure chest. When the specified progress is completed, all members of the hunting squad will obtain 1 treasure chest.

3.Rule: Chest rewards include Hero Awakening Runes, Loot and Hunter Marks; the higher the difficulty, the better the rewards.

4.Rule: After a beast is killed, wait a while, and a more challenging beast will spawn in another area of the map.

5.Rule: The beasts on the hunting grounds are very powerful, and each beast is unique. The members of the hunting squad will need to cooperate with each other and carefully select their opponents in order to gain advantages in battle.

1.Title: The Hunting Fields
1.Rule: You will play as five-man hunting squads in co-op instances, each instance lasting 7 days, with the last day as Quiet Time; during Quiet Time, all Camp resources and Stamina recovery will be suspended.

2.Rule: The actual duration of the season will depend on each event's rules. Specific open activities. During the event, you can enter The Hunting Fields as a hunting squad member or a support role.

3.Rule: Players have 2 Challenge Attempts by default, and will gain additional Challenge Attempts based on their VIP level. A total of 2 single Challenge Attempts can be used per season, any remaining additional Challenge Attempts can be used if the player decides to abandon a hunt in order to begin a new hunt. There are no attempt limitations for spectating battles.

4.Rule: Members of the hunting squad can participate in the battle through individual registration or squad registration. When you've reached the required number of people, the instance will start.

5.Rule: Support members can join in on instances. They will not participate in actual battles, but can provide tactical assistance and morale support to hunting squad members.

6.Rule: Instances make use of the "Martial Rating" system, and every hero's base level will be set to 360. A hero's level may be increased by a number that is based upon their own level.

7.Rule: There are 5 factions in the instance. Solo matching will give you a selection of multiple desired factions, but each member of the hunting squad can only enter the instance with heroes of the faction that they were successfully matched with along with their corresponding reinforcement heroes. Players cannot use any other heroes.

8.Rule: You can get Hunter Marks, Loot, and Hero Awakening Runes by occupying Hunting Camps, exploring Den of Bones, completing Hunting Challenges, from AFK rewards, challenging Gate Bosses, or by purchasing them at the Black Bone Market; these resources can be used to improve the Combat Rating of your heroes within the instance.

9.Rule: Members of the hunting squad can exchange items and share resources through the shared bags; this can improve the squad's strength. Please place all items that you don't need in the shared bags for your companions to use, and enhance your overall combat effectiveness.

10.Rule: Occupying hunting camps, challenging gate bosses, and challenging Adrax will consume Hero stamina. Heroes within Troops will automatically recover stamina.

11.Rule: Hunting challenges will consume Challenge Seals; these can be obtained by increasing the hunting squad's level, purchased from the Black Bone Market, or by exchanging gifts between hunting squad members.

12.Rule: Increasing the hunting squad's level grants better rewards, and will require the joint efforts of all squad members.

13.Rule: Supporting members will also get a corresponding reward when their hunting squad levels up.

14.Rule: During a season, each player can only receive one hunting squad level up reward. If you have previously received a designated level reward as a support member, the level up reward will be calculated and issued after deducting the part that you received as a support role.

15.Rule: Reach the designated hunting squad level to sweep wilderness tiles of the designated level. This will no longer consume stamina, and will give you 3 stars automatically.

16.Rule: In the instance, occupied wilderness tiles are counted as shared land for the hunting squad, and will not affect the occupation limit, and cannot be abandoned.

1.Title: Revert Heroes
1.Rule: Designated heroes can be reverted during the event.

2.Rule: Reverting a hero returns all of the resources spent on it, and a Hero Choice Chest of the corresponding hero's faction will be produced.

3.Rule: Gear and Artifacts are returned to the player's bag when a hero is reverted. If a hero has T3 or higher gear, it will be reverted back to its corresponding T2 form along with the resources used to strengthen it.

4.Rule: All Gold, Experience and Hero's Essence that was used on a hero is returned to the player when the hero is reverted.

5.Rule: According to the hero's faction and Ascension tier, a corresponding number of Hero Choice Chests shall be returned to the player when a hero is reverted.

6.Rule: According to the hero's Signature Item level, a corresponding number of Primordial Emblems, Amplifying Emblems and Emblem Choice Chests which were consumed by the hero shall be returned when the hero is reverted.

7.Rule: When reverting a hero, their Oak Inn room shall be deleted, and any Mythic Furniture shall be returned to the player in the form of Custom Mythic Furniture Scrolls. Legendary, Elite and Rare Furniture will be returned to the player's Storeroom.

8.Rule: When a hero is reverted, their Eternal Engravings will be reset, and all Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores that were consumed to upgrade it will be returned.

1.Title: Garrisoned Mercenaries
1.Rule: Players can send mercenary hiring requests to their friends or their guild mates. If they approve the request, the corresponding heroes may be hired out to the requesting player.

2.Rule: Players can loan out one mercenary hero to a maximum of 5 friends, with each loan period lasting 30 days. Players can re-apply to hire a hero when there are 30 or fewer days remaining.

3.Rule: An expense of 100 Dimensional Stones are required each time a player wants to hire a hero. After a particular hero is hired six times, they will no longer require Dimensional Stones.

4.Rule: Dimensional Stones can be exchanged at the top right of the page. A maximum of 200 Dimensional Stones can be exchanged per calendar month.

5.Rule: Players can simultaneously send up to 5 hiring applications to their friends or guild mates per specific hero.

6.Rule: All hired heroes are level 1 and have an Ascension tier of Elite. Hired heroes will need to be leveled up or soul-fused. Once the loan period has ended, the degree of progression reached with the hired hero will not be affected, however, they will not be able to be used in battle until players hire them again.

7.Rule: While on loan, 'Garrisoned Mercenaries' are viewed as a player's own hero and suffer no limitations when used in battles.

8.Rule: Players cannot hire heroes from friends that have not been online in the past 7 days.

9.Rule: Each time a player loans out a hero, they shall receive 40 Companion Points. A maximum of 200 Companion Points can be attained per month by loaning out heroes. The Companion Point maximum is reset with the start of each new calendar month.

10.Rule: A hired hero that reaches Ascended tier can also increase the max level of the Resonating Crystal, which will still persist even after the hero's loan period is over.

1.Title: Support Roles
1.Rule: Each Hunting Squad has 10 support positions. Players that are eligible for the Hunting Fields can apply for these positions.

2.Rule: Members of the hunting squad will have 2 spots for support roles within 48 hours of the start of the instance, and will no longer have this restriction after 48 hours.

3.Rule: Members of the hunting squad can change settings to allow supporters to join without verification, but this will only affect their own supporter spots.

4.Rule: Supporters can still claim rewards without needing to fight.

1.Title: Warrior's Glory
1.Rule: Players may exchange Beastly Pendants for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire lots of Beastly Pendants from the Battle of Blood event.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

10.Rule: Excess Beastly Pendant will be recalled for 24k Gold per pendant once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Medal Rewards
1.Rule: Players with a top 20 ranking during the current round's result calculation phase can view their Medal acquisition progress on this page.

2.Rule: Medal rewards are calculated once per week. Results are calculated every Monday at UTC 04:00:00. Medals will be sent via mail.

3.Rule: Players with a Top 10 Stage Progression ranking will be rewarded with a limited-time Honorable Rewards Medal. The player ranked in first place will be rewarded with a Honorable Rewards Medal of distinction.

4.Rule: Stage Progression Medals are valid for up to 8 days as of the result calculation period. Please ensure Medals are equipped in a timely manner.

1.Title: Medal Rewards
1.Rule: Players that make it to the group stage are able to check their Medal acquisition progress on this page.

2.Rule: Legends' Championship Round of 64 competitors, Quarter Finalists and Champions will be rewarded with rare Honorable Rewards Medal.

3.Rule: Medals will be sent to players' mailboxes as they progress through the Legends' Championship.

4.Rule: Legends' Championship Medals are valid for up to 15 days as of the result calculation period. Please ensure Medals are equipped in a timely manner.

1.Title: Medal Rewards
1.Rule: Players that enter the Fabled Realm are able to check their Medal acquisition progress on this page.

2.Rule: Players with a Top 50% Fabled Realm ranking will be rewarded with a rare Honorable Rewards Medal. Player ranked in the Top 100 and Top 10 will be rewarded with Honorable Rewards Medals of distinction.

3.Rule: Medals will be sent to players' mailboxes during the Twisted Realm result calculation period.

4.Rule: Fabled Realm Medals are valid for up to 3 days as of the result calculation period. Please ensure Medals are equipped in a timely manner.

1.Title: Phantom Bosses
1.Rule: The health of Phantom Bosses is determined by the quantity of active players on all servers. After a certain amount of damage has been dealt against the Phantom Bosses, all players that participated in battles can claim Chest rewards. Players who do not claim their Chest rewards will receive them via their mailbox after the event has concluded.

2.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

3.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

4.Rule: Players are able to challenge bosses 5 times for free daily, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may refresh boss challenges up to a maximum of 10 times. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

5.Rule: Only one mercenary may be used per battle against Phantom Bosses however, the number of times that a mercenary can be used is unlimited.

6.Rule: Phantom Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded daily damage dealt against Phantom Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

8.Rule: Players will receive Gold for challenging Phantom Bosses, and will receive additional Gold for exceeding their daily damage record.

1.Title: Thicket Lodge
1.Rule: Relics obtained from the Thicket Lodge will only take effect against Phantom Bosses.

2.Rule: Purchased Relics can be sold back to the Thicket Lodge via the Relic Bag for the full amount of Acorns spent, which can then be which can then be used to purchase different Relics.

1.Title: Phantom Thicket Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Phantom Thicket Leaderboard is a leaderboard that ranks the highest damage each player deals per day to the Phantom Bosses.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

4.Rule: Phantom Thicket Leaderboard guild rewards will be gradually sent out via the mailbox once the daily rankings have been calculated.

1.Title: The Forest Escapade
1.Rule: Players can acquire an abundance of rewards within the Forest Escapade during the event period.

2.Rule: A player's own heroes and enemy heroes shall all start each new battle with full health and zero energy.

3.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

4.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

5.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

1.Title: A Musical Tribute
1.Rule: During the event, players are able to claim up to 7 daily login rewards.

2.Rule: Players can unlock the corresponding Musical Note Clues after claiming login rewards for the day. By following the clues, players can try to find the corresponding Musical Notes hidden throughout the game, and then illuminate them at event page.

3.Rule: In addition to daily login rewards, a final reward chest will be unlocked on day 14 of the event. Players can unlock this reward chest in advance by illuminating Musical Notes.

4.Rule: Each time a player illuminates a Musical Note, the progress of the reward chest will be advanced by 1 day. If a player illuminates all 7 Musical Notes, they can claim the reward chest by day 7 of the event at the earliest.

5.Rule: Players can tap on each illuminated Musical Note to play its corresponding tune. When players illuminate all of the Musical Notes and claim the final reward chest, the complete musical score can be played.

1.Title: Swap Scrolls
1.Rule: Used to swap heroes' Hero Level, Ascended Tier, Signature Item and Mythic Furniture with one another.

2.Rule: Gear worn by heroes as well as non-Mythic Furniture will not be swapped.

3.Rule: Swapped heroes will be removed from the Resonating Crystal. Heroes' Ascension Tiers may be altered as a result of hero swapping, which may result in these heroes being removed from certain in-game systems which include, but are not limited to the following systems: Abyssal Expedition, The Oak Inn, Legends' Championship.

4.Rule: Celestial, Hypogean, Dimensional and Awakened heroes cannot be swapped. Non-Ascended Tier Heroes cannot be swapped. Newly released heroes cannot be swapped within their first 60 days. Heroes that have their Engraving level increased cannot be swapped.

1.Title: Bounty Chest
1.Rule: Gifted by the Bounty Hunters Association. Rewards granted are based on stage progression.

1.Title: Event Rules
1.Rule: Players can claim and trial Dolly's "True Companion" skin for 7 days during this event.

2.Rule: During this event, players can permanently acquire Dolly's "True Companion" skin by playing The Forest Escapade.

3.Rule: Players can choose the "True Companion" skin from the Noble Tavern's 'Skins' page.

1.Title: Fortune Chests
1.Rule: By meeting certain standards within differing game modes, players can win Fortune Chests for all of their guild members.

2.Rule: Fortune Chest loot will be divided into 60 portions of random varying amounts. All players that joined the Guild before any Fortune Chests were received may claim one portion for themselves.

3.Rule: Each Fortune Chest may only be claimed within a certain time frame, and will disappear once it expires.

1.Title: Request Help
1.Rule: Players have 5 opportunities per day to ask their friends or guild mates for help earning 3 stars for particular stages.

2.Rule: Players can only seek help from friends or guild mates which have already earned 3 stars for a particular stage.

3.Rule: After receiving help, the stage in question will have 3 stars, and the player shall receive rewards for achieving 3 stars.

1.Title: Help
1.Rule: Each time a player earns 3 stars for a stage, they will receive 3 "Quick Help" attempts. Each stage's "Quick Help" attempts are counted separately.

2.Rule: Players can use a "Quick Help" attempt to help a friend or guild mate immediately complete a stage, allowing them to receive 3-Star completion rewards.

3.Rule: When all of a player's "Quick Help" attempts have been used, they can choose to manually help their friend or guild mate complete the stage, if they successfully complete the stage by achieving 3 Stars, their friend will also pass this stage.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: Magic Tickets can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Players can exchange Poe Coins and Salon Music Set skins once the Oak Inn is unlocked.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

11.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Chasmic Altar
1.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

2.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

3.Rule: During the event, all heroes' Signature Items, Dura's Virtues and Oak Inn Furniture bonuses will be retained. Attributes and skill effects will be added in according to the player's actual circumstance.

4.Rule: Artifact and Hero Union attribute bonuses will not be retained during the event.

5.Rule: The Devourer's HP is determined by the number of active players across all servers.

6.Rule: Aside from its skills, The Devourer possesses extra effects that change every time it loses 25% of its health.

7.Rule: Players may challenge The Devourer 5 times per day for free, and may then spend Diamonds to reset challenge attempts for up to 10 times. 1 Challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters battle.

8.Rule: The highest amount of damage a player deals to The Devourer every day will be converted into Contribution Points, and will count towards their leaderboard ranking. The daily rewards players receive are based on their final daily ranking.

9.Rule: Players can cleanse Corrupted Altars by battling against The Devourer. Cleansing the altars grants players Purifying Power, which reduces the difficulty of Campaign stages.

1.Title: Chasmic Altar
1.Rule: The highest amount of damage a player deals to The Devourer every day will be converted into Contribution Points, which will then be permanently recorded on the leaderboard.

2.Rule: The daily top 10 ranked players of each server will be awarded the title 'Pioneer' and a Limited-Time Medal (2 days) as rewards.

3.Rule: Besides 'Pioneer', players will be divided into Diamond, Gold, Silver, Bronze divisions. Gold, Silver and Bronze divisions shall each be respectively split into 2 smaller sub-divisions.

4.Rule: Based on a player's daily division ranking, players are able to acquire Essence, Hero EXP, Gold and a Common Hero Scroll etc. Rewards will be calculated daily at 00:00 UTC.

5.Rule: Based on final Contribution Point rankings across all servers, the Top 10 players will receive a limited edition avatar frame. The top 1000 players will receive a Limited-Time Medal (6 months) when the event ends.

6.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized when the final leaderboard rankings are calculated.

1.Title: Chasmic Altar
1.Rule: The Devourer is invading Esperia. Arden has sensed the impending danger, and has called upon all living beings to band together in order to protect the realm.

2.Rule: The Devourer's HP is determined by the number of active players across all servers.

3.Rule: Players can cleanse the Corrupted Altars within the Chasmic Altar by assailing The Devourer.

4.Rule: Cleansing the Corrupted Altars helps reduce the difficulty of Campaign stages across all servers by granting players Purifying Power. Players can gain more Purifying Power by cleansing more Altars.

5.Rule: With the help of Purifying Power, Campaign stage enemies' levels can be reduced according to how many players have completed it. The more players which have completed a certain stage will further reduce its difficulty.

6.Rule: Damage dealt to The Devourer will be converted into Contribution Points, which will then be permanently recorded on the leaderboard.

7.Rule: Players who attack The Devourer will get different rewards based on their Contribution Point ranking.

1.Title: The Conch Collector
1.Rule: Players may exchange Blood Pearls for various rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can earn lots of Blood Pearls from daily quests.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

11.Rule: Surplus Blood Pearls will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Siren's Song
1.Rule: During the event period, Players can earn lots of Blood Pearls from daily quests.

2.Rule: Players can obtain lots of "Siren Chests" as rewards, based on the total quantity of Blood Pearls they have cumulatively acquired.

3.Rule: Blood Pearls can be exchanged for different types of rewards. Exchanging Blood Pearls will not affect the total quantity of Blood Pearls the player has cumulatively acquired.

4.Rule: Unlock all Amethyst Chests to additionally receive the following rewards: Limited Edition Emojis - Siren's Song Emojis; Limited Edition Chat Bubble - Siren's Wave; Limited Edition Animated Avatar Frame - Siren's Surge.

1.Title: Abandoning Hunts
1.Rule: Squad members can initiate a vote to abandon their current hunt 48hrs after it has begun, and if there are still more than 24hrs of hunting time remaining.

2.Rule: Members that have acquired no less than 3000 points within last 2 days of the hunt can vote 'For' or 'Against' to abandoning a hunt. Those with fewer points than 3000 points will automatically vote 'For' by default.

3.Rule: The player who initiates the vote will vote 'For' by default. Votes have a duration of 24 hours, after which time all remaining members who can vote but did not will have their votes regarded as 'Against' votes by default.

4.Rule: If enough votes have already been received to decide the final outcome of the vote, its results will immediately be released.

5.Rule: The minimum number of votes required to pass a vote is 4 votes.

6.Rule: Once a hunt has been abandoned, any Hunting Fields challenge attempts used in order to commence the hunt shall not be returned to players.

1.Title: Medal Rewards
1.Rule: Players that reach a designated rank on the final Hunting Fields leaderboard will be rewarded with rare Honorable Rewards Medals.

2.Rule: Medals will be sent to players' mailboxes at the end of each season.

3.Rule: The Hunting Fields Medals are valid for up to 20 days as of the result calculation period. Please ensure Medals are equipped in a timely manner.

1.Title: Demonbreaker
1.Rule: Demonbreakers can be used within the Dismal Maze Mode of the Arcane Labyrinth to reduce Dismal Luck effects, subsequently reducing the difficulty of battles.

2.Rule: After using a Demonbreaker, players can select an active Dismal Luck effect that they wish to dispel.

3.Rule: After using the Demonbreaker, the base amount of Gold and Experience produced by remaining tiles will be reduced by 50%.

4.Rule: The Demonbreaker can only be used once per Dismal Maze challenge.

5.Rule: Players can acquire Demonbreakers by requesting help with the 'Mutual Assistance' function.

6.Rule: Once a player possesses 3 or more Demonbreakers they will be unable to request assistance from other players.

1.Title: Request Help
1.Rule: Players can seek help from friends or guildmates that have already become Dismal Masters. A maximum of 10 help requests can be simultaneously sent to Dismal Masters.

2.Rule: Once a help request has been successfully accepted, the requesting players will receive a Demonbreaker. Using the Demonbreaker will allow the player to dispel 1 active Dismal Luck effect, reducing the overall difficulty of the Dismal Maze.

3.Rule: A maximum of 3 Demonbreakers can be held at one time. Once the maximum limit of Demonbreakers has been accumulated, players will not be able to request more help from other players.

4.Rule: You can only ask the same player for help once a day.

1.Title: Help
1.Rule: When a player has completed Dismal Master challenges, they shall be regarded as a Dismal Master, which will give them the power to help other players. Every time a Dismal Master challenge has been completed, the Dismal Master will have 5 chances to help other players.

2.Rule: Dismal Masters can use their chances to help other players by gifting them Demonbreakers that will assist them with progress through Dismal Maze.

3.Rule: A maximum of 10 help requests can be accumulated. Once the max number of requests has been reached, requests will stop being accumulated.

1.Title: The Dreamy Garden
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Celestial Sanctum
1.Rule: You may only use Celestial heroes. You will be rewarded for defeating the enemies on each floor, and thus permitted to ascend to the next floor.

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Infernal Fortress
1.Rule: You may only use Hypogean heroes. You will be rewarded for defeating the enemies on each floor, and thus permitted to ascend to the next floor.

2.Rule: If you are having difficulty completing a stage, you can try re-arranging your hero formation or checking the replays of other players to gauge the minimum Combat Rating required to pass the stage.

1.Title: Warrior's Way
1.Rule:
The Warrior's Way event shall be available 
during the Battle of Blood event, and will last for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can complete Battle of Blood quests for Valiant Merits. The more Valiant Merits you acquire, the more rewards you can unlock.

3.Rule: Rewards will be multiplied 5 times when you purchase and unlock the Warrior's Way Splendorous Rewards. Not only will the rewards be multiplied, but players shall also receive a large quantity of Valiant Merits.

4.Rule: Any Warrior's Way rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Warrior's Way ends.

1.Title: Request Help
1.Rule: During the Battle of Blood event, players can make use of the Mutual Assistance function to request help from other players who are capable of giving assistance. Once assistance has been successfully received, the player will then receive a Medal of Might.

2.Rule: Players can use a certain quantity of Medals of Might to complete specific Battle of Blood quests automatically.

3.Rule: During the event players can acquire up to 3 Medals of Might per day, and a maximum of 6 Medals over the whole duration of the event.

4.Rule: A player that has already successfully assisted you cannot assist you more than once per day.

1.Title: Help
1.Rule: During the Battle of Blood event, the number of times a player can offer assistance is based upon their server rank. The number of assistance chances a player receives is issued according to the event rules.

2.Rule: Players on the server with ranks 1-5, 6-15, 16-50 will respectively receive 5/3/1 chances to assist other players.

3.Rule: Players that have assistance chances may give other players whom are requesting assistance a Medal of Might, in order to assist them complete Battle of Blood quests.

1.Title: Relic Shop
1.Rule: Consume Acorns in order to purchase Relics from the Relic Shop

2.Rule: Purchased Relics can be sold back to the Thicket Lodge via the Relic Bag for the full amount of Acorns spent, which can then be which can then be used to purchase different Relics.

1.Title: Exchanging Dimensionals
1.Rule: Players can use the designated currency type during the limited-time exchange event in exchange for Dimensional Heroes.

2.Rule: The limited-time exchange event will be displayed in game prior to the event's official start in order to allow players to begin storing the designated exchangeable currency in advance. Once the event officially starts, players will have 7 days to exchange Soulstones using designated exchangeable currency.

3.Rule: During the limited-time exchange event, players may only exchange 60 Dimensional Hero Soulstones one time to directly summon a Dimensional hero. If a player possesses fewer than 60 Soulstones, then the exchange cannot take place.

1.Title: Exchanging Dimensionals
1.Rule: Players can use the designated currency type during the limited-time exchange event in exchange for Dimensional Hero Soulstones.

2.Rule: The limited-time exchange event will be displayed in game prior to the event's official start in order to allow players to begin storing the designated exchangeable currency in advance. Once the event officially starts, players will have 7 days to exchange Soulstones using designated exchangeable currency.

3.Rule: During the limited-time exchange event, you can only exchange 60 Dimensional Hero Soulstones each time. If you have fewer than 60 Soulstones, you cannot exchange them. Once Soulstones have been successfully exchanged, you can summon the Dimensional Hero from your Bag.

4.Rule: Once Merlin's limited-time exchange event has ended, players that do not yet possess Merlin may still proceed to the Challenger Store (Complete Stage 9-20 to unlock it) to exchange Merlin's Soulstones. 250,000 Gladiator Coins can be exchanged for 15 of Merlin's Soulstones per time. Players can continue exchanging more Gladiator Coins for Soulstones after the Challenger Store is refreshed.

1.Title: Fight of Fates
1.Rule: When entering the event for the first time, players will be given a differing number of initial points, which is based upon the player's current campaign progress.

2.Rule: During this event players can choose which cards are used in their deck of cards. Each deck can comprise of 5 hero cards and 6 effect cards.

3.Rule: In this event, players can only choose from heroes that they already own, and that are higher than Legendary Tier (excludes Legendary). Dimensional heroes are not subject to hero tier rating restrictions, and any Dimensional hero the player possesses may be used. Some heroes are temporarily unavailable for this event.

4.Rule: There shall be 10 additional heroes available for all players to choose from, which are not impeded by any restrictions.

5.Rule: One of the five heroes shall be selected as a Vanguard Hero. The Vanguard Hero will automatically enter the battlefield first when a battle commences. When a Hero Card's cooldown time has ended, it can then be freely placed on the battlefield.

6.Rule: During battles, Gems of Dawn Energy will gradually increase over time. The maximum Energy points a Gem of Dawn may have is 9.

7.Rule: Players can consume Gems of Dawn Energy to cast a variety of different effects with their Skill Cards.

8.Rule: Players can choose to fight competitively against similarly ranked players or spar with their guildmates and friends.

9.Rule: All heroes used are level 360, 5-Star Ascended heroes.

10.Rule: All heroes will by default equip Mythic T4 equipment without bonus attributes.

11.Rule: All heroes are equipped with a level 30 Signature Item by default.

12.Rule: All heroes are equipped with 9 pieces of Mythic Exclusive Furniture.

13.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Elder Tree attributes and skills by default.

14.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Engravings by default.

15.Rule: Heroes do not make use of any Artifact attribute bonuses or Union Attribute Bonuses.

16.Rule: Sparring with friends and guildmates does not affect a player's leaderboard points and does not grant any rewards.

17.Rule: If a battle times out, the player with the most remaining heroes shall be victorious. If both sides have the same number of heroes left, the player with the highest percentage of total health of heroes will win.

18.Rule: Players can complete daily requests to acquire rewards. By completing more quests during the event, players can acquire even greater rewards.

19.Rule: Players that obtain a top 1000 rank on leaderboard shall win a Fortune Chest that contains large amount of Diamonds. Guilds can obtain a maximum of one Fortune Chest. If multiple guild members obtain a rank, the Fortune Chest will be based upon the highest ranked member.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: Magic Tickets can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

12.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Eternal Engravings
1.Rule: Once players have reached Chapter 22, the Eternal Engravings will become available to their 1-Star Ascended heroes.

2.Rule: Each hero has their own exclusive Eternal Engravings monolith. The Eternal Engravings are based on each hero's class and faction, and will vary between heroes.

3.Rule: Eternal Engraving monoliths are composed of 3 Major Glyphs and 5 Minor Glyphs. Players can consume Elemental Shards or Elemental Cores to raise the levels of Glyphs to strengthen their hero's attributes and reveal more of the Eternal Engraving monolith.

4.Rule: Glyphs on the Eternal Engraving Monolith must be activated in a specific order. Enhancing Glyphs that are already active will not be affected by this order.

5.Rule: The Eternal Engraving level is the sum of all Glyphs combined. Raising the Eternal Engraving level allows for skills to be unlocked. Furthermore, raising a hero's Ascension Tier allows for additional skill effects to be unlocked.

6.Rule: After reaching an Eternal Engraving level of 80, heroes shall be able to acquire the special skill called "Endeavor" in the Arena of Heroes, Legends' Challenger Tournament and Legends' Championship etc. PVP modes.

7.Rule: The fixed value of Health, Attack and Defense attributes that are provided by The Elder Tree and Dura's Virtues are increased based on a hero's Eternal Engravings bonuses.

1.Title: Island of Solitude
1.Rule: Acquire an abundance of rewards by exploring the Island of Solitude during the event period.

2.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

3.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

4.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

5.Rule: Some actions on the Island of Solitude will expend Heroes' Stamina. Heroes within Troops will automatically recover stamina.

6.Rule: Swapping heroes within 'Troops' will not expend any Stamina.

7.Rule: After each battle on the Island of Solitude has been concluded, the health and energy levels for enemies will not be reset.

8.Rule: Surplus items will be automatically refunded after the event according to the price stated in the description.

1.Title: Hidden Danger
1.Rule: Players that battle against Bosses and that activate the Bosses' "Despair" state can claim a Reward Chest. Players that unlock but do not claim the Reward Chest will receive it in their mailbox when the bosses disappear.

2.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

3.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

4.Rule: When fighting against Bosses, food can be used to grant heroes buffs.

5.Rule: Players are able to challenge Bosses 5 times for free daily. 1 Challenge Attempt shall be deducted after every battle, as well as food.

6.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Bosses.

7.Rule: Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

8.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

9.Rule: Players will receive Gold for challenging Bosses, and will receive additional Gold for exceeding their highest damage record.

10.Rule: Fortune Chests shall be calculated and sent to players' mailboxes after each Boss disappears.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each boss.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Island Survival
1.Rule: The Island Survival event shall be available during the Island of Solitude event, and will last for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can complete Island of Solitude quests to obtain Survival Tokens. Obtaining more Survival Tokens unlocks greater rewards.

3.Rule: Players who have unlocked Island Survival that have not claimed all of their rewards 4 days prior to the end of the event can purchase Survival Tokens with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Island Survival to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any Island Survival rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when Island Survival ends.

1.Title: Isle of Gold
1.Rule: The Isle of Gold event will run for a total of 14 days. Players can build upon their own islands and reap an abundance of resources.

2.Rule: Players can roll dice to move across their own islands. After rolling the dice, players can walk the corresponding amount of steps shown on the dice, and build structures on the adjoining tiles.

3.Rule: Players shall receive 6 dice rolls every 12 hours, but no more than a total of 30 dice rolls can be accumulated.

4.Rule: Players may construct up to 4 Resource buildings, from which they can obtain the resources they want.

5.Rule: Players may construct up to 14 Defensive buildings to help defend against other players pillaging their island.

6.Rule: Building upon the island provides Island Experience, which can be used to increase the island's Island Level, unlocking the corresponding reward in the process.

7.Rule: Functional Buildings cannot be upgraded, however, special rewards can be acquired from these buildings when a player lands upon them.

1.Title: Construction
1.Rule: After each roll of the dice, the player can only select one adjoining tile to build upon once.

2.Rule: Players can construct 2 types of buildings: Resource Buildings and Defensive Buildings. 4 different types of Resource Buildings can be constructed, as well as 14 Defensive type buildings. Each type of Resource Building may only be constructed once.

3.Rule: Players may upgrade and rebuild buildings.

4.Rule: Buildings' effects grow stronger, the higher their levels increase. Reaching levels 5 and 10 will unlock additional effects.

1.Title: Defensive Building
1.Rule: Defensive buildings are separated into three types: Defense Towers, Stones and Flowers.

2.Rule: Defense Towers are able to strengthen nearby buildings, making Resource buildings harder to pillage.

3.Rule: Stones have the skill to curse enemies when stepped upon, weakening their pillaging efforts.

4.Rule: Flowers have no defensive properties, but will increase the player's own heroes' Combat Ratings while they are pillaging other player's islands.

5.Rule: Defensive buildings cannot be destroyed.

1.Title: Assistance
1.Rule: Players can provide friends / guildmates with aid by garrisoning their own heroes in their friend's Resource buildings.

2.Rule: Players can create 3 teams with which they can help their allies. Players can also simultaneously place heroes that are already garrisoning their own buildings in their friends' buildings, but 1 hero may only be placed in 1 allied garrisoned formation at a time.

3.Rule: Players cannot garrison the same team to help the same ally more than once.

4.Rule: Players may dispatch a total of 6 teams to their allies, and can view these teams via their Log.

5.Rule: Players may withdraw heroes that are garrisoned on their allies islands, and can also remove teams placed in their own buildings by other players.

1.Title: Pillaging
1.Rule: Players have 2 chances a day to pillage other players. While out pillaging, even if a player does not enter their target's island, 1 pillaging chance will still be deducted.

2.Rule: Players have a total of 5 chances per day to refresh their pillaging target.

3.Rule: Once a player has confirmed their pillaging target, they shall be placed on the Shipyard tile on their target's island, and will move clockwise with every dice roll.

4.Rule: While pillaging a target, if a player lands on a tile that is adjacent to a Resource building, the building may be pillaged. If there are defensive forces garrisoned within the building, the player must first defeat them before claiming any resources.

5.Rule: If a player lands next to two Resource buildings, the player may pillage them successively, however, a hero may only participate in 1 battle.

6.Rule: While pillaging, if you successfully defeat the garrisoned defensive forces and pillage a resource building, you will receive resources equal to 4 hours worth of production. In addition, the pillaged resource building will be destroyed, ceasing its production for 1 hour.

7.Rule: When pillaging resources, the invader shall get additional pillaged resources depending on how much Morale they have.

8.Rule: When resources are pillaged, structures suffer additional losses based on the invader's Morale.

9.Rule: You can choose to pilfer and get 4 hours worth of production, but it will reduce your Morale by 1 point.

10.Rule: Players have 6 dice rolls per pillage. Once the dice has been rolled 6 times, the pillaging will automatically end.

1.Title: Resources
1.Rule: Resource buildings produce resources every hour. The quantity of resources produced by the building is determined by the player's campaign progression at the time of unlocking the Isle of Gold event.

2.Rule: Resource buildings may be pillaged by invading pillagers. If a Resource building is successfully pillaged, it will cease producing resources for 1 hour.

3.Rule: Players are able to garrison defensive forces within Resource buildings. Invading pillagers must first defeat the defensive forces before they are able to pillage the resources it has.

4.Rule: When resources are pillaged, structures suffer additional losses based on the invader's Morale.

1.Title: Take Your Pick
1.Rule: During the event, players will receive 1 chance to draw rewards when they log in each day. After returning players have input the invitation code they received from an already active player, both players shall receive 15 extra chances to draw rewards.

2.Rule: Rewards are randomly drawn from a reward pool after every draw. After drawing a total of 16 rewards, all rewards shall have been acquired.

3.Rule: Once all rewards have been received from the reward pool, the reward chest can be unlocked. If a player has used the invitation code function, they shall be able to receive the reward chest within 1 day.

4.Rule: Players may choose any 1 Celestial or Hypogean that is available from the reward chest.

5.Rule: Active players can send out 1 invitation code. Returning players can input a maximum of 5 invitation codes.

6.Rule: A maximum of 16 draws may be conducted, after which players will no longer be able to acquire any more draw chances.

7.Rule: Tapping "Share" will share the Returning Players event to social media. Players shall receive 100 Diamonds in the mail after successfully sharing the event.

8.Rule: Players that have not logged in within the past 15 days, or between July 17th - July 31st and have completed Chapter 10 are regarded as returning players.

9.Rule: If a player already has an active profile on their account, other profiles cannot be regarded as a "returning player" profile.

1.Title: Guild Trials
1.Rule: This event has a duration of 14 days. After the event has ended, players may still continue to test formations but shall not receive any rewards.

2.Rule: During Guild Trials, guild members' heroes that have reached Legendary+ may be used by all guild members.

3.Rule: Duplicate heroes cannot be used, only the hero with the highest Combat Rating within the guild can used.

4.Rule: Players that do not belong to a guild are unable to view Guild Trial Formations.

1.Title: Guild Trial Rankings
1.Rule: The leaderboard is divided into two stages, each lasting 7 days. Rankings from Stage 1 will not be reset when Stage 2 begins.

2.Rule: During Stage 1, players cannot view the formations used by other guilds. These become visible in Stage 2.

3.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are determined first by enemy level, then by the total time taken to defeat them, and finally by the order in which results were achieved.

4.Rule: The leaderboard only records each guild's highest-level kill. Members with lower records will not be listed.

5.Rule: Fortune Chests are awarded based on guild rankings at the end of Stage 1. No Fortune Chests are awarded after Stage 2.

6.Rule: Players can earn rewards by completing Arena of Trials quests, which unlock when stages are refreshed.

7.Rule: Guilds that reach Rank 1 in Stage 1 will appear within Bard Tales.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

1.Title: Abyssal Aid
1.Rule: During the event players can form small teams to participate in the Dismal Maze.

2.Rule: Each small team is comprised of 3 players. Once the team is full, the Maze event may commence.

3.Rule: Team members are able to share their Resonating Crystal heroes. Heroes that are Legendary+ can be shared by all team members. Duplicate heroes are not permitted, the hero with a level 30 Signature Item and 9 Mythic pieces of furniture will be prioritized for selection. Garrisoned heroes with fewer than 2 days remaining will not be entered into team formations.

4.Rule: When a player uses another member's hero, the hero shall retain their ascension tier, gear, Signature Item level, Oak Inn furniture level and Eternal Engraving level. The hero's level will be adjusted to match the user's own Resonating Crystal level.

5.Rule: If any member of the small team completes the Dismal Maze, members of their team may then use the "Quick Battle" function to quickly complete the maze and receive the maze rewards.

6.Rule: After joining a small team, reward bonuses for missing the Arcane Labyrinth will not be counted when rewards are calculated.

7.Rule: If a player within a small team has yet to enter the maze, and has not used the Sweep feature, the increased reward bonus will remain intact after they leave their small team.

8.Rule: If a member requests to leave their team after the maze event has started, they must first wait until the next round of the event has been refreshed before their request will take effect.

9.Rule: You cannot use the Demonbreaker within the Dismal Maze while forming a team.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances: knife juggling, fire juggling, a clown show, and puppetry. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free battle chances per day, and exiting during a battle will not deduct chances. Players can acquire additional reward chests for the first 2 battles of each new day, and may also spend Diamonds to purchase additional battle chances.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Cursed Realm
1.Rule: The Cursed Realm opens once every 7 days.

2.Rule: All heroes within the Cursed Realm have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Players may only use mercenaries, dimensional heroes and heroes which are within the Resonating Crystal.

4.Rule: Only one mercenary may be used per challenge within the Cursed Realm, however, the number of times that a mercenary can be used is unlimited.

5.Rule: Bosses and their Shadow Guards will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

6.Rule: Within each new Cursed Realm session, players are able to challenge bosses 10 times for free, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may challenge bosses a maximum of 199 times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

7.Rule: The final damage of each challenge is the total sum of the damage dealt to bosses as well as the five Shadow Guard teams.

8.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

9.Rule: If a player deals enough damage to reach a new level of Realm Mastery, they will receive a one-off reward.

10.Rule: Results for the Cursed Realm are calculated over 24 hours, during which time players cannot partake in battles.

11.Rule: Rewards for every Cursed Realm shall be gradually sent to players' inboxes at the end of each event.

1.Title: Cursed Glory Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Cursed Glory Leaderboard shows the Dream Ladder achievements of players across all servers.

2.Rule: Rankings are predominantly based upon the time that players acquire avatar frames. If players are equally ranked in terms of frame quantities, the player with the highest overall Combat Rating will claim the higher ranking.

3.Rule: The Cursed Glory Leaderboard only displays the top 100 players.

1.Title: Cursed Realm Leaderboard
1.Rule: Players are able to view the replay and formation of battles in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

2.Rule: The target damage for Legendary, Diamond and Gold divisions are related to the battle results of the previous session. Battle results here correspond to the battle results of the same boss from the previous session. When the leaderboards are dynamic, the top ranked players will enter the Legendary, Diamond and Gold ranks in turn.

3.Rule: If there are no players occupying the lower divisions of the leaderboard, then those divisions will not be viewable on the leaderboard.

4.Rule: Real-time rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

5.Rule: Individual Cursed Realm Leaderboard rewards will be gradually sent out via the mailbox once the season's rankings have been calculated.

6.Rule: Cursed Realm Region leaderboards will be subdivided in the same way as the "Legends' Championship". Players will be able to view rankings for the whole server or their specific region from the overall Leaderboard.

7.Rule: Players who have earned Cursed Realm Plates can choose to either equip their Region Plate or All-Servers Plate.

1.Title: Calling Winds
1.Rule: During the event, players are able to claim up to 7 daily login rewards by logging in every day for a week.

1.Title: Noctis Animarum Treats
1.Rule: During the event, players can give candy to 3 surprise visitors every day, with which they can receive corresponding rewards after successfully gifting away each piece of candy.

2.Rule: When the number of candies reaches the number required by the corresponding visitors, a reward shall become available. And if a visitor is given ALL of their favorite candy, a new message will be triggered.

3.Rule: Give candy to a total of 30 visitors during the event to receive Thoran's Exclusive Skin - Treacherous Tyrant.

4.Rule: If a player does not give candy away to visitors, the number of times candy can be given away shall be accumulated. Players can use the refresh function to re-summon surprise visitors by spending diamonds after visitors have already successfully received their candy. It costs 50 Diamonds to summon each visitor.

5.Rule: Players can acquire candy from Daily Quest Chests and by doing battle in the Noctis Animarum event. The type of candy received shall depend on which faction heroes players use in their formations.

6.Rule: Candy shall be automatically recalled at the end of the event.

1.Title: Engraving Rewind
1.Rule: During this event, players can revert the Eternal Engravings of one hero.

2.Rule: When a hero has their Eternal Engravings reverted, their Eternal Engravings level shall be reverted to zero, and all resources that were used to originally increase their Engraving level shall be returned.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

12.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

18.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

1.Title: Road to Glory
1.Rule: The Road to Glory event shall be available during The Lost Sigils event, and will last for 14 days.

2.Rule: Triumphing in battles in The Lost Sigils event grants Battle Experience. By obtaining more Battle Experience, players can unlock even more rewards.

3.Rule: Rewards will be multiplied 5 times when you purchase and unlock the Road to Glory's Splendorous Rewards. Not only will the rewards be multiplied, but you will also receive 1200 Battle Experience points.

4.Rule: Any Road to Glory rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the event ends.

1.Title: Splendorous Rewards
1.Rule: Rewards will be multiplied 5 times when you purchase and unlock the Road to Glory's Splendorous Rewards. Not only will the rewards be multiplied, but you will also receive 1200 Battle Experience points.

2.Rule: Rewards displayed on the purchase page contain the following: 1. Rewards already unlocked by the player x4; 2. Rewards that the player can unlock after receiving additional Battle Experience rewards x5.

3.Rule: If a player has already claimed a portion of the rewards before purchasing the Road to Glory Splendorous Rewards, the player shall be compensated with the reward difference.

4.Rule: If a player has already unlocked a portion of the rewards before purchasing the Road to Glory Splendorous Rewards, the rewards shall be multiplied 5 times after purchasing the Splendorous Rewards deal, but the player must claim them manually via the Road to Glory page.

5.Rule: Rewards received after acquiring additional Battle Experience will be multiplied 5 times after purchase, and must be manually claimed from the Road to Glory page.

1.Title: Temporal Rift
1.Rule: The event lasts for 42 days, and the next start date will be announced on the event calendar. In this game mode, all heroes will be Lvl 360.

2.Rule: Battles require 1 Heavenly Card. Players shall have 7 Heavenly Cards restored each week.

3.Rule: Each floor will feature a random type of challenge event, and after completing a floor, you can advance to the next.

4.Rule: Before starting each challenge, you must select a quantity of Team Badges that matches the floor.

5.Rule: During the challenge, random "Divine Seals" will be dropped. Each Team Badge has 3 empty Divine Seal slots. You can choose to convert acquired Divine Seals to increase the base level of the Badges, with the maximum base level limited by the current floor.

6.Rule: The same Team Badges and Divine Seals can only be used by a single team, to enhance the power of heroes in the Temporal Rift.

7.Rule: After defeating the Boss every 20 floors, the Divine Seals on the Team Badges will be cleared due to temporal turbulence, but the level of the Team Badges remains unaffected.

8.Rule: Team Badges are special items that can only be activated and viewed in the Temporal Rift. All Team Badges shall be destroyed after a challenge ends or is reset.

9.Rule: You will have a certain amount of "Stability" during each challenge. The exploration will end when your Stability reaches 0.

10.Rule: Stability will be reduced based on the result of each battle. The longer the battle, the more damage the heroes suffer, the more Stability is lost.

11.Rule: This event provides Medals of Courage, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Award Swap Section. Unused Medals of Courage will not be carried over into the next Temporal Rift event.

12.Rule: You can increase your heroes' Combat Ratings within the Temporal Rift through the Temporal Beacon. Increasing a hero's Combat Rating requires the expenditure of Continuum Essence and Continuum Cores.

13.Rule: Continuum Essence may be acquired from Temporal Armillary AFK Rewards, Temporal Feedback events and by completing a Temporal Rift level for the first time. Once a season has ended, Continuum Essence will be destroyed.

14.Rule: During the event, leveling up the Temporal Armillary increases the number of additional selectable heroes during the challenge, unlocks the max level limit of "Temporal Beacon", etc. More details can be found on the Temporal Armillary level interface. The Temporal Armillary level is reset when a new season begins.

15.Rule: In Temporal Rift, each floor has a certain point value, and reaching a floor shows that the player has attained that point value.

16.Rule: You can visit the rewards screen to claim rewards depending on your highest score.

17.Rule: There are "initial rewards" and "repeat rewards". Initial rewards can only be claimed one time, while repeat rewards can be claimed again the next time the event opens.

18.Rule: Upon clearing Floor 300 of Temporal Rift, Infernal Chasm will be unlocked, and you can continue in the Hard tower.

19.Rule: The Infernal Chasm has the same Temporal Beacon as the Normal tower, but the enemies will be much stronger.
