1.Title: Defense Force
1.Rule: The number of heroes in the Temporal Rift Defense Force and the number of Team Badges increases as the challenge progresses. Increasing the Temporal Rift level allows for additional heroes to be deployed in the Defense Force.

2.Rule: Ascended tier Elite+ heroes or higher can be used in the Hero Defense force, trial heroes may not be used.

3.Rule: Selected heroes cannot be swapped in the middle of a challenge.

4.Rule: In the Temporal Rift, the number of Divine Seals that can be dropped cannot exceed the number of Team Badges carried by the Defense Force. If there are empty slots, the randomly dropped Divine Seals will be fewer.

5.Rule: Heroes recruited during challenges will not occupy Defense Force slots.

6.Rule: After reaching a specific floor, you can unlock Level Sweep starting from levels that are multiples of 20. For each Level Sweep, you need to select the corresponding number of heroes and Team Badges.

7.Rule: The number of times levels can be swept cannot exceed the maximum number of levels in the current season.

8.Rule: Using the preset function, you can directly use the configuration of recently used Hero Badges and Defense Force heroes, or used previously saved configurations.

1.Title: Temporal Beacon
1.Rule: Unlocking and increasing the stats within the Temporal Beacon can increase a hero's Combat Rating, which may only take effect until the current season ends.

2.Rule: Consumable items such as Continuum Cores and Continuum Essence that have already been obtained will be destroyed at the end of each season.

3.Rule: Temporal Rift Talents are only effective in the Temporal Rift.

4.Rule: Temporal Beacon Talents can be reset, however, they cannot be reset during the middle of a Temporal Rift run.

5.Rule: Increase the level of the Temporal Armillary to unlock more talent effects and remove restrictions.

1.Title: Sanctioned Realm
1.Rule: The Sanctioned Realm is temporarily unavailable, however in the official version it will be open for a duration of 21 days. For specific details, please refer to the Sanctioned Realm page.

2.Rule: All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Battles require 1 Sanction Card. Players shall have 7 Sanction Cards restored each week. Any unused cards will be removed.

4.Rule: The Sanctioned Realm is divided into 3 types of arena: The Elite Arena, the Courageous Arena and the Godly Arena.

5.Rule: By reaching level 200 of the Temporal Rift, players may choose to fight in the Elite Arena; by reaching level 300, players may choose to fight in the Courageous Arena; by reaching level 400, players may choose to fight in the Godly Arena.

6.Rule: One week before the event, players can choose to enter any arena according to the conditions they meet. After 3 days, players cannot switch to another arena.

7.Rule: On the first day players will receive a ranking but will not accumulate points.

8.Rule: One week before the event, players can choose to enter any arena according to the conditions they meet. After 3 days, players cannot switch to another arena.

9.Rule: To achieve victory in the Elite Arena players must win 2 out of 3 battles. To achieve victory in the Courageous Arena players must win 3 out of 5 battles. To achieve victory in the Godly Arena players must win 4 out of 7 battles. Players must field a number of formations that correspond to the number of battles that must be fought. Battles may be swept, and skills may be auto-cast.

10.Rule: Each attacking formation must possess at least 1 hero. Victory is achieved by defeating all of the opposition's heroes. If the battle timer reaches zero, the defending team is the victor.

11.Rule: After a challenger has successfully won a battle, the challenger and defender shall switch rankings. A higher ranking results in a higher rate of point accumulation.

12.Rule: Based on a player's total accumulated points, they are able to acquire an Avatar Frame, Badges and a Fortune Chest.

1.Title: Temporal Armillary
1.Rule: While the event is in progress, increasing your Temporal Armillary level will increase the rate of resource acquisition, and also unlocks other modes of play.

2.Rule: The Temporal Armillary's level is reset every season. Continuum Sequence can be used to increase the Temporal Armillary's level.

3.Rule: Continuum Sequences can be obtained through the Fountain of Time.

1.Title: Temporal Rift
1.Rule: Temporal Rift leaderboard rankings are based on the highest Temporal Rift level (floor) a player reached in a season.

2.Rule: Players' Temporal Beacon Talents can be viewed on the leaderboard and used as recommended formation references.

1.Title: Team Badge
1.Rule: New Team Badges will be unlocked gradually based on the highest floor you have reached.

2.Rule: During the challenge, random "Divine Seals" will be dropped. Each Team Badge has 3 empty Divine Seal slots. You can choose to convert acquired Divine Seals to increase the base level of the Badges, with the maximum base level limited by the current floor.

3.Rule: Each Team Badge has 3 empty slots, which can only be filled with their corresponding Divine Seals.

4.Rule: The same Team Badges and Divine Seals can only be used by a single team, to enhance the power of heroes in the Temporal Rift.

1.Title: Honorable Rewards
1.Rule: Honorable Rewards are calculated at the end of a season and automatically distributed based on the rankings.

2.Rule: Honorable Rewards are distributed based on the rankings.

3.Rule: For players at the same stage, those who reached the stage earlier rank higher.

1.Title: Reinforcements
1.Rule: Once a player has confirmed the faction they wish to use in the instance, players can then choose an additional reinforcement team of the corresponding faction.

2.Rule: Each faction have different reinforcement heroes, tap the button to view the specific heroes.

3.Rule: Reinforcement heroes must reach Elite+ or higher before they can be placed in the "Troops" recovery pool. Mercenaries and trial heroes may not be used as reinforcements.

4.Rule: Up to two teams of reinforcement heroes may be placed in the recovery pool.

1.Title: Hunter's Honor
1.Rule: Hunter's Honor shall become available during The Hunting Fields event.

2.Rule: Each time a player increases their Hunting Squad Level, the next tier of rewards shall be unlocked. Reward tiers may only be claimed once, even if the player embarks on multiple hunts.

3.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 980 VIP experience points and Premium Pass rewards.

4.Rule: Hunter's Honor will become unavailable when the Hunting Fields event ends.

5.Rule: Any Militia Honors rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when Island Survival ends.

1.Title: Temporal Feedback
1.Rule: The Temporal Feedback event will persist throughout the Temporal Rift event.

2.Rule: Players will receive Continuum Points based on bundle price when they purchase bundles before the Temporal Feedback event ends (excluding Growth Bundles).

3.Rule: When the corresponding quantity of Continuum Points is acquired, players can claim Continuum Essence, Continuum Cores and Rewinding Keys.

4.Rule: During each Temporal Rift season, the Temporal Feedback event will be reset once every 14 days. It will reset even if there are fewer than 14 days remaining before the Temporal Rift season ends. Any surplus Continuum Points will be retained and added to the next Temporal Feedback event.

5.Rule: Excess Continuum Points, Continuum Essence, Continuum Cores and Rewinding Keys will be removed when a season ends, and will not count towards the next season.

6.Rule: Once a season has ended, the Temporal Feedback event for the following season will be launched in advance. All Continuum Points earned during this time will automatically roll over into the next season.

1.Title: The Hunting Fields
1.Rule: Only heroes and reinforcements from the faction you were matched with during the final matching process can be used once the challenge has commenced.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Yuexi Bundle
1.Rule: By reaching Chapter 20 or VIP Level 13, players can unlock the entrance to the Yuexi Ship.

2.Rule: Yuexi bundles are refreshed every 14 days.

3.Rule: When purchasing Yuexi bundles, players will receive Wish Tokens. Wish Tokens can be used at the Wishing Well to draw prizes.

1.Title: Wishing Well
1.Rule: Wish Tokens can be acquired by purchasing Yuexi bundles.

2.Rule: During a period of 14 days, all Special Tier and some of the 1st Tier prizes available will be limited in quantity.

3.Rule: The Wishing Well is refreshed every 14 days. After it's refreshed, all unused Wish Tokens will be retained. All Special Tier and 1st Tier Prizes will be fully renewed.

4.Rule: When drawing "Dream Tier" prizes, the odds are as follows: Special Tier - 3.14%, 1st Tier - 19.57%, 2nd Tier - 77.29%.

5.Rule: When drawing "Wish Tier" prizes, the odds are as follows: 1st Tier - 1%, 2nd Tier - 6%, 3rd Tier - 93%.

1.Title: Solemn Vow
1.Rule: How to become a Mentor: Reach Chapter 30 of the Campaign and possess 10 Ascended tier heroes.

2.Rule: How to become an Apprentice: Reach a Stage between Campaign Chapter 4 through Chapter 25.

3.Rule: Mentors may only take on one apprentice at a time, likewise, apprentices may only ask for help from one mentor at a time.

4.Rule: Mentors and apprentices cannot halt their relationship within the first 3 days of it beginning.

5.Rule: Mentors are required to take on new apprentices at least one week apart from their last intake.

6.Rule: Apprentices cannot choose a new Mentor for the next 24 hours after halting their relationship with the previous Mentor. If a mentor has been offline for 7 days, the Apprentice can immediately find a new Mentor after halting their relationship with the inactive Mentor.

7.Rule: When a mentor and apprentice have been in a mentoring relationship for one week, the mentor can choose to terminate the relationship with the apprentice.

8.Rule: After completing corresponding tasks, Mentors can claim "Years Lost" rewards. "Years Lost" contains all Apprenticeship rewards.

1.Title: Solemn Vow
1.Rule: When an Apprentice completes Learning Tasks and Mentor Tasks they shall receive Erudite Essence. By accumulating Erudite Essence, players can raise the level of the sword "Solemn Vow", while also claiming its level-up rewards.

2.Rule: By completing all Learning Tasks and Mentor Tasks, players are able to level up the Solemn Vow to its maximum level. Once a player has claimed the Solemn Vow's max level rewards, their apprenticeship will be considered as successfully finished.

3.Rule: Apprentice's Solemn Vow level-up rewards can only be claimed once per level. A player's Apprentice level is linked to their Solemn Vow level, thus, if they terminate their mentoring relationship with a Mentor, it shall not be reset.

4.Rule: During a Mentor and Apprentice's mentoring relationship, Mentors can acquire Mentorship Points based on the Apprentice's current Solemn Vow level.

5.Rule: Mentors can claim corresponding Mentor Rewards by accumulating Mentorship Points.

6.Rule: How to become a Mentor: Reach Chapter 30 of the Campaign and possess 10 Ascended tier heroes.

7.Rule: How to become an Apprentice: Reach a Stage between Campaign Chapter 4 through Chapter 25.

8.Rule: Mentors may only take on one apprentice at a time, likewise, apprentices may only ask for help from one mentor at a time.

9.Rule: Mentors and apprentices cannot halt their relationship within the first 3 days of it beginning.

10.Rule: Mentors are required to take on new apprentices at least one week apart from their last intake.

11.Rule: Apprentices cannot choose a new Mentor for the next 24 hours after halting their relationship with the previous Mentor. If a mentor has been offline for 7 days, the Apprentice can immediately find a new Mentor after halting their relationship with the inactive Mentor.

12.Rule: When a mentor and apprentice have been in a mentoring relationship for one week, the mentor can choose to terminate the relationship with the apprentice.

13.Rule: After completing corresponding tasks, Mentors can claim "Years Lost" rewards. "Years Lost" contains all Apprenticeship rewards.

1.Title: Quests
1.Rule: Apprentices can complete all Learning Tasks with the guidance of their Mentors. Learning Tasks may not be completed multiple times, and the number of tasks already completed will not be reset if an Apprentice terminates their relationship with a Mentor.

2.Rule: Mentors may give Apprentices 1 Mentor Task per week, after which the Apprentice will receive a reward upon completing it.

3.Rule: Mentor Task progress is calculated weekly. Apprentices may commence their Mentor Tasks in advance, and the progress made within each week will be retained.

4.Rule: An Apprentice may complete a total of 10 Mentor Tasks. If an Apprentice changes Mentor, the number of chances they have to complete Mentor Tasks will not be reset.

5.Rule: If an Apprentice does not complete a Mentor Task, they do not lose any chances to complete future Mentor Tasks.

1.Title: Formations
1.Rule: Mentors can use the Recommended Formation function to recommend optimal formations to their Apprentices.

2.Rule: The Recommended Formation function is divided into two types of formation: 'Optimal' and 'Current'. Within the Optimal tab, Mentors can select the best possible heroes within the game to formulate a formation. Within the Current tab, Mentors may only select heroes from a list of heroes that are currently owned by the Apprentice.

3.Rule: Apprentices can copy their Mentor's recommended formation into their own formation.

1.Title: Mentor Mercenaries
1.Rule: Apprentices can borrow Mentor Mercenaries from their Mentors without their approval. Apprentices just need to confirm their heroes on the secondary confirmation page to start using them.

2.Rule: Apprentices can borrow up to 2 Mentor Mercenaries a week. Chances to use a Mentor Mercenary will only be deducted when they are used in a victorious formation. Mentor Mercenaries will be recalled on Sunday mornings at 00:00 UTC.

3.Rule: You may only hire Legendary tier or higher heroes from Mentors or friends. Hired heroes can each be used in battle only once in the King's Tower, Faction Towers, and campaign stages if you are victorious, or more than once if you are defeated. Only one mercenary can be used at a time while 'Team Hunting'. However, there is no usage limit for mercenaries.

1.Title: The Frosty Isles
1.Rule: Glacial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players may acquire treasure or Rock Orchids. Rock Orchids have a chance to trigger a Critical Strike, which grants players double the number of Rock Orchids they can receive, and even more!

4.Rule: Rock Orchids can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Rock Orchids will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Glacial Keys will be recalled for 40k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Frosty Festivities
1.Rule: Glacial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players may acquire treasure or Rock Orchids. Rock Orchids have a chance to trigger a Critical Strike, which grants players double the number of Rock Orchids they can receive, and even more!

4.Rule: Rock Orchids can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Rock Orchids will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

13.Rule: Remaining Glacial Keys will be recalled for 40k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Rules
1.Rule: Event lasts for a total of 9 days. Players can contribute Fire Tokens to increase the global progress bar, and receive random rewards by doing so.

2.Rule: Players can acquire Fire Tokens from Daily Quest Chests before the progress bar for all servers reaches is full. Once the progress bar is completely full, players will no longer be able to acquire Fire Tokens the following day.

3.Rule: Information about the new hero can be gradually unlocked based on the progression of all servers. Additional rewards may also be claimed when the information is unlocked.

4.Rule: Remaining Fire Tokens will be recalled for 10k gold per token once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Talene - The Resurging Flame
1.Rule: Talene - The Resurging Flame possesses an additional skill called the Solaran Realm that aids her allies in combat.

2.Rule: Once unlocked, Talene - The Resurging Flame's skills can be increased by leveling up her Signature Item, Mythic Furniture, Engraving level and Hero Tier.

3.Rule: Talene - The Resurging Flame cannot be placed on the battlefield alongside Talene - The Rising Phoenix (e.g two Talenes cannot be in the same formation at the same time.)

4.Rule: The lowest Ascension Tier that Talene - The Resurging Flame can be is Legendary. Talene - The Resurging Flame can be acquired by spending Time Emblems at the Temple of Time.

5.Rule: Players can exchange a limited quantity of Time Emblems at the Store.

6.Rule: When a player possesses an Ascended Talene - The Resurging Flame, they can select her at the Stargazer and use Stargazing Cards to summon her again.

7.Rule:
How to combine Talene - The Resurging Flame:
        Legendary x3 = (Legendary+)
 (Legendary+) + (Legendary+) = Mythic
 (Legendary+) + (Mythic+) = Ascended
 (Legendary+) + Ascended = Ascended+1
 (Legendary+) + Ascended+1 = Ascended+2
 (Legendary+) + Ascended+2 = Ascended+3
 (Legendary+) + Ascended+3 = Ascended+4
 (Legendary+) + Ascended+4 = Ascended+5
 (Legendary+) + Ascended+4 = Ascended+5

1.Title: Midwinter Feast
1.Rule: During the event, players need to work together with their guild mates to collect ingredients and create delicious culinary delights.

2.Rule: This event shall last for a total of 14 days. A new delicacy will be unlocked once per day for the first 7 days of the event for all guild members to cook.

3.Rule: During the event, players will receive 15 Stamina Points per day. Stamina Points cannot be accumulated, but players can spend Diamonds in exchange for Stamina Points they skipped, with a maximum of 15 points available each time. However, Stamina Points can only be exchanged when the player has zero points remaining. Stamina Points only affect the player's self.

4.Rule: Hunting: 5 Stamina Points shall be consumed when fighting against Wrizz. Stamina is deducted at the start of battle, if a player chooses to exit the battle halfway through, the Stamina will not be returned to them. Wrizz drops varying quantities of Meat and Seeds based on the amount of damage dealt by the player. Dropped ingredients are stored in the Guild Depot and can be shared by all guild members.

5.Rule: Sowing Seeds: Each time a player sows seeds, 10 Seeds will be consumed as well as 5 Stamina Points, which are immediately deducted. After a period of time, players can manually harvest 10 Fruit and Vegetables which correspond to the 10 planted seeds. Harvested food is stored in the Guild Depot and can be shared by all guild members.

6.Rule: Cooking: Once the needed amount of ingredients has been collected, players can consume 5 Stamina Points which are immediately deducted, to begin cooking. Cooking requires two actions to be carried. The final resting point of the moving needle shall have a direct impact on a delicacy's overall completion progress. Delicacies are shared among all guild members.

7.Rule: Cooking Rewards: All guild members shall receive a reward when specific increments of a Delicacy's progression are reached.

8.Rule: Personal Rewards: Once players have accumulated a total of 100 Stamina Points they can receive Satrana's Exclusive Winter Skin - Wintry Blaze and other such rewards.

9.Rule: Players can refer to the scrolling messages atop the event screen for information about what ingredients need to be prepared.

10.Rule: After the event has ended, if the player has unclaimed rewards, then the rewards will be sent to the player's mailbox, according to their guild's current progression situation and the quantity of Stamina Points the player has personally expended.

1.Title: Hunter's Feast
1.Rule: Players need to consume 5 Stamina Points each time they fight Wrizz.

2.Rule: A differing quantities of Meat and Seeds shall drop from Wrizz based on the amount of total damage dealt to him.

3.Rule: Dropped Meat and Seeds will be directly deposited in the Guild Depot for all guild members to share.

4.Rule: After receiving Seeds, players can proceed to the "Sow" function to plant their seeds based on their guild's current needs. Once the seeds have finished growing, the Fruit and Vegetables that they produce can be harvested.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances: knife juggling, fire juggling, a clown show, and puppetry. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: The Tormented Reach
1.Rule: The Tormented Reach event will run for 14 days. During the event, players can consume Mental Clarity to dispel Talene's Clouds of Doubt and defeat her Inner Demons.

2.Rule: 50 points of Mental Clarity are restored every day at 00:00 AM UTC time. Once the event period is over, Mental Clarity will be recycled at a rate of 1 Diamond per point.

3.Rule: A cloud can be dispelled when there are no obstacles, enemies, or other clouds between the cloud and the player. Dispelable clouds will be highlighted and cost 1 point of Mental Clarity to dispel.

4.Rule: When a Cloud is dispelled, it will dispel the cloud on the surrounding impassable tiles within one tile of the dispelled Cloud.

5.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

6.Rule: There are a total of 7 Inner Demons. After they are all destroyed, players can tap the final point of the progress bar for a fabulous reward!

7.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, every day that players attempt to challenge a difficulty higher than that of their current highest will reward them with treasure chests. Rewards obtained but not collected will be sent to player inboxes the following day.

8.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, hero levels will be set to 300. Equipment, Furniture, Signature Item, and Eternal Engravings will all remain the same.

9.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used when engaging in the Fortitude Forge.

10.Rule: Heroes engaging in the Fortitude Forge will receive Talene's protection effects.

11.Rule: The Fortitude Forge will be divided into three rounds which last for 5 days, 5 days, and 4 days respectively, with the protection effect changing each round.

12.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, players can choose the difficulty at which they wish to engage, there is no limit to how many times a challenge can be undertaken.

13.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, players can acquire rewards by completing specific difficulty and level quests via the "Individual Rewards" page during the event.

14.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, the highest current difficulty challenge completed throughout all challenges will count towards your real-time ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

15.Rule: In the Fortitude Forge, each round is ranked independently, and players will receive Fortune Chests based on their Guild Members' highest rankings.

1.Title: Temple of Time
1.Rule: Time Emblems can be used to summon Awakened Heroes, Emblems, Legendary Gear and more.

2.Rule: Summons also have a chance of rewarding Diamonds.

3.Rule: The prize pool hero is consistent with the Awakened Hero chosen by the player.

4.Rule: When a player possesses an Ascended Awakened hero, they can summon the corresponding hero at the Stargazer.

1.Title: Blooming Wishes
1.Rule: Players can exchange Flower Bloom Bracelets for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: Players can obtain lots of Flower Bloom Bracelets from Daily Quest Chests.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Remaining Flower Bloom Bracelets will be recalled for 40k Gold per bracelet once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Forest Sonnets
1.Rule: You can send gifts to other players via their "Player Info" page during the event.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined by the total amount of "Sweet Sensations" players receive during the event. Players will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition Forest Sonets frame, which is determined by their final leaderboard ranking. Frames shall be sent to the player's inbox at the end of the event.

3.Rule: Players who reach Twisted Realm Floor 252 will receive a base quantity of Sweet Sensations during each result calculation. When calculating results, divisions equal to, or higher than Gold division will be granted additional Sweet Sensations. Players below Floor 252 cannot obtain any Sweet Sensations.

4.Rule: Players will get extra Sweet Sensations when they buy Flower Bloom Bracelets from the Merchant's page.

1.Title: Poetic Pop Quiz
1.Rule: The event will last for a total of 10 days. New questions will become available every day for the first 8 days of the event.

2.Rule: Each round will be comprised of 5 questions. Resources will be awarded for each question answered correctly. Rewards will be sent out after all questions have been answered.

3.Rule: Aside from the rewards mentioned above, players can acquire additional rewards by correctly answering a specific number of questions during the event. Players can find these additional rewards in the top right corner of the event page.

4.Rule: Review: After a player has correctly answered all questions in a round, they can look back and review their answers.

5.Rule: Corrections: If some questions were answered incorrectly, players can use the "Vanishing Fluid" to redo all the questions they got wrong after the round has ended.

6.Rule: Vanishing Fluid: Can be acquired from 100 Activity Point Daily Quest Chests after completing Daily Quests. Unused Vanishing Fluid will be lost at the end of the event.

7.Rule: Retake: If a question round is missed, 100 Diamonds can be spent to retake the missed questions.

8.Rule: Any claimable rewards that still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mail after the event.

1.Title: Exchanging Dimensionals
1.Rule: Players can use the designated currency type during the limited-time exchange event in exchange for Dimensional Heroes.

2.Rule: The limited-time exchange event will be displayed in game prior to the event's official start in order to allow players to begin storing the designated exchangeable currency in advance. Once the event officially starts, players will have 7 days to exchange Soulstones using designated exchangeable currency.

3.Rule: During the limited-time exchange event, players may only exchange 60 Dimensional Hero Soulstones one time to directly summon a Dimensional hero. If a player possesses fewer than 60 Soulstones, then the exchange cannot take place.

4.Rule: After the limited time exchange event for Joan of Arc - Dawn Protector has ended, players who do not possess this hero can exchange Joan of Arc's Soulstones in the Labyrinth Store. 64,000 Labyrinth Tokens can be exchanged for 15 of Joan of Arc's Soulstones per time. The number of times tokens can be exchanged will reset when the Labyrinth Store refreshes.

1.Title: Gold Bounty
1.Rule: The Gold Bounty lasts for 14 days. Players can unlock rewards by increasing their Island level in the Isle of Gold event.

2.Rule: Players who have unlocked additional rewards and have not claimed all of their rewards 3 days prior to the end of the Gold Bounty event can purchase Island Experience with diamonds.

3.Rule: After the Gold Bounty ends, any unlocked but unclaimed rewards will be sent to the player's Mail.

1.Title: Morale
1.Rule: When Pillaging is successful, Morale increases the amount of pillaged resources. The amount of resources the defender loses shall also be increased accordingly.

2.Rule: The initial max Morale is 5, and increases by 1 Morale point for each Island Level gained.

3.Rule: Morale can be reduced to below 0 during invasions. However, when Morale is calculated for pillaging resources, calculations are made with no less than 0 Morale.

1.Title: Specials
1.Rule: You can buy Daily Gift Set at a discounted price. They include all of today's Specials.

2.Rule: Purchase a complete set at a discounted price, and the fragments contained can be used to immediately summon heroes.

3.Rule: If you have bought an individual bundle, you will no longer be able to buy the Set of the day. They will be available for purchase after a refresh the next day.

4.Rule: If you have bought a Set, you will no longer be able to buy any individual bundle from the Set period. They will be available for purchase after the Set period is refreshed.

5.Rule: If you have purchased any bundle, then heroes cannot be exchanged during its refresh period.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Gear Resonance
1.Rule: Gear Resonance can raise all low Combat Rating gear worn by heroes to the same tier.

2.Rule: After collecting enough gear of the specified tier, players can unlock the Gear Resonance function, or upgrade its tier level.

3.Rule: When the Gear Resonance Tier is at Mythic T2 or below, low Combat Rating gear will be raised to match the Gear Resonance tier with faction bonuses, but will not be enhanced.

4.Rule: When the Gear Resonance Tier reaches Mythic T3 or above, low Combat Rating gear will be raised to match the Gear Resonance tier, but will not gain faction bonuses, nor be enhanced. If the original gear's tier reaches Mythic T3, it will retain its hero exclusive bonus attributes.

5.Rule: Players can enable or disable Resonating effects via hero and gear interfaces.

6.Rule: Once gear is resonating, it cannot be enhanced, upgraded or reset.

1.Title: Warrior's Glory
1.Rule: Players may exchange Beastly Pendants for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can acquire lots of Beastly Pendants from the Battle of Blood event.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

10.Rule: Excess Beastly Pendant will be recalled for 24k Gold per pendant once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Warrior's Way Splendorous Rewards
1.Rule: Rewards will be multiplied 5 times when you purchase and unlock the Warrior's Way Splendorous Rewards. Not only will the rewards be multiplied, but players shall also receive 2400 Valiant Merits.

2.Rule: Rewards displayed on the purchase page contain the following: 1. Rewards already unlocked by the player x4; 2. After receiving additional Valiant Merits, rewards players can unlock x5.

3.Rule: If a player has already claimed a portion of the rewards before purchasing the Warrior's Way Splendorous Rewards, the player shall be compensated with the reward difference.

4.Rule: If a player has already unlocked a portion of the rewards but not claimed them before purchasing the Warrior's Way Splendorous Rewards, the rewards shall be multiplied after purchasing the Splendorous Rewards deal, but they must be claimed manually via the Warrior's Way page.

5.Rule: Rewards received after acquiring additional Valiant Merits will be multiplied after purchase, and must be manually claimed from the Warrior's Way page.

1.Title: (Old) Regal Rewards
1.Rule: Regal Rewards become available 8 days after the creation of a new account profile.

2.Rule: The Regal Rewards event has a duration of 42 days.

3.Rule: More Regal Rewards can be unlocked by using Medals of Valor, which can be acquired from the 'Dailies' and 'Weeklies' quest chests.

4.Rule: Any claimable Regal Rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Regal Rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Medals of Valor in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Regal Rewards' reset date.

6.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

7.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

1.Title: (Old) Twisted Bounties
1.Rule: Twisted Bounties event will be available after the Twisted Realm is unlocked.

2.Rule: The Twisted Bounties event has a duration of 38 days.

3.Rule: Acquire more Twisted Sigils and receive more Twisted Bounties during this event! Twisted Sigils can be acquired via Twisted Realm rank rewards.

4.Rule: Any Twisted Bounties rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Twisted Bounties system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Twisted Bounties rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Twisted Sigils in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the reward reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

9.Rule: After purchasing the Twisted Bounties Premium Pass you may purchase the Deluxe Pass to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: Champions of Esperia
1.Rule: The Champions of Esperia can be opened after completing Stage 8-20 when the Arcane Labyrinth is refreshed.

2.Rule: The Champions of Esperia event has a duration of 34 days.

3.Rule: Heroic Merits can be acquired by defeating Kane on every floor of the Arcane Labyrinth. You can unlock more rewards on the 'Champions of Esperia' page by acquiring more Heroic Merits.

4.Rule: Any claimable Champions of Esperia rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Champions of Esperia rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Champions of Esperia rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Heroic Merits in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the reward reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

9.Rule: Players that have unlocked Signature Items can purchase the Deluxe Pass after purchasing the Premium Pass in order to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: Lost Grace
1.Rule: The 'Lost Grace' event will run for 14 days. During the event, players can explore the map to help Rosaline and Oscar find clues to solve the mystery and earn some fabulous rewards!

2.Rule: Once the event starts, each day one new area can be unlocked and explored. Players must explore areas in the order that they are unlocked. There are 8 areas in total.

3.Rule: You can collect Heirlooms while exploring the map. Up to three Heirlooms can be used per team during Powerful Enemy challenges.

4.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

5.Rule: As you progress through the story, you will be able to choose one of the three suspects believed to be the genuine culprit. Once chosen, if you chose correctly, you will receive an additional bonus reward!

6.Rule: During Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge, hero levels will be set to 360. Equipment, Furniture, Signature Item, and Eternal Engravings will all remain the same.

7.Rule: Mercenaries are not permitted in Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge.

8.Rule: During the event, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge.

9.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt in Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge will count towards your real-time ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

10.Rule: During Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge, each challenge is ranked independently, and players will receive Fortune Chests based on their Guild Members' highest rankings.

1.Title: Powerful Enemies
1.Rule: When fighting Powerful Enemies, hero levels will be set to 360. Gear, Furniture, Signature Items and Eternal Engravings levels will all remain the same.

2.Rule: When battling Powerful Enemies, you can choose adventure items that grant you buffs.

3.Rule: Players are able to challenge Powerful Enemies 5 times daily for free. 1 Challenge Attempt shall be deducted after every battle.

4.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies.

5.Rule: During the event, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges and the Final challenge.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

7.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

8.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

9.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chests shall be sent out when the leaderboard is calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Tracing Suspicions
1.Rule: The Tracing Suspicions event shall continue to be available during Lost Grace event, and will last for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can complete Lost Grace quests to obtain Case Progress Experience. Obtaining more Case Progress Experience unlocks greater rewards.

3.Rule: Players who have unlocked Tracing Suspicions that have not claimed all of their rewards 4 days prior to the end of the event can purchase Case Progress Experience with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Tracing Suspicions to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any Tracing Suspicions rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed, will be sent to the player's mailbox when the event ends.

1.Title: Mirth & Merriment
1.Rule: During the event, players can acquire Random Jigsaw Pieces from 100 Point Daily Activity Chests.

2.Rule: Random Jigsaw Pieces can be used on the event page. Illuminating any piece will grant its corresponding rewards.

3.Rule: Illuminate all 8 Jigsaw Pieces during the event to claim the final prizes.

4.Rule: Players can illuminate a maximum of 8 Jigsaw Pieces. Any unused Random Jigsaw Pieces will be recalled after the event ends.

1.Title: Den of Bones
1.Rule: Every hunting squad member has five opportunities per day to challenge each Den of Bones. When challenging the Den of Bones, no Stamina will be consumed.

2.Rule: If a player fails to defeat the enemies within the Den of Bones, the enemies shall be reset to their initial pre-challenge state.

3.Rule: After defeating Den of Bones enemies, players can place up to 4 heroes from their Recovery Pool in order to search the Den of Bones for Hunter Marks and Gear. Searching the Den of Bones shall consume Hero Stamina.

4.Rule: When a player's tiles are connected to the Den of Bones, they can place heroes into the den and explore it. Heroes placed in dens can be removed at any time.

5.Rule: The speed at which the Den of Bones can be searched increases with every hero that is placed in formation.

6.Rule: Received Hunter Marks shall be shared equally amongst Squad Members. Any acquired Gear will be placed in the Shared Bag.

7.Rule: The quantity of Hunter Marks which can be found within every Den of Bones is limited. Once searching has been completed, Den of Bones will disappear and become an empty Squad tile that is occupied by the player's heroes.

8.Rule: Once a Den of Bones has been fully searched, it shall disappear, and the empty tile shall be shared by the Squad.

1.Title: Dance of Wonder
1.Rule: During the event period, players can earn lots of Double-petal Roses from daily quests.

2.Rule: Players can obtain lots of event chests as rewards, based on the total quantity of Double-petal Roses they have cumulatively acquired.

3.Rule: Double-petal Roses can be exchanged for different types of rewards. Exchanging Double-petal Roses will not affect the total quantity of Double-petal Roses the player has cumulatively acquired.

4.Rule: Unlock all Dance of Wonder - Amethyst Chests to additionally receive the following rewards: Limited Edition Dance of Wonder Emojis; Limited Edition Chat Bubble - Veiled Youth; Limited Edition Avatar Frame - Enchanting Fragrance.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

15.Rule: Remaining Double-petal Roses will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Rules
1.Rule: New info about the new hero will be revealed throughout the event as time progresses.

2.Rule: You can claim corresponding rewards each time a new piece of info is unlocked.

1.Title: Echoes of Time
1.Rule: The Echoes of Time contains some legendary video and text records regarding heroes.

2.Rule: Turn the pages and look back at the content of past videoes or story events.

3.Rule: Some videos or texts remain locked, and can only be unlocked in the Echoes of Time once their corresponding event ends.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.
