16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

19.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

1.Title: Treasure Scramble
1.Rule: A single Treasure Scramble season has a duration of 10 days. Players can create their team formations 1 day before the season begins.

2.Rule: Treasure Scramble is a region-divided cross-server event. All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Trial heroes and short-term mercenaries cannot be used in Treasure Scramble.

4.Rule: Treasure Scramble is division-based game mode which is divided into 6 separate divisions that are based on Prestige.

5.Rule: During the event, players will need to dispatch heroes to defeat other players so that they can acquire Prestige. Prestige is used to increase a player's division, and allows them to enter more advanced treasure hunting areas.

6.Rule: Heroes that are currently out searching for treasure will only encounter heroes from players that are currently in the same division.

7.Rule: In divisions below "Treasure Master", players can only compete with other players that are on the same route. After reaching "Treasure Master" division, players will compete against players on other routes.

8.Rule: During the event, the number of teams that can be dispatched increases as a player reaches higher divisions.

9.Rule: During the event, all players' individual teams will explore and battle independently of one another. Each team can encounter enemies up to 100 times per day.

10.Rule: After players have confirmed their participation in the event, their configured teams shall begin treasure hunting every day at UTC 02:00 and UTC 14:00. Players can adjust their teams at any time within the season. Team adjustments will take effect as of the next treasure hunt.

11.Rule: After heroes have been dispatched, their statuses shall remain locked. Combat calculations are based on the stats the heroes have at the time they are dispatched.

12.Rule: If a team formation is empty at the time of dispatch, the formation shall be automatically filled by the system.

13.Rule: During the event, received rewards include daily exploration rewards and leaderboard rewards.

14.Rule: After each search team has finished a battle, players shall receive random exploration rewards based on the division the player was currently in when they encountered an enemy. All exploration rewards shall be sent out to players the following day of the event, and can be claimed automatically when the player enters Treasure Scramble event page. Exploration rewards are only retained for 2 days, so please claim them in good time.

15.Rule: The leaderboard rewards will be tallied every 5 days when the event ofﬁcially begins, and the rewards will be sent to your mail.

1.Title: Treasure Scramble Leaderboard
1.Rule: Player leaderboard rankings are determined by their Prestige.

2.Rule: The leaderboard rewards will be sent every 5 days when the event ofﬁcially begins.

3.Rule: Leaderboard rankings shall fluctuate daily, and are subject to daily battles. Final leaderboard rewards are determined by the final leaderboard calculation.

4.Rule: Treasure Scramble leaderboard rewards shall be sent out successively to players' mailboxes when leaderboards are calculated.

1.Title: Adrax
1.Rule: The first time Adrax's health falls below 80%, he receives power from his beacons, restoring his health to 80%. Defeating beacon defenders can prevent beacon effects from aiding Adrax.

2.Rule: When Adrax's health falls below 40% for the first time, he becomes enraged and his health is restored to 40%.

1.Title: Auto Battle
1.Rule: Players can turn on Auto Battle on the formation page at any time.

2.Rule: Once Auto Battle mode has been turned on, the system will use the player's current configuration to continue battling in subsequent rooms.

3.Rule: Auto Battle will stop when the following situations occur: 1. When there are 1 or more enemy teams, and the player does not have any heroes configured in their teams. 2. The player manually halts Auto Battle (including exiting the function, or terminating the process). 3. The player has selected the option to halt Auto Battle when heroes die. 4. The player reaches a floor that is not yet available.

4.Rule: Players will remain on the current floor that they stop Auto Battle on, and can continue to battle normally, including using the Time Rewind function etc.

5.Rule: The increase of Badges' basic level is prioritized during Auto Battle, where inferior Divine Seals will be replaced by acquired superior Divine Seals.

1.Title: The Grand Hunt
1.Rule: The Grand Hunt will run for 14 days, and results are calculated after 14 days.

2.Rule: Battles for enemies shall respectively become available on the 15th, 43rd and 75th days of the season. For specific times please refer to the in-game countdown timer. After players reach a specified floor of the Temporal Rift, they can participate in battles against specific enemies.

3.Rule: All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 360, and all heroes' gear (including gear slots which are empty) will have a level of Mythic T4. Hero tiers will remain unaffected, and they will not enjoy artifact attribute and effect bonuses.

4.Rule: Within this game mode, heroes will only receive the following Temporal Beacon battle effects: Renewed Hope, Energy Transfer, Subjugation, Badge Addiction, Fearsome Alliance, Silent Alliance, Unforeseen Power, Dimensional Force, Tank's Fortitude, Warrior's Spirit, Ranger's Rage, Mage's Might, and Supporter's Tenacity.

5.Rule: Before entering battle, you can choose a Badge for heroes to equip. For different enemies, different Badges can be chosen. For specifics please refer to the "Badges" list.

6.Rule: Battles require 1 Challenger Ticket each. Players are given 5 Challenge Tickets per week, with the option to spend Diamonds to acquire additional tickets.

7.Rule: Players can claim more rewards each time they deal a specified amount of damage to an enemy for the first time.

8.Rule: The final damage dealt in each challenge is counted towards the overall damage dealt by all teams.

9.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

10.Rule: Battles cannot be initiated while the results of each enemy are being calculated. Once results have been calculated, Fortune Chests will be awarded according to the player's overall ranking, and shall be sent to their mailbox.

1.Title: The Grand Hunt
1.Rule: Players are able to view the replay and formation of battles in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

2.Rule: Real-time rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: Players that obtain a Top 1000 rank on the leaderboard shall win a Fortune Chest that contains large amount of Diamonds. The results of each Grand Hunt enemy are calculated once, equaling 3 calculations in total. Guilds can obtain a maximum of one Fortune Chest each time rewards are calculated. If multiple guild members reach the criteria to obtain a Fortune Chest, the Fortune Chest will be based upon the member with the highest rank.

4.Rule: Individual leaderboard rewards will be gradually sent out via the mailbox once the season's rankings have been calculated.

5.Rule: Players ranked in the top 100 at the end of the season will be inducted into the Hall of Valor.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Celestial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Antiquity Stones. When Antiquity Stones are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Crit, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Antiquity Stones respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Antiquity Stones can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 42k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Rule: Players can exchange Antiquity Stones for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

5.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

6.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

13.Rule: Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Relief Forces
1.Rule: During the Relief Forces event, players can pick their preferred choice of heroes from the Relief Force list to join their teams.

2.Rule: The strength of Relief Force heroes corresponds with the player's own Resonating Crystal level. Raising the Resonating Crystal level up to the next stage increases the strength of the player's Relief Force heroes.

3.Rule: The Relief Force hero list is refreshed once every 14 days. When the list is refreshed, the current Relief Force selection will be reset, but may be reselected from the Relief Force list in the next stage of the event.

4.Rule: Each Relief Force invitation slot has its own corresponding expiration time. Once a slot expires, the player shall no longer be able to select a Relief Force hero for that invitation slot.

5.Rule: The three Relief Force invitation slots will be respectively opened on the 1st, 14th, and 28th day of the event. After having returned, if a player purchases a Monthly Card and Deluxe Monthly Card, they can immediately open the second and third invitation slots.

1.Title: Wish Boxes
1.Rule: During the event, 4 desired items may be selected from the event page and set as Wishlist items, after which Wish Boxes may be drawn.

2.Rule: After configuration, Wish Boxes will immediately produce one of the four desired items when drawn.

3.Rule: Wish Box rewards and their probabilities can be previewed from "Prizes".

1.Title: Lucky Prize Pool
1.Rule: <text|When 4 Wishlist items have been configured, the probability of getting each item from the Wish Box is 25%.|rule_des>

1.Title: Glorified Guilds
1.Rule: The Glorified Guilds Leaderboard shows the top guilds in the Abyssal Expedition every season (excluding the experimental season).

2.Rule: The leaderboard will be updated at the end of an Abyssal Expedition season. The champion guild on this server will be listed in the reward panel, and all players will be rewarded.

3.Rule: The leaderboard is based on the total data collected by the end of the Abyssal Expedition season.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

1.Title: Dune Destroyer
1.Rule: Once a player has finished all stories in Voyage of Wonders - "The Blood Claw", they can join the hunt for the Dune Destroyer with other players.

2.Rule: As the Boss is challenged by players across all servers, its HP is based on the number of active players across all servers. A player's damage dealt to the Boss will be updated the next day at 00:00 UTC time.

3.Rule: The Dune Destroyer lasts for up to 12 days until it is eliminated by players.

4.Rule: The hunt is split into 3 stages with each stage lasting for 4 days. Entering the next stage will allow players to deploy more heroes to challenge the Dune Destroyer.

5.Rule: All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

6.Rule: Players must deploy Brutus the Lion's Pride in this game mode. They can also deploy other heroes obtained through Voyage of Wonders - "The Blood Claw" or their own heroes. short-term mercenaries and trial heroes cannot be used.

7.Rule: When a player has dealt enough damage to the Boss in a stage, they can claim an Individual Reward in the Merit panel.

8.Rule: Each time players across all servers have dealt a certain amount of damage to the Dune Destroyer, they can claim a Server Reward from the Merit panel.

9.Rule: Players that ranked on top of the Total Leaderboard will get an Avatar Frame as an Honorable Reward. They can also win Fortune Chests for guild members.

1.Title: Dune Destroyer
1.Rule: There are two types of Leaderboards: the Total Leaderboard and the Stage Leaderboard.

2.Rule: The Stage Leaderboard records players' damage dealt to the Dune Destroyer and their formations in each stage.

3.Rule: When following other players on the leaderboards, it is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record for that stage.

4.Rule: The Total Leaderboard records players' highest damage dealt to the Dune Destroyer in each stages and ranks them by the total damage dealt.

5.Rule: Players that ranked on top of the Total Leaderboard will get an Avatar Frame as an Honorable Reward. They can also win Fortune Chests for guild members.

1.Title: Champion Bounties
1.Rule: Champion Bounties are available for 17 days during the Heroes of Esperia event.

2.Rule: Players can complete Heroes of Esperia quests to obtain Gem Laurels. Obtaining more Gem Laurels unlocks greater rewards.

3.Rule: Players who have unlocked Advanced Champion Bounties, and have not claimed all of their rewards 4 days prior to the end of the event, can purchase Gem Laurels with diamonds.

4.Rule: Unlocking the Advanced Champion Bounties will reward you with 980 VIP experience points.

5.Rule: Any Advanced Champion Bounties rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed, will be sent to the player's mailbox when the event ends.

1.Title: Joyous Summons Catchup Rules
1.Rule: Players who have logged in less than 3 days during the 2022 Joyous Summons event are eligible for the Joyous Summons Catchup event when they log in for the first time in 2022.

2.Rule: Players who have completely missed the event can claim 80 Hero Scrolls when they log in 3 days in a row.

3.Rule: Players who have logged in less than 3 days can claim the remaining Sign Up rewards.

1.Title: Shadow Invasions
1.Rule: Stages will become unlocked based on the player's Campaign progress.

2.Rule: Players can claim one-time rewards every time they complete a stage for the first time.

3.Rule: The player can obtain stars in each stage by fulfilling certain requirements. After reaching a certain number of stars, the chest with extra rewards in the bottom right will be unlocked.

4.Rule: New heroes will be unlocked as the player completes stages. Players must have already obtained a hero (of any Tier) in the main game to use them in this event. Certain heroes can only be used after the corresponding side quests are completed.

5.Rule: Any hero in Shadow Invasions will be synced automatically with the same hero in the player's backpack who has achieved the highest tier, and will receive the corresponding enhancements. The specific effects can be viewed on the "Heroes" page.

6.Rule: Once the player clears Stages 1-12 and meets the requirements, they will be able to play "Trials of Annihilation".

7.Rule: The "Trials of Annihilation" stage lasts until the player is defeated. Points will be calculated based on the number of enemies killed and the completion of other objectives. A player's score record is only visible to the player themselves.

8.Rule: Players' high scores for "Trials of Annihilation" will be cleared after Shadow Invasions is adjusted or updated. After that, players can explore and complete the challenge again.

1.Title: Hall of Valor
1.Rule: The Hall of Valor honors players who have achieved excellent scores in the Temporal Rift;

2.Rule: The leaderboard will be based on the data calculated at season-end for the Temporal Rift;

1.Title: High Summer Adventure
1.Rule: The High Summer Adventure event will run for 14 days. Players will explore each area in the map to help Captain Pufferfish and its crew overcome obstacles and locate and seek revenge against the Reviled Captain.

2.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

3.Rule: Areas on the map that are shrouded by cloud have yet to be unlocked. Players can unlock an area each day by visiting the camp in the starting area and sending scouts. When you unlock a new area, you get a hero that can only be used in the event. If multiple recon chances have been accumulated in the camp, you will need to complete exploring the current unlocked area and acquire its ship part before unlocking the next area.

4.Rule: While exploring the map, players can collect Ship Parts from different areas. After the parts are acquired, their effects will be activated automatically (removing the obstacles in the different areas).

5.Rule: While exploring the map, players can unlock an area's powerful enemies after completing the area's storyline, and then fight the powerful enemies.

6.Rule: While exploring the map, players can collect Heirlooms on the map. When fighting powerful enemies, each team of players can arm themselves with a maximum of three Heirlooms to increase their strength.

7.Rule: Players can use baits for the fishing feature at the fishing spots on the map. Any "common fish" caught can be exchanged for rewards. Each area has a fishing spot. "Rare fish" may appear when fishing at the fishing spots of the seven areas other than the initial area "Motiz Cove". Any rare fish caught can unlock the Portrait Diamond Reward.

8.Rule: Every day, players can get one treasure map fragment by visiting the tavern in the starting area and speaking to the sailor. Once the seven fragments have been collected and combined into a complete treasure map, the location of Treasure Island will be marked out. The player can then go there to explore and receive rewards.

1.Title: Powerful Enemies
1.Rule: When fighting Powerful Enemies, hero levels will be set to 360. Tier, Gear, Furniture, Signature Items and Eternal Engravings levels will all remain the same, but will not enjoy Artifact attribute or effect bonuses.

2.Rule: When fighting Powerful Enemies, players can arm themselves with different Heirlooms to increase their team's strength. Heirlooms can be obtained when exploring different areas.

3.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

4.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against powerful enemies; but heroes acquired when unlocking areas can be used.

5.Rule: During the event, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

6.Rule: Players can use one team of heroes when fighting an area's powerful enemies. Players can use two teams of heroes when fighting the Final Powerful Enemy "The Reviled Captain". The sum of the damage dealt by the two teams will be the final damage.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

8.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

9.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

10.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chests shall be sent out when the leaderboard is calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Far Sea Voyage
1.Rule: Far Sea Voyage will be available during the High Summer Adventure event and run for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can earn Night-Sea Pearls by completing the missions in High Summer Adventure. The more Night Sea Pearls received, the greater the rewards they can unlock.

3.Rule: Players who have unlocked Far Sea Voyage that have not claimed all of their rewards four days prior to the end of the event can purchase Night-Sea Pearls with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Far Sea Voyage to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when Far Sea Voyage ends.

1.Title: Treasure Island Cache
1.Rule: Every day, players can get one treasure map fragment by visiting the tavern in the starting area and speaking to a sailor. There are a total of seven treasure map fragments to collect.

2.Rule: Once you have acquired a treasure map fragment, you can illuminate it on the Treasure Map screen. For each treasure map fragment illuminated, you will receive a corresponding reward.

3.Rule: Once the seven fragments are lit up and pieced into a complete Treasure Map, the location of Treasure Island will be marked out. The player can then explore the Island and receive rewards.

1.Title: Fish
1.Rule: During the event, players can use different baits to fish at different fishing spots.

2.Rule: Bait: Baits are classified into Universal and Special Baits. The Universal Bait "Shrimp Bait" can be used unlimited times to attract all kinds of fish. The remaining three Special Baits can be acquired during adventures and are used to attract specific fish. On the fishing preparation screen, tap a bait to see the fish it can catch.

3.Rule: Fish: Fish are classified into "common fish" (six species in total) and "rare fish" (seven species in total). Each area has a fishing spot. Only common fish will appear when fishing at the fishing spot of the initial area "Motiz Cove". When fishing at the fishing spots of the other seven areas, local rare fish may appear besides the common fish. Common fish can be used to redeem rewards. Rare fish can unlock the Portrait Diamond Reward.

4.Rule: Catch: Players can make six catch attempts each day. One catch attempt is deducted for each successful fishing session, while none is deducted for unsuccessful sessions. No catch attempt is deducted for any rare fish caught. When the catch attempts are exhausted, the player can still use Universal Baits to continue fishing, but the fish caught will not count as a catch and can only be used for recording their sizes and unlocking rare fish portraits.

5.Rule: How to fish: Once the fishing session starts, tap the fishing button to stop the moving needle. If the needle stays in the yellow zone, you will be deemed to have completed one fishing round. The completion of the specified round will count as a successful fishing session. If the needle does not stay in the yellow zone when the fishing button is tapped, the countdown will be shortened by a brief duration. If a player fails to complete all rounds before the countdown is over, the session will be deemed as failed. The next fishing session will start automatically regardless of the outcome of the previous one. Players can tap the back button to exit the fishing feature.

1.Title: Anglin' Prizes
1.Rule: During the event, players can fish at the fishing spots of the various areas on the map, and catch large quantities of fish.

2.Rule: Players may exchange "common fish" for various rewards over 14 days.

3.Rule: “Rare fish” cannot be exchanged for rewards.

4.Rule: After the event, excess fish will be automatically retrieved by the system.

1.Title: Fish Gifting
1.Rule: During the event, players can gift "common fish" to other players.

2.Rule: Only one fish can be gifted to a target player each day. There is no limit to the number of target players that can be gifted.

3.Rule: Each player can only receive two fish from other players each day. A player's Receiving List can save up to 10 gift messages. Once the number is reached, other players will no longer be able to initiate a gift.

4.Rule: If a recipient decides not to receive a gift after receiving a gift message, the fish will be returned to the original player.

1.Title: Battle Wager
1.Rule: After each Boss rotation of Cursed Realm is unlocked, every player can bet on the last digit of the combined damage dealt by the top 10 players in that rotation. The damage value shall be determined based on the final calculation result.

2.Rule: Players can place their wager within the first 3 days after each rotation of Cursed Realm is unlocked. Thereafter, the wagers will be locked pending the final result.

3.Rule: Each player can bet on a maximum of 5 numbers in each rotation.

4.Rule: Each guess costs 600 Poe Coins. A winner gets 6,000 Poe Coins. The reward for participation is 300 Poe Coins. All rewards for winners and participants are issued via the mailbox when the results of Cursed Realm are calculated.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

12.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

19.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

1.Title: Regal Rewards
1.Rule: Regal Rewards become available 8 days after the creation of a new account profile.

2.Rule: The Regal Rewards event has a duration of 42 days.

3.Rule: More Regal Rewards can be unlocked by using Medals of Valor, which can be acquired from the 'Dailies' and 'Weeklies' quest chests.

4.Rule: Any claimable Regal Rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Regal Rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Regal Rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Medals of Valor in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Regal Rewards' reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Once the Battle Pass has been updated, the original Regal Rewards will be displayed as "(Old) Regal Rewards", and once the old Regal Rewards expire, they will no longer be refreshable.

9.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

10.Rule: After purchasing the Regal Rewards Premium Pass you may purchase the Deluxe Pass to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: Boss Trial
1.Rule: During the preparation phase for Abyssal Expedition, players can carry out a Boss Trial on the interface. After the preparation phase, players can use the Boss Trial feature on the Final Boss display menu.

2.Rule: Only highest-level Blessed Relics are used, and Hero attributes are subject to "Martial Rating" rules. Players are only allowed to use their heroes that meet the battle criteria.

3.Rule: The trial does not consume Stamina. Damage dealt is for reference only, and does not affect the Boss' actual HP.

1.Title: Celestial Celebrations
1.Rule: Celebratory Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Dragonberries. When Dragonberries are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Critical Strike, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Dragonberries respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Dragonberries can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Dragonberries will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Celebratory Keys will be recalled for 42k Gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Plentiful Delights
1.Rule: Players can exchange Dragonberries for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

6.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

7.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Remaining Dragonberries will be recalled for 24k gold each one once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Beast Growth Bundle
1.Rule: Unlock the Beast Growth Bundle entrance by completing Stage 14-40.

2.Rule: During this event, players can unlock reward bundles by acquiring specific beasts and increasing their levels. The level of a beast is based on the highest level it has achieved.

3.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of less than 5 can initially view Beast Growth Bundle up to Level [6].

4.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of between 5 and 12 can initially view Beast Growth Bundle up to Level [12].

5.Rule: Players with a VIP Level of 13 or higher can initially view all Beast Growth Bundles.

1.Title: Twisted Bounties
1.Rule: Twisted Bounties event will be available after the Twisted Realm is unlocked.

2.Rule: The Twisted Bounties event has a duration of 38 days.

3.Rule: Acquire more Twisted Sigils and receive more Twisted Bounties during this event! Twisted Sigils can be acquired via Twisted Realm rank rewards.

4.Rule: Any Twisted Bounties rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the Twisted Bounties system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Twisted Bounties rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Twisted Sigils in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the reward reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

9.Rule: After purchasing the Twisted Bounties Premium Pass you may purchase the Deluxe Pass to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: Lure
1.Rule: Players can acquire a random beast by using Bait. Any Elite beast received by a player will be the beast named in their wishlist.

2.Rule: When acquiring a beast, a player has a certain chance of acquiring Spice Materials. Every 300 Spice Materials will be automatically synthesized into Secret Spices.

3.Rule: Players can use Secret Spices to acquire a designated Elite beast.

4.Rule: If a player owns enough copies of a beast to level it up to the max level, any additional copies acquired will automatically be converted into Spice Materials.

5.Rule: If a player owns fewer than 3 beasts that are not at max level, any beast they capture will be a beast that is not at max level.

1.Title: Glorified Guilds
1.Rule: The Glorified Guilds Leaderboard shows the top players in every official season of the Hunting Fields.

2.Rule: The leaderboard is updated at the end of a Hunting Fields season. The champion squad on this server will be listed in the reward panel, and all players will be rewarded.

3.Rule: The leaderboard is based on the total data collected by the end of the Hunting Fields season.

1.Title: Hunter's Notes
1.Rule: The Hunter's Notes contain different events, each with unique battlefield effects.

2.Rule: Players can earn stars by completing the challenge goals of the stage. After earning a certain amount of stars, they can unlock the chest and claim the reward.

3.Rule: There are two types of stages in an event: key and normal stages. Players can attempt a key challenge repeatedly to earn more stars.

4.Rule: Players can claim one-off reward after completing the stage.

5.Rule: Taking challenges will reduce your available number of attempts shared among all events in Hunter's Notes. Players' number of attempts is restored to 80 times every Monday at 00:00 UTC.

6.Rule: Trial heroes, Short-Term Mercenaries, and Relief Force heroes cannot be used in the Hunter's Notes.

7.Rule: In the Hunter's Notes, all heroes are Level 360. Their gear is Mythic T2 and includes Faction Bonuses but is un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipped with Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

8.Rule: Artifacts cannot be used in the Hunter's Notes.

1.Title: Diver's Quest
1.Rule: During the event period, players can earn lots of Beast Medals from daily quests.

2.Rule: Players can obtain lots of event chests as rewards, based on the total quantity of Beast Medals they have cumulatively acquired.

3.Rule: Beast Medals can be exchanged for different types of rewards. Exchanging Beast Medals will not affect the total quantity of Beast Medals the player has cumulatively acquired.

4.Rule: Unlock all Beast Clash Amethyst Chests to additionally receive the following rewards: Limited Edition Beast Clash Emojis; Limited Edition Chat Bubble - Campus Footprints; Limited Edition Avatar Frame - Campus Glory.

1.Title: Bravery Rewards
1.Rule: Players may exchange Beast Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Remaining Beast Medals will be recalled for 24k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 6-20 can claim the Awakened Baden Emojis in this interface.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Swamp Corruptor
1.Rule: Once a player has finished all stories in Voyage of Wonders - "Hopeless Isle", they can join the hunt for the Swamp Corruptor with other players.

2.Rule: As the Swamp Corruptor is challenged by players across all servers, its HP is based on the number of active players across all servers. A player's daily damage dealt to the Boss will be updated the next day at 00:00 UTC time.

3.Rule: The Swamp Corruptor lasts for up to 12 days until it is eliminated by players.

4.Rule: The hunt is split into 3 stages with each stage lasting for 4 days. Entering the next stage will allow players to deploy more heroes to challenge the Swamp Corruptor.

5.Rule: All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

6.Rule: Players must deploy the Knight of Blight in this game mode. They can also deploy other heroes obtained through Voyage of Wonders - "Hopeless Isle" or their own heroes. Short-term mercenaries and trial heroes cannot be used.

7.Rule: When a player has dealt enough damage to the Boss in a stage, they can claim an Individual Reward in the Merit panel.

8.Rule: During the event, your first challenge of the Swamp Corruptor each day will earn additional rewards.

9.Rule: Each time players across all servers have dealt a certain amount of damage to the Swamp Corruptor, they can claim a Server Reward from the Merit panel.

10.Rule: Players that ranked on top of the Total Leaderboard will get an Avatar Frame as an Honorable Reward. They can also win Fortune Chests for guild members.

1.Title: Swamp Corruptor
1.Rule: There are two types of Leaderboards: the Total Leaderboard and the Stage Leaderboard.

2.Rule: The Stage Leaderboard records players' damage dealt to the Swamp Corruptor and their formations in each stage.

3.Rule: When following other players on the leaderboards, it is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record for that stage.

4.Rule: The Total Leaderboard records players' highest damage dealt to the Swamp Corruptor in each stage and ranks them by the total damage dealt.

5.Rule: Players that ranked on top of the Total Leaderboard will get an Avatar Frame as an Honorable Reward. They can also win Fortune Chests for guild members.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

15.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Melodic Gifts
1.Rule: The Melodic Gifts event will last 28 days from 00:00 UTC of its starting day;

2.Rule: Rewards already drawn during the Melodic Gifts event will not be drawn again until its next reset;

3.Rule: Once the Grand Prize is drawn, the Melodic Gifts will be refreshed immediately;

4.Rule: Each time you enter the 2nd or 3rd wheel in each event, the Pop Prodigy will give you 1 reward from the Melodic Gifts. The reward will be deemed as drawn in subsequent round.

5.Rule: During the event, players can acquire Sonata Notes by purchasing Merchants' Bundles other than Growth Bundles, Alpinist's Bundles, Climber's Bundles, Apex Bundles, Subscriptions, and Noble Privileges.

6.Rule: During the event, Sonata Notes will be cleared at 00:00 UTC daily;

7.Rule: During the event, players can earn a Collectible Record by accumulating 90 Rhapsody Notes per day; To earn an extra Collectible Record, players must earn additional 300 Rhapsody Notes. The Records can be used to draw Melodic Gifts.

8.Rule: You will receive up to 28 Precious Records during the event.

1.Title: Rhapsody Bundles
1.Rule: There are three types of Rhapsody Bundles: Normal, Precious, and Supreme Rhapsody Bundles;

2.Rule: Rhapsody Bundles will be refreshed daily during the event.

1.Title: Cursed Realm
1.Rule: The Cursed Realm opens once every 7 days.

2.Rule: All heroes within the Cursed Realm have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Complete Stage 12-40 to unlock the trial function. The trial results will not be entered for competition on the leaderboard.

4.Rule: If a player deals enough damage to reach a new level of Realm Mastery, they will receive a one-off reward.

5.Rule: Bosses and their Shadow Guards will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

6.Rule: Within each new Cursed Realm session, players are able to challenge bosses 10 times for free, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may challenge bosses a maximum of 199 times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

7.Rule: The final damage of each challenge is the total sum of the damage dealt to bosses as well as the five Shadow Guard teams.

8.Rule: Results for the Cursed Realm are calculated over 24 hours, during which time players cannot partake in battles.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Beast Squad
1.Rule: The Beast Squad event will run for a total of 14 days.

2.Rule: During the event, you will receive 15 Stamina per day. Unused Stamina will be lost at the end of the day, but you can purchase unused Stamina from the previous day with Diamonds (up to 15 Stamina at a time). You can only purchase Stamina when you have zero Stamina remaining. Your Stamina can only be used by you. Your guild's cumulative Stamina consumption for the event cannot exceed 1050 Stamina x the number of event days (e.g. 1050 by day 1, 2100 by day 2, etc).

3.Rule: During the event, your guild will have a default beast. By spending Ancient Crystals, your guild will be able to hire up to 6 more beasts for your squad.

4.Rule: All beasts will automatically perform their assigned tasks. CP will be calculated based on their current Growth Value at UTC 00:00, and will be included in your guild's total CP for the event.

5.Rule: Hunting: Battling Wreathz costs 5 Stamina. Stamina will be deducted at the start of battle. If you choose to exit a battle halfway through, the Stamina you spent will not be refunded. After you win the battle, Wreathz will drop varying quantities of Gold Essence based on the total damage you dealt. Wreathz also has a chance to drop a rare Ancient Crystal. Dropped materials will be shared by all guild members.

6.Rule: Train: Training a beast costs 5 Stamina and a certain amount of Gold Essence. Training increases a beast's Growth Value and its speed of completing assigned tasks and earning CP.

7.Rule: Advance: Once a beast reaches a certain Growth Value, you will have to spend a large amount of Gold Essence to raise its Growth Limit. Advancing beasts does not cost Stamina.

8.Rule: Hiring: During the event, your Guild Deputy and Guild Master can spend Ancient Crystals to hire new beasts to join the squad and to perform assigned tasks. Hiring a beast does not cost Stamina. All guild members can "like" a beast in the beast menu to indicate which one they want the Guild Master/Deputy to hire.

9.Rule: Guild Rewards: When the total CP earned by your guild's Beast Squad meets certain requirements, all guild members can claim a reward.

10.Rule: Personal Rewards: You will be able to claim additional rewards if your personal Stamina consumption during the event meets certain requirements.

11.Rule: Hiring Rewards: Each time a new beast is hired for the squad during the event, every member will be mailed 100 Diamonds.

12.Rule: Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your mailbox at the end of the event.

13.Rule: The beasts hired during the event belong to the guild, not individual players. They will automatically disappear after the event ends.

1.Title: Wreathz
1.Rule: Battling Wreathz costs 5 Stamina. Stamina will be deducted at the start of battle. If you choose to exit a battle halfway through, the Stamina you spent will not be refunded.

2.Rule: After you win the battle, Wreathz will drop varying quantities of Gold Essence based on the total damage you dealt. Wreathz also has a chance to drop a rare Ancient Crystal.

3.Rule: Dropped materials will be shared by all guild members.

4.Rule: You cannot use beasts when battling Wreathz.

1.Title: Guild Ranking
1.Rule: The Beast Squad event's leaderboard is the Guild Ranking.

2.Rule: The rankings on the leaderboard will be based on each guild's total CP.

1.Title: Regal Rewards
1.Rule: Regal Rewards become available 8 days after the creation of a new account profile.

2.Rule: The Regal Rewards event has a duration of 42 days.

3.Rule: More Regal Rewards can be unlocked by using Medals of Valor, which can be acquired from the 'Dailies' and 'Weeklies' quest chests.

4.Rule: Any claimable Regal Rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Regal Rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Regal Rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Medals of Valor in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Regal Rewards' reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

9.Rule: After purchasing the Regal Rewards Premium Pass you may purchase the Deluxe Pass to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: Spooky Bundles
1.Rule: By reaching Chapter 15 or VIP Level 6, you can unlock Spooky Bundles.

2.Rule: By purchasing the below bundle for the Spooky Bundle, you can increase your Spooky Bundle discount by up to 50%. Once the maximum discount is reached, any purchase of the below bundle will no longer increase your Spooky Bundle discount.

3.Rule: If you have already purchased a Spooky Bundle, any purchase of the below bundle will no longer increase its discount.

1.Title: Fantastic Beasts
1.Rule: Fantastic Beasts contain different events, each with unique battlefield effects.

2.Rule: Players can earn stars by completing the challenge goals of the stage. After earning a certain amount of stars, they can unlock the chest and claim the reward.

3.Rule: There are two types of stages in an event: key and normal stages. Players can attempt a key challenge repeatedly to earn more stars.

4.Rule: Players can claim one-off reward after completing the stage.

5.Rule: Taking challenges will reduce your available number of attempts shared among all events in Fantastic Beasts. Players' number of attempts is restored to 80 times every Monday at 00:00 UTC.

6.Rule: Due to its special battlefield effects, beasts will play a significant role in Fantastic Beasts.

7.Rule: Trial heroes, short-term mercenaries, and Relief Forces cannot be used in Fantastic Beasts.

8.Rule: All heroes used are level 360, 5-Star Ascended heroes.

9.Rule: All heroes wear Mythic T3 equipment without bonus attributes by default.

10.Rule: All heroes are equipped with a level 30 Signature Item by default.

11.Rule: All heroes are equipped with 9 pieces of Mythic Exclusive Furniture.

12.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Elder Tree attributes and skills by default.

13.Rule: All heroes have level 60 Engravings by default.

14.Rule: Heroes do not make use of any Artifact attribute bonuses or Union Attribute Bonuses.

1.Title: Bringer of Blessings
1.Rule: After arriving at Harmony City in Merchant's Adventures, players can unlock the Boss challenge "Bringer of Blessings" in the city.

2.Rule: Players need to attack the Fortune Firecrackers while being harassed by the stone lion guards, and release Jubilee Flowers to earn points. The stone lion guards are not targetable and are immune to attacks.

3.Rule: During the Boss challenge, heroes' levels will be standardized as Lvl 360, while their original tiers, gear, furniture, Signature Items, Eternal Engravings, and beast levels will be maintained. However, they cannot enjoy any Artifact attribute and effect bonuses.

4.Rule: During the Boss challenge, heroes can be equipped with various Heirlooms to strengthen their teams. Heirlooms can be acquired while exploring different zones.

5.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

6.Rule: When battling the Boss, you cannot deploy mercenaries but may use heroes you have acquired in Merchant's Adventures.

7.Rule: Bringer of Blessings is divided into three phases. Players that achieve the required damage value for individual rewards during each phase will receive the relevant rewards.

8.Rule: In the three phases, players can deploy either 1, 2 or 3 teams of heroes. The total damage dealt by all the teams will count towards the final damage.

9.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each Boss disappears.

10.Rule: At the end of each phase, silver coins will be awarded to players based on their ranking, and can be used for trading goods in the Bustling Trade feature. After the reward calculation for a phase completed, players need to claim the rewards for this previous phase in Bringer of Blessings.

11.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chest Rewards will be determined once at the end of each phase.

1.Title: Trading
1.Rule: Players can explore the map in the Merchant's Adventures feature, discover the hawker stalls in various cities, and unlock trading nodes.

2.Rule: In the "Bustling Trade" feature, players can purchase local products at each trading node with silver coins and sell them in other cities.

3.Rule: The quantities of local goods at each place are limited. The stock at each trading node is replenished daily at 00:00 UTC. The quantities and prices of goods at each trading node may fluctuate depending on local events.

4.Rule: Players need to spend trading licenses when traveling between trading nodes. During the event, players will receive a certain number of trading licenses daily at 00:00 UTC. Trading licenses can be accumulated.

5.Rule: Players can expand their storeroom limit by spending silver coins in certain cities.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Players are ranked on the leaderboard based on the points they earned from releasing Jubilee Flowers.

2.Rule: On the leaderboard, players can view the replays of battles in which other players earned points as a reference for the recommended formation.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes depending on the players' attempts. Therefore, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized when the final leaderboard rankings are calculated.

1.Title: Rich List
1.Rule: Players are ranked on the leaderboard based on the total number of silver coins they earned in the "Bustling Trade", "Merchant's Adventures", and "Bringer of Blessings" features.

2.Rule: Players will receive Medals based on their rankings after the event.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes depending on the players' wealth. Therefore, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized when the final leaderboard rankings are calculated.

1.Title: Daily News
1.Rule: During Merchant's Adventures, Esperia Daily will continue to cover various local news.

2.Rule: Esperia Daily's news are updated at 00:00 UTC and come with gifts. Be sure to check your emails for the gifts.

1.Title: Grower of Wealth
1.Rule: The "Grower of Wealth" event will be available during the "Merchant's Adventures" event for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can win commendations from the Commerce Chambers by completing quests in Merchant's Adventures. The more commendations received, the greater the rewards that can be unlocked.

3.Rule: Players who purchased and unlocked Grower of Wealth, and have not claimed all the rewards 4 days before the end of Grower of Wealth, may purchase commendations with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Grower of Wealth to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any Grower of Wealth rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when Grower of Wealth ends.

1.Title: The Frosty Isles
1.Rule: Glacial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Rock Orchids. When Rock Orchids are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Critical Strike, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Rock Orchids respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Rock Orchids can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Rock Orchids will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Glacial Keys will be recalled for 42k Gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Rule: Players can exchange Rock Orchids for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

6.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

7.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Remaining Rock Orchids will be recalled for 24k gold each one once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Exchanging Dimensionals
1.Rule: Players can use the designated currency type during the limited-time exchange event in exchange for Dimensional Hero Soulstones.

2.Rule: The limited-time exchange event will be displayed in game prior to the event's official start in order to allow players to begin storing the designated exchangeable currency in advance. Once the event officially starts, players will have 7 days to exchange Soulstones using designated exchangeable currency.

3.Rule: During the limited-time exchange event, players may only exchange 60 Dimensional Hero Soulstones one time to directly summon a Dimensional hero. If a player possesses fewer than 60 Soulstones, then the exchange cannot take place.

4.Rule: Once Mulan's limited-time exchange event has ended, players that do not yet possess Mulan may still proceed to the Challenger Store (unlocked after completing Stage 9-20) to purchase Mulan's Soulstones. 250,000 Gladiator Coins can be exchanged for 15 of Mulan's Soulstones each time. Players can continue exchanging Gladiator Coins for Soulstones after the Challenger Store is refreshed.

1.Title: Resonant Fountain
1.Rule: The Resonant Fountain allows you to receive a large number of beast tokens for newly-acquired beasts and upgrade them quickly. The higher the level of the Resonant Fountain, the more tokens you will receive.

2.Rule: Beasts will be added to the Resonant Fountain automatically, starting with your highest-level beast. The higher the level of the Resonant Fountain, the more beasts that can be added to it.

3.Rule: Once all beasts in the Resonant Fountain have reached the required level, the Fountain can be ascended, increasing your resonance level.

4.Rule: When the Resonant Fountain is ascended, you will receive beast tokens or Secret Spices for all beasts not in the Fountain. For each beast, you will receive enough beast tokens to upgrade them from their current level to your resonance level.

5.Rule: If the level of a beast that is not in the Resonant Fountain is higher than your resonance level before ascending, you will receive Secret Spices for the excess levels.

6.Rule: The amount of tokens and Secret Spices you receive will be affected by the number of tokens you already own for each beast.

7.Rule: The beast's first token will not be compensated.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 6-20 can claim Belinda - Spark of Hope's Emoji in this interface.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Wish Finder
1.Rule: For each of the first 7 days of the event, a location clue for a wish will be unlocked.

2.Rule: Based on the clues, you can find the wishes hidden in other parts of the game.

3.Rule: After hanging a wish, you will receive the corresponding reward.

4.Rule: Each wish that is hung up will increase your progress towards unlocking the grand prize. After all the 7 wishes are hung up, you can tap to claim the grand prize.

1.Title: Zero Limit
1.Rule: Zero Limit is only available for a limited period.

2.Rule: All heroes within Zero Limit have a level of 360, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Each week, you are able to challenge 25 times for free, after which you will need to spend Diamonds to continue challenging. You may challenge a maximum of 100 additional times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time you enter a battle.

4.Rule: You are free to choose the difficulty of your challenge. Your current highest stage difficulty will count towards your ranking. Your final ranking will be determined by the calculation at the end of each session.

5.Rule: After the event, the final leaderboard rankings will always be displayed in the stage.

1.Title: Inseparable Friends
1.Rule: You can exchange Blooming Branches for rewards until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: You can obtain a ton of Blooming Branches from Daily Quest Chests.

3.Rule: You can receive bonus rewards depending on how many Blooming Branches you have used.

4.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

5.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

6.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

15.Rule: Remaining Blooming Branches will be converted into 40k Gold each once the event has ended.

1.Title: Shepherd's Serenade
1.Rule: You can send gifts to other players via their "Player Info" page during the event.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined by the total amount of Sunny Bouquets players receive during the event. Based on your final ranking and bouquets you sent, you will have the chance to be rewarded with a limited edition Shepherd's Serenade frame. Frames will be sent to your inbox at the end of the event.

3.Rule: After reaching Twisted Realm Floor 300, you will receive a base quantity of Sunny Bouquets during each result calculation. When calculating results, you will receive additional Sunny Bouquets if you are in Gold Division or higher. You will not obtain Sunny Bouquets if you have not reached Floor 300.

4.Rule: You will get extra Sunny Bouquets when you buy Blooming Branches from the Merchant's page.

1.Title: Nightmare Corridor
1.Rule: The Nightmare Corridor is available once every 7 days.

2.Rule: Nightmare Corridor is a region-divided cross-server event. All heroes within this game mode shall have a level of 480, their gear and tiers will remain unaffected. Heroes will not receive any Artifact effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Players may only use mercenaries, dimensional heroes and heroes which are within the Resonating Crystal.

4.Rule: Only one mercenary may be used per challenge within Nightmare Corridor. However, the number of times that a mercenary can be used is unlimited.

5.Rule: Faction effects of bosses rotate in each session.

6.Rule: Within each new Cursed Realm session, players are able to challenge bosses 10 times for free, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may challenge bosses a maximum of 199 times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

7.Rule: The final score of each challenge represents the number of Bosses killed and the time taken to do so. If no Bosses were killed, the final score would be the sum of all damage dealt by the team.

8.Rule: Only your best score after each Boss challenge will count towards your final ranking, which will be determined at the end of each session.

9.Rule: Results for Nightmare Corridor are calculated over 24 hours, during which you cannot partake in battles.

10.Rule: Leaderboard rewards for every Nightmare Corridor will be gradually sent to your inboxes at the end of each event.

1.Title: Dream Shadow Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Dream Shadow Leaderboard shows players' ranking on the Dream Ladder.

2.Rule: Rankings are predominantly based upon the time that players acquire avatar frames. If players are equally ranked in terms of frame quantities, the player with the highest overall Combat Rating will claim the higher ranking.

3.Rule: The Dream Ladder only shows the top 100 players.

1.Title: Nightmare Corridor Leaderboard
1.Rule: You can view the replay and formation of battles in which other players achieved their best scores.

2.Rule: The more Bosses you kill, the higher you rank. For the same number of Bosses killed, the player who takes the shorter time to do so ranks higher. Where no Bosses are killed, the higher the total damage dealt by all your teams, the higher you rank.

3.Rule: The Nightmare Corridor Leaderboard is dynamic. Top ranked players will enter the Legendary, Diamond and Gold ranks in turn.

4.Rule: If there are no players occupying the lower divisions of the leaderboard, then those divisions will not be viewable on the leaderboard.

5.Rule: Real-time rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

6.Rule: Individual Nightmare Corridor Leaderboard rewards will be gradually sent out via the mailbox once the season's rankings have been calculated.

1.Title: Nightmare Dashboard
1.Rule: The Nightmare Dashboard shows the Bosses players have fought in Nightmare Corridor and the Bosses that will be available in the future.

2.Rule: The Boss formation will be updated every 28 days, replacing expired Bosses with new ones.

1.Title: Quests
1.Rule: For every quest you complete, you will receive Dream Tokens, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Dream Store.

2.Rule: When the Boss formation is updated every 28 days, the quest will be refreshed as well, while all Dream Tokens will be reset to 0.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboards are divided into the Boss Challenge Leaderboard and the Resources Leaderboard.

2.Rule: The leaderboard displays real-time stats for players in the current session.

3.Rule: For the Boss Challenge, rankings prioritize damage dealt over time; guilds that haven't killed the boss are ranked by the total damage to the boss.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.
