14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

15.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Warm Reunion
1.Rule: The Warm Reunion event is open to all servers. Players in the test and official servers will share their progress separately.

2.Rule: You can help prepare the event once per day to receive a reward of 100, 150, or 288 diamonds.

3.Rule: Each time you help, you will randomly increase the preparation progress by 100, 300, or 500.

4.Rule: Each time the reunion is prepared to a certain level, all adventurers who have helped in its preparation will receive a reward.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within. Some quests have two goals, where you only need to achieve either one of them to complete the quest.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 6-20 can claim Maetria's Emoji in this interface.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Gourmelee
1.Rule: The "Gourmelee" event will run for 14 days. During the event, you can travel with Rosaline to various places to collect ingredients, create delicious culinary delights, and earn rewards.

2.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

3.Rule: Once the event starts, one new area can be unlocked and explored each day. The areas can only be explored in the order that they were unlocked.

4.Rule: While exploring, you can collect ingredients from different areas to prepare dishes. On your journey, you will occasionally encounter sous-chefs with different qualities. After joining your team, they can assist you in cooking.

5.Rule: While exploring the map, players can unlock an area's powerful enemies after completing the area's storyline, and then fight the powerful enemies.

6.Rule: While exploring the map, players can collect Heirlooms on the map. When fighting powerful enemies, each team of players can arm themselves with a maximum of three Heirlooms to increase their strength.

1.Title: Powerful Enemies
1.Rule: During the Boss challenge, heroes' levels will be standardized as Lvl 360, while their original tiers, gear, furniture, Signature Items, Eternal Engravings, and beast levels will be maintained. However, they cannot enjoy any Artifact attribute and effect bonuses.

2.Rule: When fighting Powerful Enemies, players can arm themselves with different Heirlooms to increase their team's strength. Heirlooms can be obtained when exploring different areas.

3.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

4.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies.

5.Rule: During the event, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

6.Rule: You can use one team of heroes when fighting an area's powerful enemies. You can use two teams of heroes when fighting the Final Powerful Enemy "Mezoth - Abysmal Butcher". The sum of the damage dealt by the two teams will be the final damage.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

8.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

9.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

10.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chests shall be sent out when the leaderboard is calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Delicacies Galore
1.Rule: Delicacies Galore will be unlocked during the Gourmelee event and run for 14 days.

2.Rule: You can complete Gourmelee quests to obtain Gourmet Coupons. The more Gourmet Coupons you acquire, the more rewards you can unlock.

3.Rule: Players who have unlocked Delicacies Galore that have not claimed all of their rewards 4 days prior to the end of the event can purchase Gourmet Coupons with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Delicacies Galore to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when Delicacies Galore ends.

1.Title: Chef's Challenge
1.Rule: During the event, you can acquire ingredients when exploring different areas, and then cook them.

2.Rule: Within the first 7 days of the event, 2 dishes will be unlocked on Day 1, and then 1 dish will be unlocked every day. However, the first dish must be completed before the next dish can be prepared.

3.Rule: While exploring the map, you will occasionally encounter sous-chefs with different qualities. After joining your team, they can assist you in cooking.

4.Rule: The dishes will be judged based on 4 criteria: Visual, Aroma, Health, and Creativity. Each dish has its own inherent characteristics. Before cooking, you can allocate 10 culinary focus points across the 4 criteria based on the dish's description. The more consistent the point allocation is with the dish's characteristics, the higher score you will get when cooking.

5.Rule: Each day, you will get 3 cooking chances to gain culinary experience, which can be carried forward. You can continue to cook after using up all your cooking chances, but you won't gain any experience.

6.Rule: You can reach the next culinary level by accumulating a certain amount of culinary experience. The higher your level and base culinary value, the higher your score gained while cooking.

7.Rule: There is a chance for a Critical Strike to occur during cooking. When this happens, you receive a higher culinary score.

8.Rule: The higher the final culinary points for a dish, the higher its rating. Ratings are defined as S, A, B, C, and D, from high to low. By achieving a higher culinary score and rating for your dish, you can complete the quest and receive a different reward.

9.Rule: Each dish has a hidden recipe. You can unlock it by using a specific focus point combination. You will receive diamonds after unlocking the recipe.

1.Title: Hero Swap Event
1.Rule: During the event, you may choose two heroes and swap their levels, Signature Items, Mythic Furniture, Eternal Engravings, and T3/T4 gear.

2.Rule: Non-T3/T4 gear worn by heroes and non-Mythic Tier furniture will not be swapped.

3.Rule: Heroes that can be swapped include non-Dimensional Heroes released in 2022 and earlier. Non-Ascended Tier Heroes cannot be swapped.

4.Rule: Swapped heroes will be removed from the Resonating Crystal. Heroes' Ascension Tiers may be altered as a result of hero swapping, which may result in these heroes being removed from certain in-game systems, which include but are not limited to the following systems: Abyssal Expedition, The Oak Inn, etc.

5.Rule: After swapping, all heroes to be replaced in your bag will be swapped with the target heroes.

6.Rule: Some systems and gameplay will refresh the swapped heroes' statuses in real-time, which include but are not limited to the following: Abyssal Aid, Soul Fusion, Temporal Rift, Legends' Championship, etc.

7.Rule: If you have not swapped any heroes during the event, you will instead receive 10,000 diamonds after the event ends.

8.Rule: The event entrance closes after swapping.

1.Title: Diver's Quest
1.Rule: During the event period, you can earn abundant Tracking Compasses from daily quests.

2.Rule: You can obtain abundant event chests as rewards, based on the total quantity of Tracking Compasses you have cumulatively acquired.

3.Rule: Tracking Compasses can be exchanged for different types of rewards. Exchanging Tracking Compasses will not affect the total quantity of Tracking compasses you have cumulatively acquired.

4.Rule: Unlock all Diver's Quest - Amethyst Chests to receive the following additional rewards: Limited Edition Diver's Quest Emojis; Limited Edition Chat Bubble - Surfer's Secret; Limited Edition Avatar Frame - Remnants of Glory.

1.Title: Forsaken Treasure
1.Rule: You can exchange Tracking Compasses for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

6.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

7.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Remaining Tracking Compasses will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Legacy of Grit
1.Rule: Once you reach Chapter 10, the Legacy of Grit event will be available the following day for 56 days.

2.Rule: During the event, you may spend 1 legacy chance to choose two heroes to pass legacies. After receiving the legacies, the two heroes will swap their levels, Signature Items, Mythic Furniture, Eternal Engravings, and T3/T4 gear.

3.Rule: During the event, you will receive 1 legacy chance after reaching 100 Weekly Activity Points each week. Weekly Activity Points can be earned by completing Weekly Quests and will be cleared when Weekly Quests are refreshed. A maximum of 4 legacy chances can be given during the event.

4.Rule: Non-T3/T4 gear worn by heroes and non-Mythic Tier furniture will not be swapped.

5.Rule: Awakened, Dimensional, and non-Ascended Tier heroes cannot receive legacies, nor can Wu Kong and Flora. New heroes also cannot receive legacies within 60 days of being launched.

6.Rule: Once a hero has received a legacy of grit, all legacy heroes in the bag and your inbox will be swapped with the target hero.

7.Rule: Heroes having received legacies of grit will be removed from the Resonating Crystal. This may cause their tiers to be altered and result in their removal from certain in-game systems, including but not limited to Abyssal Expedition and The Oak Inn.

8.Rule: Some systems and gameplay will refresh the heroes' statuses in real time. They include but are not limited to Abyssal Aid, Soul Fusion, Temporal Rift and Legends' Championship.

9.Rule: When a hero receives a legacy causing a change in their tier, the activation status of their Hero Union will also be refreshed. The Flawless Droplets that can be claimed in the Elder Tree will not change.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, you can claim Athalia - Harbinger of Truth's Emoji on this page by clearing Stage 6-20.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: 10th Anniversary Invite
1.Rule: During the 10th Anniversary Invite event, you will receive a Fidelia seedling. By completing certain quests, you can acquire Water Drops to cultivate Fidelia.

2.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Sprout and Bud phases, you will receive corresponding rewards.

3.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Bloom phase, you can send a letter inviting your favorite hero to join your team! (Only Celestial, Hypogean, and Four Factions heroes released before 2023 can be invited.)

1.Title: Memory Rewind
1.Rule: Memory Rewind allows you to select a battle record and restart the battle quickly.

2.Rule: The floor number that can be selected from each battle record is: any floor between the nearest floor number that is a multiple of 20 up to the highest floor in the battle record.

3.Rule: During a Memory Rewind, you can reselect the heroes in the Defense Force. However, the status of Badges, Divine Seals, and remaining Stability will remain the same as the floor in the record.

4.Rule: During a Memory Rewind, all the room effects from previous battles will be removed.

5.Rule: A maximum of 7 battle records can be saved. When a new battle record is added, the oldest record will be automatically deleted. Battle records are not retained across seasons.

6.Rule: Battle records can be saved as your favorites. These battle records will not be deleted automatically, and you can have up to 10 favorite records at a time.

7.Rule: During a battle, you must complete an entire floor before it can be saved in the battle record.

8.Rule: When a player's Temporal Beacon - Stability Amplifier level changes, the remaining Stability in their records will be adjusted accordingly. If their Stability is equal to or lower than 0 after the change, the battle cannot commence.

1.Title: Judgment Chronicles
1.Rule: Judgment Chronicles contain different events, each with unique battlefield effects.

2.Rule: Players can earn stars by completing the challenge goals of the stage. After earning a certain amount of stars, they can unlock the chest and claim the reward.

3.Rule: There are two types of stages in an event: key and normal stages. Players can attempt a key challenge repeatedly to earn more stars.

4.Rule: Players can claim one-off reward after completing the stage.

5.Rule: Taking challenges will reduce your available number of attempts shared among all events in Judgment Chronicles. Players' number of attempts is restored to 200 times every Monday at 00:00 UTC.

6.Rule: Trial heroes, short-term mercenaries, and Relief Forces cannot be used in Judgment Chronicles.

7.Rule: In Judgment Chronicles, all heroes are Level 360. Their gear is Mythic T2 and includes Faction Bonuses but is un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipped with Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

8.Rule: Artifacts cannot be used in Judgment Chronicles.

9.Rule: After the limited-time Judgment Decree activity for each event ends, the condition for unlocking the event will change to [Clear Stage 21-60]. Meanwhile, the enemies' difficulty of the event will also be reduced, after which its duration will be 168 days. If you have completed Stage 21-60 and have fewer than 56 days left, the duration will be reset to 56 days.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

12.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

13.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

19.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

20.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

1.Title: Reunion Order
1.Rule: The Reunion Order event lasts for 30 days.

2.Rule: During the event, you can acquire Medal of Calling by completing the quests in Reunion Order, to increase the level of Reunion Order and earn bountiful rewards.

3.Rule: The quests of Reunion Order are unlocked gradually over time. You will be rewarded after completing all quests during the event.

4.Rule: Unclaimed rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the end of Reunion Order.

5.Rule: You can purchase a Courage Badge or Valiance Badge for more rewards.

6.Rule: Unlocking a Courage Badge or Valiance Badge grants you VIP Experience of an equivalent value.

1.Title: The Dreamy Garden
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within. Some quests have two goals, where you only need to achieve either one of them to complete the quest.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: You can acquire a Reward Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Fun in the Wild
1.Rule: Fun in the Wild will be available for a total of 7 days.

2.Rule: During the event, you can claim a free Fun Bundle or purchase not more than one paid Fun Bundle to receive Fun Feed daily.

3.Rule: Acquired Fun Feed will be used automatically. Each Fun Feed will advance Aix for one tile.

4.Rule: When Aix reaches the end point, you will receive a reward of 5000 diamonds; While passing through other tiles you will draw a reward from the random prize pool at a moderate chance.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

15.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, you can claim Safiya - Maestro of Power's Emoji on this page by clearing Stage 6-20.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Treasure Hunt Camp
1.Rule: A single Treasure Hunt Camp season lasts for 10 days. Players can create their team formations 1 day before the season begins.

2.Rule: All heroes shall have a level of 360, with their gear and tiers unaffected. They will not receive any Artifact attribute and effect bonuses.

3.Rule: Trial heroes and Short-Term Mercenaries cannot be used in Treasure Hunt Camp.

4.Rule: Treasure Hunt Camp is in division-based game mode, which is divided into 6 separate divisions that are based on Prestige.

5.Rule: During the event, players will need to dispatch heroes to defeat other players so that they can acquire Prestige. Prestige is used to increase a player's division, and allows them to enter more advanced treasure hunting areas.

6.Rule: Heroes that are currently out searching for treasure will only encounter heroes from players that are currently in the same division.

7.Rule: In divisions below Gilt Silver, players can only compete with other players that are on the same route. After reaching the Gilt Silver division, players will compete against players on other routes.

8.Rule: During the event, the number of teams that can be dispatched increases as a player reaches higher divisions.

9.Rule: During the event, your individual teams will explore and battle independently of one another. Each team can encounter enemies up to 100 times per day.

10.Rule: After players have confirmed their participation in the event, their configured teams shall begin treasure hunting every day at UTC 02:00 and UTC 14:00. Players can adjust their teams at any time within the season. Team adjustments will take effect as of the next treasure hunt.

11.Rule: After heroes have been dispatched, their statuses shall remain locked. Combat calculations are based on the stats the heroes have at the time they are dispatched.

12.Rule: If a team formation is empty at the time of dispatch, the formation shall be automatically filled by the system.

13.Rule: After each search team has finished a battle, players shall receive random exploration rewards based on the division the player was currently in when they encountered an enemy. All exploration rewards shall be sent out to players the following day of the event, and can be claimed automatically when the player enters the Treasure Hunt Camp event page. Exploration rewards are only retained for 2 days, so please claim them in good time.

14.Rule: If you become eligible for a Scramble Invite in the Treasure Hunt Camp, you may enter Treasure Scramble the next time you participate in the Treasure Hunt Camp. The rewards are more attractive and the competition is more intense in Treasure Scramble. You cannot return to Treasure Hunt Camp once entering Treasure Scramble.

1.Title: Shadow Invasions
1.Rule: Once the player clears Stages 2-10 and meets the requirements, they will be able to play "Endless Trials".

2.Rule: The "Endless Trials" stage lasts until the player is defeated. Points will be calculated based on the number of enemies killed and the completion of other objectives. Depending on the heroes used, different heroes' highest scores will be included and ranked on the leaderboard.

3.Rule: Each hero's highest score for "Endless Trials" will be cleared after Shadow Invasions is adjusted or updated. After that, players can explore and complete the challenge again.

1.Title: Haunting Dreamscape
1.Rule: Adventurers that have completed Campaign Stage 15-40 can participate in the event.

2.Rule: During the event, the heroes available to you are provided by the system and are not affected by your own hero training.

3.Rule: You must deploy Ezizh - Lord of Nightmares in the event.

4.Rule: After starting the game, you will possess a certain amount of Lives, and you must challenge 8 enemies. 1 Life will be deducted if you fail or quit a battle.

5.Rule: The game ends once you win the battle against 8 enemies or you lose all Lives.

6.Rule: You can re-start the game during the event.

7.Rule: After each victory, Ezizh - Lord of Nightmares is automatically leveled up and you can choose to activate one of the two talent skills for him. The talent skills available depend on the enemy defeated.

8.Rule: After each victory, you may enlist one of the four heroes provided by the system in your own formation. If the hero already exists in your formation, they can be ascended. Each hero can be ascended up to once at a maximum.

9.Rule: At the end of each game, the talent skill, hero, and hero tier selected by you are reset.

10.Rule: During the event, you can complete achievement challenges to earn Achievement Points and unlock rewards.

11.Rule: Achievement progress is only calculated at the end of each game.

1.Title: Quick Buy
1.Rule: Upon clearing Stage 30-60, the preorder list function will be available.

2.Rule: You can add your desired items to the preorder list.

3.Rule: After setting is completed, a Quick Buy button will appear on the store interface.

4.Rule: Tap Quick Buy to automatically buy all items on the preorder list that appear on the store interface.

1.Title: Mythic Prophecy
1.Rule: During the event, you will have 1 stargazing attempt every day.

2.Rule: After stargazing, you can head for the corresponding location on the map under the Stargazer's guidance to look for Fragments of Fate.

3.Rule: For every Fragment of Fate you collect, a corresponding story fragment will be unlocked and the corresponding Prophecy Realm will be lit.

4.Rule: You will receive rewards based on the number of fragments you collect.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

12.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

13.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

19.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

20.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

21.Rule: If you choose Sweep, you will skip the battle and directly see the battle result.

22.Rule: In Sweep, if you check the auto-matching option, you will be automatically matched with opponents for consecutive challenges until you run out of reward-claiming attempts for the day.

1.Title: Guild Treasure Hunt
1.Rule: Each Guild Treasure Hunt season lasts for 3 days. Players can create their team formations 1 day before the season begins.

2.Rule: Players are divided into Treasure Hunters and Battle Stars in the Guild Treasure Hunt. Players with a Combat Rating in the top 5 of the guild will become Battle Stars by default. A Battle Star can be replaced if the player is willing to vacate the position while another player has applied to fill it with the approval of the Guild Master. Replacements can only be made before the season begins.

3.Rule: Treasure Hunters can add different attributes for the guild's Battle Stars by escorting supplies, investigating intel, and occupying treasures.

4.Rule: Battle Stars earn Prestige by defeating Battle Stars from other guilds. The guild's points and ranking are based on its Battle Stars' Prestige and rankings.

5.Rule: When out for an operation, your heroes will only be matched with heroes of the same operation from other guilds.

6.Rule: During the Guild Treasure Hunt, each of your teams will explore and battle independently. Treasure Hunters will fight each Treasure Hunter from other guilds once on the same operation. Each Battle Stars' team can encounter enemies up to 100 times per day.

7.Rule: After you have participated in the event, your configured formation will be dispatched every day at 02:00, 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 UTC, subject to the actual operation undertaken. You can adjust your team formation at any time for the next dispatch within the season.

8.Rule: After heroes have been dispatched, their statuses remain locked. Combat calculations are based on the heroes' stats at the time they are dispatched.

9.Rule: Rewards in the Guild Treasure Hunt consist of Personal Quest rewards, Guild Rank rewards, and Fortune Chest rewards.

10.Rule: Guild rank rewards will be sent via mail after the season ends.

1.Title: Guild Treasure Hunt Leaderboard
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are determined by the Prestige of Battle Stars.

2.Rule: The rankings fluctuate daily, and are subject to daily battles. Final rank rewards are determined by the final calculation.

3.Rule: Rank rewards will be mailed as and when they have been calculated.

1.Title: Operation Rules
1.Rule: After you have confirmed an operation, it will be carried out once at 02:00, 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 UTC respectively. Automatic operations will cease thereafter, and to undertake more operations, you need to dispatch your team again.

1.Title: Guild Points
1.Rule: Guild points are the sum of the individual points of all Battle Stars in that guild.

2.Rule: A Battle Stars member's individual points are the sum of their Prestige and additional leaderboard points.

1.Title: Chrono Strife
1.Rule: Chrono Strife is a server-wide, faction-based competitive event in which players must join either the Celestial or Hypogean faction, and then, during the Conflict Phase and Decisive Battle phase, players will fight to secure victory for their faction.

2.Rule: The event lasts for 15 days. Day 1 is the Enrollment Phase, followed by two rounds of the Conflict Phase and Decisive Battle phase. Once these phases end, the Battle Review Phase will begin. Players who have not joined a faction within the first 14 days will be unable to participate in the Battle Review Phase.

3.Rule: During this event, all heroes will be Lvl 360 and are equipped with Mythic T1 gear without bonus attributes by default. Hero tiers and Signature Items will not be changed.

4.Rule: The Conflict Phase lasts for several days, during which your main objective is to collect Chaos Fragments via Wild Adventures.

5.Rule: When the Conflict Phase ends and settlement begins, every player who has obtained a Chaos Fragment will receive settlement rewards for that phase. The faction that holds more Chaos Fragments will gain tiered benefits, with extra rewards at settlement.

6.Rule: During the Conflict Phase, you can also get Core Components from Wild Adventures, which you can use to repair Chrono Cores in coordination with other members of your faction. Each Chrono Core repaired will grant all players of your faction a reward.

7.Rule: Wild Adventures have a chance to trigger various events, and players will receive different amounts of Conflict Phase supplies based on the choices they make during these events. During adventures, there is a very low chance of triggering a Phantom. Once triggered, all players of that faction can challenge it to earn extra Chaos Fragments.

8.Rule: When the Conflict Phase ends, all Chaos Fragments will be reset to zero and the Decisive Battle phase will begin. This phase lasts for several days, during which the main objective is to collect Time Gemcores.

9.Rule: During the Decisive Battle phase, destroy the enemy's Chrono Cores to obtain Time Gemcores. Both factions will compete on a three-laned battlefield to destroy each other's Chrono Cores.

10.Rule: When the Decisive Battle phase ends, every player who participated will receive settlement rewards for that phase. The faction with more Time Gemcores will be declared the ultimate winner, and will receive extra rewards. The rewards received by both factions will also differ depending on which faction won.

11.Rule: During the Decisive Battle phase, on each Chrono Strife lane, battlefields will appear between each pair of adjacent Chrono Cores. Players can move between battlefields depending on the situation and engage in combat with players from the opposing faction.

12.Rule: Players can earn Battle Fervor by challenging enemies on the battlefield, and the stronger the enemy, the more Battle Fervor gained. At the daily battlefield settlement, the faction with more Battle Fervor will win the battlefield on that lane, destroying the adjacent enemy Chrono Cores on that lane. If all Chrono Cores on a lane have been destroyed by a faction and that faction is still the winner of that lane's battlefield at the time of daily settlement, that faction will not gain any more Time Gemcores.

13.Rule: During the Decisive Battle phase, monsters will appear in Chrono Strife, and players of both factions can challenge them.

14.Rule: Each monster challenge lasts for 1 day. The top 200 players of each faction, ranked by damage dealt to a specific monster, will have their damage summed to determine the total damage for their faction. At settlement each day, the faction with the higher total damage for each monster will receive Time Gemcores.

16.Rule: After the Decisive Battle phase ends, the Battle Review phase will begin. Combat on all 3 lanes will stop, and Chrono Cores will stop producing Time Gemcores. During this phase, players of both factions can view the final results of Chrono Strife and claim their rewards.

1.Title: Contribution Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Contribution Leaderboard contains both Conflict Phase Contribution Rankings and Decisive Battle Contribution Rankings. Only players of your faction will be displayed.

2.Rule: Conflict Phase Contribution Rankings will rank players based on the total number of Chaos Fragments they obtained during the Conflict Phase.

3.Rule: In the Decisive Battle Contribution Rankings, players are ranked by the total Battle Fervor they've obtained from all lane battlefields in Final Duels during the Decisive Battle phase.

1.Title: Wild Adventures
1.Rule: During the Conflict Phase, players can embark on Wild Adventures to earn Chaos Fragments and Core Components.

2.Rule: Wild Adventures have a chance to trigger various events, and players will receive different amounts of rewards based on the choices they make during these events. During adventures, there is a very low chance of triggering a phantom. Once triggered, all players of that faction can challenge it to earn extra Chaos Fragments.

3.Rule: Wild Adventures consumes adventure attempts. You receive a certain number of attempts each day, and starting an adventure uses 1 attempt. Adventures are performed continuously. If you have attempts remaining, the next adventure will begin automatically. You may tap Exit to return to the preparation page, but any events already triggered will remain unchanged.

4.Rule: After you have joined Wild Adventures a specified number of times, you receive the corresponding rewards. You cannot continue Wild Adventures once you have entered the Decisive Battle stage. All your unclaimed Wild Adventures rewards will be sent to you via mail.

1.Title: Phantom Hunt
1.Rule: During Wild Adventures, players have a very low chance to trigger a phantom, including Phantom - The Wailing Widow, Phantom - The Astral Oracle, Phantom - The Dark Crow, and Phantom - The Cursebearer. Different phantoms may be triggered multiple times.

2.Rule: After a phantom is triggered, all players in the faction can challenge it. Each phantom grants a fixed number of challenge attempts per player, and attempts are not shared between different phantoms. Phantoms with the same name triggered at different times do not share challenge attempts.

3.Rule: A triggered phantom exists until it is defeated. Multiple phantoms may exist at the same time, during which you can tap the Switch button to challenge a different phantom.

4.Rule: After a challenge ends, you receive a certain number of Chaos Fragments based on the damage you dealt to the phantom.

1.Title: Monster Challenge
1.Rule: On days 2 and 3 of the Decisive Battle phase, the monster "Soul Hound" and the monster boss "Mask Curator" will appear in the Chaotic Timeline, and players of both factions may proceed to challenge them.

2.Rule: After each monster appears, players from both forces have one day to challenge it. The monster disappears the following day. You have 10 free challenge attempts against each monster, and may spend Diamonds to gain more attempts. Each battle consumes one challenge attempt.

3.Rule: If you achieve a certain damage value during a single Monster Challenge, you receive the corresponding individual rewards.

4.Rule: The top 200 players of each faction, ranked by damage dealt to a specific monster, will have their damage summed to determine the total damage for their faction. At settlement each day, the faction with the higher total damage for each monster will receive Time Gemcores.

5.Rule: Players can deploy 1 team of heroes to challenge monsters. When challenging bosses, each player can deploy 2 teams, and their combined damage output will determine the final total damage.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: On the Monster Challenge Leaderboard, you are ranked based on the highest damage you dealt to each monster. The Leaderboard displays players rankings from both forces.

2.Rule: On the Monster Challenge Leaderboard, you can view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: The Monster Challenge Leaderboard is tallied at the same time as the results calculation for each Monster Challenge.

1.Title: Final Duel
1.Rule: During the Decisive Battle phase, on each Chaotic Timeline lane, battlefields will appear between each pair of adjacent Chrono Cores. Players can move between battlefields depending on the situation and engage in combat with players from the opposing faction.

2.Rule: Final Duel consumes challenge attempts. Each day, you have a fixed amount of challenge attempts. Each Final Duel consumes 1 attempt. Your attempts are shared across all three battlefields. You may choose any battlefield path for your challenge.

3.Rule: In a battlefield, you may challenge an enemy of either a high-, medium-, or low-level CMBR. After a challenge ends, 3 new enemies are produced through a refresh. You can also refresh your enemies manually. Each day, you have a fixed number of refresh, and may spend Diamonds to gain more refresh attempts.

4.Rule: After challenging and winning against a high-CMBR-level enemy for 2 consecutive times, your 3 enemies' CMBR level will increase in the next refresh. After challenging and losing against a low-CMBR-level enemy for 2 consecutive times, your 3 enemies' CMBR level will drop in the next refresh.

5.Rule: You can acquire Battle Fervor by challenging enemies in a battlefield. The Battle Fervor you earn depends on whether you win the battle. The more powerful the enemy challenged, the higher Battle Fervor you receive, regardless of whether you win or lose the battle.

6.Rule: The cumulative Battle Fervor earned by each player of a faction in a battlefield constitutes the total Battle Fervor of the faction for that battlefield.

7.Rule: At the daily battlefield settlement, the faction with more total Battle Fervor will win the battlefield on that lane, destroying the adjacent enemy Chrono Cores on that lane.

8.Rule: If all enemy Chrono Cores on a lane have been destroyed by a faction and that faction is still the winner of that lane's battlefield at the time of daily settlement, that faction will not gain any more Time Gemcores.

9.Rule: After you have joined Final Duel for a specified number of times, you receive the corresponding rewards. You cannot continue Final Duel once you have entered the battle review stage. All your unclaimed Final Duel rewards will be sent to you via mail.

1.Title: Strife of Chaos
1.Rule: Strife of Chaos starts during War of Truth and lasts for 14 days.

2.Rule: You can earn Medals of Merit by completing quests in War of Truth. The more Medals of Merit received, the greater the rewards unlocked.

3.Rule: The quests are restricted to specific stages. A showdown quest cannot be completed earlier in the battle preparation stage, while a non-completed preparation quest cannot continue in the showdown stage.

4.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Strife of Chaos and have yet to claim all your rewards 4 days before the end of Strife of Chaos, you may purchase Medals of Merit with Diamonds.

5.Rule: Purchase and unlock Strife of Chaos to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

6.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed by the player will be sent to the player's mailbox when Strife of Chaos ends.

1.Title: Strife of Chaos
1.Rule: Strife of Chaos starts during War of Truth and lasts for 14 days.

2.Rule: You can earn Medals of Merit by completing quests in War of Truth. The more Medals of Merit received, the greater the rewards unlocked.

3.Rule: The quests are restricted to specific stages. A showdown quest cannot be completed earlier in the battle preparation stage, while a non-completed preparation quest cannot continue in the showdown stage.

4.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Strife of Chaos and have yet to claim all your rewards 4 days before the end of Strife of Chaos, you may purchase Medals of Merit with Diamonds.

5.Rule: Purchase and unlock Strife of Chaos to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

6.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed by the player will be sent to the player's mailbox when Strife of Chaos ends.

1.Title: Chaos Codex
1.Rule: The Chaos Codex will be activated during the Chrono Strife event, and lasts for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can obtain Time Engravings by completing quests in Chrono Strife. The more Time Engravings you collect, the more rewards you will unlock.

3.Rule: Different quests have phase restrictions. Decisive Battle quests cannot be completed during the Conflict Phase, and quests not completed during the Conflict Phase cannot be continued during the Decisive Battle phase.

4.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked the Chaos Codex but have not claimed all your rewards within the 4 days before it ends, you can purchase Time Engravings with diamonds.

5.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Chaos Codex ends.

1.Title: Mystic Backup
1.Rule: The Mystic Backup event lasts for a total of 12 days.

2.Rule: During Mystic Backup, you can collect points by completing various quests, and unlock certain rewards once you have gathered a specific number of points. The highest reward is the Mystic Backup Coupon, which can be used to redeem a free Celestial and Hypogean-themed bundle.

3.Rule: During Mystic Backup, after participating in War of Truth and then re-opening the Mystic Backup page, you will receive a Mystic Backup 50% Discount Coupon, which can be used to purchase a Celestial and Hypogean-themed bundle at half-price.

4.Rule: Mystic Backup Coupons and Mystic Backup 50% Discount Coupons can only be used in Mystic Backup, and not more than once.

5.Rule: Celestial and Hypogean-themed bundles can be purchased for unlimited times.

1.Title: Journal
1.Rule: While participating in Wild Adventures in the battle preparation stage or Final Duel in the showdown stage, you can acquire Tattered Pages.

2.Rule: Each tattered page acquired unlocks part of the contents of Eugene's Journal or The Metallurgist's Diary in the journal, which reveal clues about unknown pasts in Cradle of Truth.

3.Rule: After War of Truth ends, regardless of your progress in the event, all contents of Eugene's Journal and The Metallurgist's Diary are unlocked and recorded in the Library's "Echoes of Time" feature.

1.Title: Battle Report
1.Rule: Battle Reports display combat information for the previous day, including changes in both factions' Time Gemcores, Chrono Core ownership changes, and defeated monsters (if any monsters were defeated in the Chaotic Timeline).

2.Rule: The winning faction of a battlefield conflict will destroy the enemy faction's adjacent Chrono Cores on that lane. If all Chrono Cores on a lane have been destroyed by a faction and that faction is still the winner of that lane's battlefield at the time of daily settlement, that faction will not gain any more Time Gemcores.

3.Rule: During the Decisive Battle phase, monsters will appear in the Chaotic Timeline. The faction that defeats more monsters will receive extra Time Gemcores.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Celestial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Antiquity Stones. When Antiquity Stones are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Crit, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Antiquity Stones respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Antiquity Stones can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 42k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Rule: Players can exchange Antiquity Stones for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

3.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

4.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

6.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

7.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

14.Rule: Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

1.Title: The Lost Spire
1.Rule: Adventurers that have completed Campaign Stage 3-36 can participate in the event.

2.Rule: During the event, you may manually claim 1 Quest Supplement every day, which contains 200 Spire Tokens and 5 Adventure Torches.

3.Rule: One Quest Supplement is placed every 24 hours, up to a maximum amount of 3. Once limit is reached, supplements will no longer be placed until manually claimed.

4.Rule: The system assigns you default heroes, who can be deployed, trained, or otherwise operated in the session.

5.Rule: You may deploy a Legendary or higher-tier hero. During the session, your hero tier is maintained while other hero stats are standardized as a fixed value.

6.Rule: For each floor cleared, 1 Adventure Torch will be consumed and you will receive the Spire Tokens provided by that floor, while unlocking the next floor to challenge.

7.Rule: While clearing each floor for the first time, you may complete the relevant quest to earn a 1st Time Reward.

8.Rule: A floor can be challenged repeatedly. A successful challenge consumes your Adventure Torches and grants you Spire Tokens provided by the floor; failed attempts do not consume Adventure Torches.

9.Rule: You may spend Spire Tokens to unlock hero deployment.

10.Rule: Once deployment is unlocked, you may select heroes to be deployed. Thereafter, you are not allowed to switch to other heroes in this event.

11.Rule: You may spend Spire Tokens to boost the Engravings, Furniture, and exclusive abilities of deployed heroes within the event.

12.Rule: Boss challenges do not consume Adventure Torches. A boss can be challenged repeatedly.

13.Rule: Once the damage dealt to the boss reaches the required level, you can then complete the relevant quest to win challenge rewards.

14.Rule: During the event, your highest recorded damage dealt in a boss challenge will count towards your final ranking. The rankings are for record purposes only, and do not carry any real rewards.

1.Title: Lost Spire Leaderboard
1.Rule: You must clear Stage 24 to challenge the boss.

2.Rule: Boss challenges do not consume Adventure Torches. A boss can be challenged repeatedly.

3.Rule: Once the damage dealt to the boss reaches the required level, you can then complete the relevant quest to win challenge rewards.

4.Rule: During the event, your highest recorded damage dealt in a boss challenge will count towards your final ranking.

5.Rule: The rankings are for reference only and do not carry any rewards.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, you can claim The Dawnbringer Emoji on this page by clearing Stage 6-20.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Frosty Treasures
1.Rule: During the event, you can switch to any Treasure Layer and spend Ice Scrolls to draw rewards. The sizes and rewards of Cool Layer, Chilly Layer, and Frigid Layer are all different.

2.Rule: A Treasure Layer consists of Treasure Cells and Snowflake Cells. A Treasure Cell will be illuminated into a Snowflake Cell when the reward inside is drawn.

3.Rule: When you start exploration, the cells in Treasure Layers will be arranged randomly, after which Treasure Cells and Snowflake Cells will stay in place.

4.Rule: The rewards of Treasure Cells are divided into Exploration Rewards (blue background) and Insight Rewards (diamond background).

5.Rule: With Ice Scrolls, you can draw Exploration Rewards in Treasure Cells from Treasure Layers.

6.Rule: Once all Treasure Cells containing Exploration Rewards on a horizontal or vertical straight line in a Layer have all been illuminated into Snowflake Cells, you will receive the Insight Reward on the same line.

7.Rule: After the event ends, any remaining Ice Scrolls will be used automatically to draw rewards randomly according to the sequence of the Cool Layer, Chilly Layer, and Frigid Layer. If there are Ice Scrolls remaining after all rewards have been drawn, they will be recalled for 50,000 Gold Coins each.

1.Title: Snowmelt Bundle
1.Rule: During the event, purchase Snowmelt Bundles to receive Ice Scrolls, which can be used to draw rewards from Treasure Layers.

2.Rule: Remaining Ice Scrolls will be automatically used to draw rewards after the event ends.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within. Some quests have two goals, where you only need to achieve either one of them to complete the quest.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes as well as the Labyrinth's Rickety Cart heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Each small multi-formation stage victory within the Dismal Maze will be calculated individually.

6.Rule: "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" type quests will not be increased as a result of using the "Quick Battle" function in the Dismal Maze's Abyssal Aid event.

7.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

12.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

13.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

19.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

20.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

21.Rule: If you choose Sweep, you will skip the battle and directly see the battle result.

22.Rule: In Sweep, if you check the auto-matching option, you will be automatically matched with opponents for consecutive challenges until you run out of reward-claiming attempts for the day.

1.Title: Emoji
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 6-20 can claim the Awakened Hero Emojis in this interface.

2.Rule: After claiming the Emojis, please restart the game to enable them.

3.Rule: To use Emojis, please go to the Chat interface.

1.Title: Nocturnal Rhymes
1.Rule: Nocturnal Rhymes will commence during the Noctis Animarum Festival, and will run for 14 days.

2.Rule: Complete quests in the Noctis Animarum Festival to acquire Prank Candy. The more Prank Candy earned, the greater the rewards unlocked.

4.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Nocturnal Rhymes, and have not claimed all your rewards within the 4 days before the end of Nocturnal Rhymes, you may purchase Prank Candy with diamonds.

5.Rule: Purchase and unlock Nocturnal Rhymes to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

6.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Nocturnal Rhymes ends.

1.Title: Regal Rewards
1.Rule: Regal Rewards become available 8 days after the creation of a new account profile.

2.Rule: The Regal Rewards event has a duration of 35 days.

3.Rule: More Regal Rewards can be unlocked by using Medals of Valor, which can be acquired from the 'Dailies' and 'Weeklies' quest chests.

4.Rule: Any claimable Regal Rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Regal Rewards system is reset.

5.Rule: Each time a player claims their Regal Rewards for the first time in a round, (including free and premium rewards) they are able to choose a reward type of their own preference by tapping the "Change" button.

6.Rule: Players that have unlocked the Premium Pass may use Diamonds to purchase Medals of Valor in order to acquire any uncollected rewards 4 days prior to the Regal Rewards' reset date.

7.Rule: Unlocking the Premium Pass will reward you with 1630 VIP experience points.

8.Rule: Premium passes are active for the duration of one payment cycle and are not permanent.

9.Rule: After purchasing the Regal Rewards Premium Pass you may purchase the Deluxe Pass to receive an additional type of reward. Selected rewards cannot be chosen twice.

1.Title: This Month's Honorable Heroes
1.Rule: Honorable Heroes will include all Awakened, Celestial and Hypogean heroes, and some Elite heroes whose initial tier is Elite.

2.Rule: The list of "some Elite heroes whose initial tier is Elite" will be refreshed on the 1st of each month at 00:00 UTC.

3.Rule: The range of heroes that can be summoned with Honorable Elite Hero Soulstones is based on the current list of "This Month's Honorable Heroes".

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 20% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 500 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

4.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

7.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

8.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

9.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

13.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

15.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Mystic Starzone
1.Rule: This is a beta season of Mystic Starzone with a total of 3 battles.

2.Rule: Each round of battle consists of an enrollment stage, a matching stage, and a 3-day combat stage. For the specific dates, please refer to the events calendar.

3.Rule: The event has 3 stages: enrollment, matching, and combat. After a battle ends, the next enrollment phase commences.

4.Rule: All heroes in the event shall have a level of 480, with their gear and tiers unaffected. They will not receive any Artifact attribute and effect bonuses.

5.Rule: Trial heroes and short-term mercenaries cannot be used during the event.

6.Rule: In Mystic Starzone, you will be matched with other players according to your enrollment. Every 70 players will form one militia, and four militias will battle each other on one map for the best ranking.

7.Rule: Three different levels of Meteorite Ores will be generated randomly on the map. After defeating the guard or other occupying players, you can then start mining and earn points over time.

8.Rule: You can only occupy 1 Meteorite Ore at a time. If you successfully occupy another Meteorite Ore, you will automatically abandon the one you've occupied.

9.Rule: You can mine for 3 hours per day. Once the time has elapsed, you can no longer occupy any Meteorite Ore, but you can attack other enemy militia players who are still mining.

10.Rule: Each Meteorite Ore has a certain time limit for mining and will disappear when depleted. You can then search for a new Meteorite Ore to continue mining.

11.Rule: Each time you successfully occupy a Meteorite Ore, you earn a 15-minute protection period, during which you cannot be attacked and your enemies cannot see your defensive formations.

12.Rule: Once you have left a Meteorite Ore, it cannot be occupied by anyone within your militia for 5 minutes.

13.Rule: 1 challenge point will be consumed to launch an attack. Your challenge points recover over time, at 1 point every 30 minutes. During the combat phase, your points are reset to 10 each day at 0:00 UTC+0.

14.Rule: All content in this event is for the beta season. Changes may be made for the official season.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: On the leaderboard, you will be ranked in real time based on your militia members' score and the enemies they have slayed in battles.

2.Rule: The Victory Rankings record the number of times players have defeated enemies in each battle. Battles triggered from "Request Help" are not taken into account.

3.Rule: The Score Rankings display the total accumulated points earned by players from each battle.

4.Rule: The leaderboards are for your reference only, and there will be no rewards.

1.Title: Help
1.Rule: If your Meteorite Ore is occupied by an enemy, you can send help requests to other militia members via the Help Request system.

2.Rule: If the helper defeats the target enemy guarding the Meteorite Ore, the requester can directly return to the Ore and continue mining.

3.Rule: You can only send up to 3 help requests at a time.

4.Rule: You can help up to 5 players per day. If you fail to help the requester reclaim their Meteorite Ore, this quota will not be deducted.

5.Rule: During the test season, the target attacked by a helper will be temporarily unable to launch attacks while in the protection period. This mechanism will be optimized in subsequent versions.

1.Title: Treasure Vault
1.Rule: You can acquire treasure chests by completing quests. The treasure chests will be transferred into the Treasure Vault.

2.Rule: Once this event has ended, you can open treasure chests to receive abundant random rewards.

3.Rule: The treasure chests displayed on the page are all those that you can personally acquire after the event ended.

4.Rule: The treasure chests, as the ranking rewards, will be issued after this round of the event ends and the militia rankings are confirmed. You will be notified via the mailbox once they are issued.

5.Rule: The reward treasure chests can only be opened on the exclusive event page. Once the final round of the test season has ended, the event will continue to be available for a duration for players to claim and unlock the treasure chests. Once the event has fully ended, any locked treasure chest can no longer be opened again.

1.Title: Challenge Quests
1.Rule: Your militia will receive many extra points if you and your militia members complete a challenge quest together.

2.Rule: Your individual score will not be affected by the points received for challenge quests.

3.Rule: A challenge quest has multiple stages. The higher the stage, the more difficult it is—the more points rewarded.

1.Title: Trails of Mystery
1.Rule: You can participate in this event by completing Stage 6-4.

2.Rule: During the event, you receive four daily clues. Combine any two clues and analyze them to draw a relevant inference.

3.Rule: Each day, there is a key inference that points to the truth. You are deemed to have completed the day's investigation if you have found the key inference for the day, for which you will receive rewards.

4.Rule: You are to complete four days of investigation to gradually reveal the truth of the case.

1.Title: Ghoulish Gallery
1.Rule: You can unlock Ghoulish Gallery after reaching Chapter 6. By exploring the Gallery, you can acquire Collections from the Hypogean to equip your heroes.

2.Rule: The Collections can replace heroes' original Artifacts and can be used in most battle environments. Each Collection has its own unique effects and can be enhanced with abilities.

3.Rule: You have 7 chances weekly to enter and explore the Gallery. In each exploration, you can choose the Collections you desire, and upgrade and enhance them while exploring.

4.Rule: Each time you enter the Gallery, you can spend up to 3 Bizarre Totems to increase your exploration gains, which will grant you more powerful Collections at the end of the exploration.

1.Title: Gallery Quests
1.Rule: You must recruit new heroes in the Gallery and select unions to strengthen your exploration team. Your acquired heroes and unions cannot be taken out of the Gallery after an exploration.

2.Rule: There are a total of 10 floors in the Gallery. After exploring all floors, you will receive the desired collection.

3.Rule: Losing a battle lowers your Invisibility, drawing Hypogean attention. At 0 Invisibility, you're discovered and the exploration ends. You can also end your exploration manually.

4.Rule: You can obtain abilities by defeating enemies in battle. Abilities can enhance Collections after the exploration.

1.Title: Etch
1.Rule: After each exploration, you can etch your collection and enhance them through abilities.

2.Rule: Each collection has 3 Attack Slots, 3 Defense Slots, and 1 Common Slot. The Slots are unlocked depending on the collection's level.

3.Rule: You can etch Attack Abilities on Attack Slots, Defense Abilities on Defense Slots, and any abilities on Common Slots.

4.Rule: After being etched, a collection cannot be changed or enhanced by any other means.

1.Title: Mystic Cage
1.Rule: In the Mystic Cage, you can use an Arcane Staff to draw a Bizarre Totem.

2.Rule: You can unlock your wishlist after making 200 draws. Once unlocked, you can add up to 4 types of Bizarre Totems of the Mythic tier to your wishlist.

3.Rule: While your Wishlist is active, your acquired Bizarre Totems of the Mythic tier will be the selected Bizarre Totems in your Wishlist.

4.Rule: Your Wishlist activation attempts are refreshed weekly. Unused attempts cannot be carried over to the next week.

5.Rule: For every 80 draws, you automatically obtain a Custom Totem Scroll, which can be used to customize any type of Bizarre Totem of the Mythic tier.

1.Title: Guild
1.Rule: Each guild member will earn 1 guild EXP for every activity point they earn.

2.Rule: Your guild will level up once it has accumulated enough EXP.

3.Rule: As your guild levels up, more guild perks will be unlocked, including an upgraded Guild Store, guild administrator titles, and an increased capacity for guild members.

4.Rule: As your Guild Store levels up, superior items will become available.

5.Rule: You cannot join a new guild for 1 hour after leaving the guild.

1.Title: Arena of Heroes
1.Rule: The daily settlement time for the Arena of Sol and Arena of Luna is different. All daily rewards will be sent to players via mail.

2.Rule: When an arena is closed, it enters a dormant state. Players are unable to configure their lineups in the dormant arena. The dormant state concludes after the next settlement.

3.Rule: Martial Rating is applied to heroes in the Arena of Heroes.

4.Rule: If the attacker defeats a player of a higher rank, their ranks will be swapped.

5.Rule: The attacker fails if the battle times out.

6.Rule: Adventurers have 5 free challenge attempts per day, which are reset after the daily calculation.

7.Rule: One-time rank rewards will be available when an adventurer's all-time highest ranking reaches a certain threshold.

1.Title: Twisted Realm
1.Rule: Martial Rating is applied to heroes in the Twisted Realm.

2.Rule: There are 10 floors for each boss. Kill each floor's boss to claim the clearance rewards and unlock the next floor.

3.Rule: After the boss is killed at Floor 10, it will activate an Infinite Floor where it has infinite health and cannot be killed.

4.Rule: Bosses will stack attributes and grow stronger every time a certain amount of their health is lost.

5.Rule: Within each new Twisted Realm session, players are able to challenge bosses 5 times for free, after which the expenditure of diamonds will be required in order to continue challenging bosses. Players may challenge bosses a maximum of 99 times per session. One battle challenge attempt will be deducted each time a player enters a battle.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

7.Rule: The calculated rank rewards for the Twisted Realm will be sent via mail at the end of each event.

1.Title: Guild Hunting
1.Rule: Players can challenge the Guild Boss 3 times per day.

2.Rule: The more damage you deal to the boss in a single battle, the more rewards you get.

3.Rule: The highest damage each guild member deals to the boss today will count toward the guild's total damage. Phase rewards are unlocked when the total damage dealt to the boss reaches a certain value.

4.Rule: After the Guild Boss reaches phase 5, you can select battlefield buffs to increase your damage against the boss during the challenge.

5.Rule: Activity Points earned by guild members will be converted into Treasure Compasses, which can be used by the Guild Master and Guild Deputy to increase the rewards for challenging the Guild Boss on the second day.

6.Rule: Players will get individual rewards each day based on their highest damage dealt of the day. No rewards will be given if a battle damage does not exceed the highest damage of the day.

7.Rule: Phase rewards are calculated and sent via mail at 00:00 each day.

8.Rule: The accumulated damage dealt to the Guild Boss is reset after the calculation.

9.Rule: The guild administrator can appoint a Hunting Blade.

10.Rule: After the appointment, all guild members except the Star Hunter can use all Hunting Blade heroes in Guild Hunt.

1.Title: Guild Hunting Leaderboard
1.Rule: Rankings are based on the highest damage dealt by each guild member.

2.Title: Guild Hunting Leaderboard
2.Rule: The leaderboard is reset after the daily calculation.

1.Title: Hero Returns
1.Rule: During the Hero Returns event, players can get free Chronos Summon Tickets by completing daily quests, summoning heroes in the Noble Tavern, and reaching specified ranks in the Arena of Heroes.
