2.Rule: Use Chronos Summon Ticket to summon heroes in the event.

3.Rule: Log into your AFK Arena classic server account to activate Hero Returns Perks: you will receive Targeted Summon chances for your heroes in the Hero Returns event based on their highest ascension tier in the classic server.

4.Rule: After activating Hero Returns Perks, you can use Chronos Summon Tickets to summon the heroes you want within a specified range.

5.Rule: Each account can only activate the perks once.

1.Title: Inheritance Rules
1.Rule: Players with Hero Returns Perks can choose to summon specific hero(es) or get 60 Elite Hero Soulstones.

2.Rule: Different tiers grant varying numbers of hero summons.

3.Rule: Once a targeted summoning is used, the summoning cooldown starts. The cooldown resets once the hero pool is refreshed.

4.Rule: The pool refreshes for every 5 heroes summoned.

5.Rule: Once your targeted summons are depleted, targeted summoning will become unavailable.

1.Title: Battle Stars Rules
1.Rule: Your Battle Stars will fight the Battle Stars of the three other guilds on behalf of your guild.

2.Rule: Battle Stars earn Prestige by defeating Battle Stars from other factions.

3.Rule: The top 5 players in the guild with the highest overall hero Combat Rating will be the Battle Stars by default.

4.Rule: A Battle Stars member can be replaced if the player is willing to vacate the slot while another player has applied to fill it with the approval of the Guild Master. Applications can only be made within the first 24 hours after the registration begins.

1.Title: Rush Rewards
1.Rule: This event will last for 30 days after the server is open.

2.Rule: All players will receive splendid rewards by clearing the required stages.

3.Rule: Rewards are limited in quantity and distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. Once the allocated amount is depleted, they will be downgraded to ordinary rewards.

4.Rule: Ordinary rewards have no limitations in quantity and can be claimed by clearing the required stages during the event.

1.Title: Get All Heroes
1.Rule: During this event, complete Campaign stages to obtain Elite heroes.

2.Rule: Elite heroes obtained in this event will not be duplicates.

3.Rule: Track the heroes obtained in this event in Summoning Progress.

4.Rule: New heroes will be added to this event regularly, and new heroes from later versions will be added gradually. You can unlock them as you progress through Campaign stages.

1.Title: Expedition Plan
1.Rule: The Expedition Plan is a set of goals to be achieved by all members of the guild.

2.Rule: Activate it after the creation of a guild to get blessings.

3.Rule: Blessings are time-limited. Complete goals during their duration to get more rewards.

4.Rule: Members who have already obtained the Expedition Plan rewards will not be able to obtain them again.

1.Title: Beast Encyclopedia
1.Rule: Complete quests to level up the Beast Encyclopedia.

2.Rule: The Beast Encyclopedia provides attribute bonuses to all beasts.

1.Title: Duo Co-op
1.Rule: Team up with adventurers to borrow up to 5 heroes and deploy them in battle.

2.Rule: After teaming up with adventurers, you will be able to borrow more heroes as you progress through more stages.

3.Rule: Increases guild members' team-up earnings for Gold, Hero EXP, and Hero's Essence AFK Reward by 3%.

4.Rule: Heroes after teaming up are developed as follows:

5.Rule: Tier: When borrowing a hero with an ascension level lower than or equal to Ascended, their original tier will be maintained. If their tier is higher than Ascended, it will be lowered to Ascended tier.

6.Rule: Level: If your Resonating Crystal level is below 20, it will be raised to 20; if it's 20 or higher, your current Resonance Level will be used.

7.Rule: Gear: The average level of your own gear is used.

8.Rule: Signature Item: The average level of your own signature items is used.

9.Rule: All Team-Up Gains will be lost upon leaving the team.

1.Title: Beast Info
1.Rule: The tier of a beast affects the unlocking and upgrading of its skills. Beast tier can be increased by ascending beasts.

2.Rule: A beast's attributes only affect its own skills and are determined by the beast's tier and the Resonating Crystal level.

3.Rule: When the beast's tier reaches Legendary, Beast Talents are unlocked. Beast Talents provide attribute buffs to all heroes in the team.

1.Title: Ascend Beasts
1.Rule: Ascend Beasts allows you to ascend your beasts and increase their tiers.

2.Rule: Ascending beasts requires a certain number of beasts of the same type and tier.

3.Rule: The Ascend All feature unlocks after you have ascended beasts 10 times.

4.Rule: Ascend All allows you to ascend all eligible beasts to the highest tiers they can reach at once.

1.Title: Combine Beasts
1.Rule: Combine Beasts allows you to combine your beasts into new ones.

2.Rule: Only Ascended-tier beasts can be combined. When you combine two beasts, a new beast will be created. You can choose one of the two material beasts or the new beast, and the remaining two will be retired.

3.Rule: The type of the new beast is randomly selected based on the types of the two material beasts. More details can be found in the combination preview.

4.Rule: The tier of the new beast is determined by the material beasts, with some random variation within a certain range. More details can be viewed in the combination preview.

5.Rule: The number of the new beast's talents is determined by the number of the material beasts' talents.

6.Rule: Each time you finish combining and retiring beasts, you will receive a set number of Beast Tokens, which can be used to exchange for rewards in the Beast Store.

7.Rule: Fabled beasts cannot be combined with other beasts.

1.Title: Capture Beasts
1.Rule: Adventurers can use Capture Permit to capture beasts.

2.Rule: Each capture attempt randomly reveals 3 habitats, each containing 3 beasts. Adventurers can choose one habitat, and one beast from that habitat will be randomly captured.

3.Rule: After reaching Capture Proficiency Lvl 2, the Continuous Capture feature is unlocked.

1.Title: Hero Returns Perks
1.Rule: Log into your AFK Arena account to view the highest tier of heroes ascended in the game, as well as the Targeted Summon chances for each hero in the Hero Returns event.

2.Rule: Each account can only activate the perks once.

3.Rule: The number of hero summons will not increase as the account continues to upgrade the heroes' tiers in AFK Arena.

4.Rule: After activating Hero Returns Perks, you can use Chronos Summon Tickets to summon the heroes you want within a specified range.

5.Rule: Each ticket grants you an Elite hero. Accounts with activated perks can use targeted summoning.

1.Title: Hero Returns Perks
1.Rule: Log into your AFK Arena account to view the highest tier of heroes ascended in the game, as well as the Targeted Summon chances for each hero in the Hero Returns event.

2.Rule: Each account can only activate the perks once.

3.Rule: The number of hero summons will not increase as the account continues to upgrade the heroes' tiers in AFK Arena.

4.Rule: After activating Hero Returns Perks, you can use Chronos Summon Tickets to summon the heroes you want within a specified range.

5.Rule: Each ticket grants you an Elite hero. Accounts with activated perks can use targeted summoning.

1.Title: AFK Reward Rules
1.Rule: Campaign and Forked Fate offer different AFK rewards, with higher progression yielding greater rewards.

1.Title: Vault of Time
1.Rule: Participation in the Vault of Time is limited to guilds only.

2.Rule: The top 10 Guild members with the highest overall hero Combat Rating will be the Stars of Dawn by default. A Stars of Dawn member can be replaced if the player is willing to vacate the slot while another player has applied to fill it, with the approval of the Militia Leader. Applications can only be made within the first 24 hours after battles start.

3.Rule: Players leaving a guild to join another can still participate in Vault of Time. Their titles are carried over from the previous guild, but other data (including but not limited to occupied tiles and Relics in the bag) are not. They will have to restart the event.

4.Rule: Players who have left a Guild will not receive rewards from the Guild they left. Joining a Guild and participating in Vault of Time with that Guild will allow you to receive the rewards from that Guild.

5.Rule: Vault of Time S1 and S2 are competitions on the current server, and will start 20 and 50 days after the server opens, respectively. Starting from S3, seasons are global competitions.

6.Rule: The current server must complete S1 and S2, and at least 10 days must pass after S2 ends before global Vault of Time seasons can begin.

1.Title: Dual Forked Fate
1.Rule: Once activated, you can team up with adventurers.

2.Rule: Team up with adventurers to borrow up to 5 heroes and deploy 2 of them in battle.

3.Rule: After teaming up with adventurers, the Team-Up Gains will increase with the team duration and as you progress through Forked Fate.

4.Rule: Borrowed heroes after teaming up are developed as follows:

5.Rule: Tier: When borrowing a hero with an ascension level lower than or equal to Ascended, their original tier will be maintained. If their tier is higher than Ascended, it will be lowered to Ascended tier.

6.Rule: Level: If your Resonating Crystal level is below 20, it will be raised to 20; if it's 20 or higher, your current Resonance Level will be used.

7.Rule: Gear: The average level of your own gear is used.

8.Rule: Signature Item: The average level of your own signature items is used.

9.Rule: After teaming up, you can send a Proxy Challenge Request to a teammate for the current stage.

10.Rule: Once your teammate receives the request, a proxy challenge is consumed to use all heroes available in both of your pools. The stage is completed if the challenge is successful.

11.Rule: Proxy battles reset daily.

12.Rule: All the bonus effects expire when you leave your team.

1.Title: Dual Dream Realms
1.Rule: Once unlocked, you can search for adventurers to team up with.

2.Rule: Team up with adventurers to borrow up to 25 heroes and deploy 2 of them in battle.

3.Rule: After teaming up with adventurers, the Team-Up Gains will increase with the team duration and as more Dream Realms teams are activated.

4.Rule: Tier of borrowed heroes after teaming up: For Ascended and below heroes, the hero's original tier will be used. For heroes of higher than Ascended tier, their tiers will all be balanced to Ascended.

5.Rule: Level of borrowed heroes after teaming up: If your Resonating Crystal level is below 20, it will be raised to 20. If it's 20 or higher but lower than the Martial Rating, the Resonating Crystal level will be used. If it's higher than the Martial Rating, the Martial Rating will be used.

6.Rule: Gear level of borrowed heroes after teaming up: The average of your gear levels will be used.

7.Rule: Signature Item level of borrowed heroes after teaming up: The average of your Signature Item levels will be used.

8.Rule: Proxy Challenge: After teaming up, you can help your teammate fight bosses and set new records, but this will not count toward the quest progress of the game mode.

9.Rule: Proxy challenges do not consume teammates' challenge attempts but will deduct from your own proxy challenge count. Proxy challenge attempts reset when the boss refreshes.

10.Rule: All the bonus effects expire when you leave your team.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Alliance Contest
1.Rule: The Alliance Contest event has four phases: enrollment, matching, event, and calculation.

2.Rule: The enrollment phase lasts 1 day and 20 hours. The event requires a team of two adventurers to participate. If you haven't found a teammate by the end of this phase, you will be automatically paired with one.

3.Rule: The matching phase lasts 4 hours. During this time, adventurer teams are matched into groups of similar strength.

4.Rule: The event phase lasts 2 days. During this period, adventurers on the same team can earn points by participating in different modes. Their points are added together, and both adventurers receive rewards and are ranked based on the total points.

5.Rule: During the event, you will receive 3 Alliance Medals daily. Participating in any mode consumes 1 Alliance Medal, and unused medals can be saved for the next day.

6.Rule: In each event, all adventurers' heroes are adjusted to the same level, but heroes' gear and tiers will remain unaffected.

7.Rule: The event includes Dream Realms, Zero Limit, Arena Challenge, Tactical Trials, and Alliance Quests. Each of these modes has different difficulty levels that yield different points.

8.Rule: In each event, 2 of the following 3 modes will be randomly activated: Dream Realms, Zero Limit, and Arena Challenge. Adventurers on the same team can earn points by ranking in these modes. Rankings are calculated at the start of the next day.

9.Rule: 3 different Tactical Trials will appear in each event. Completing them grants points. Each of the trials can only be chosen by 1 adventurer on the same team.

10.Rule: Alliance Quests are available in both Easy and Hard difficulties. 5 random quests will appear in each event. Each quest can only be accepted by 1 adventurer on the same team.

11.Rule: Once a team reaches the required points, both adventurers on the team can claim their rewards.

12.Rule: The calculation phase, which lasts 1 day, begins when the event phase ends. Teams are ranked based on their total points, and ranking rewards are sent via mail.

13.Rule: After the event, unused Alliance Medals will be automatically removed.

14.Rule: At the end of the event, unclaimed points rewards will also be sent to adventurers via mail.

1.Title: Alliance Venue
1.Rule: The event includes Dream Realms, Zero Limit, Arena Challenge, Tactical Trials, and Alliance Quests. Each of these modes has different difficulty levels that yield different points.

2.Rule: Participating in any mode consumes 1 Alliance Medal, and unused medals can be saved for the next day.

3.Rule: Dream Realms, Zero Limit, and Arena Challenge are ranking modes, and points are rewarded based on final rankings. Adventurers can participate in modes that suit them the most.

4.Rule: Tactical Trials have 3 difficulty levels, and completing them grants points. Adventurers on the same team cannot join the same trial simultaneously.

5.Rule: Alliance Quests come with various objectives, and completing them grants points. Note that each quest can only be accepted by 1 adventurer on the same team at once, and progress will be tracked once the quest is accepted.

6.Rule: Discuss strategies with your teammate before joining a mode for better chances of earning higher points.

1.Title: Dream Realms
1.Rule: Use 1 Alliance Medal to join a mode to win 5 challenge attempts.

2.Rule: Once all challenge attempts are used up, you can use diamonds for extra challenges, up to 99. 1 attempt is consumed upon entering a battle.

3.Rule: After each challenge, the highest damage dealt is counted towards the overall damage dealt by all teams.

4.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt throughout all boss challenges will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

5.Rule: Dream Realms results will be calculated during the daily refresh, and points will be automatically added without notification.

1.Title: Zero Limit
1.Rule: Use 1 Alliance Medal to join a mode to win 5 challenge attempts.

2.Rule: Once all challenge attempts are used up, you can use diamonds for extra challenges, up to 99. 1 attempt is consumed upon entering a battle.

3.Rule: If a team sets a new record for the highest floor cleared, it will be counted to the leaderboard ranking, and the final ranking will be determined during the calculation.

4.Rule: Zero Limit results will be calculated during the daily refresh, and points will be automatically added without notification.

1.Title: Arena Challenge
1.Rule: Arena Challenge has two stages, and its result is calculated based on the players' rankings of the higher stage. Only the higher stage ranking is counted even if a player ranks in both stages. Adventurers can choose when to participate.

2.Rule: Use 1 Alliance Medal to join a mode to win 5 challenge attempts.

3.Rule: Once all challenge attempts are used up, you can use diamonds for extra challenges, up to 2. 1 attempt is consumed upon entering a battle.

4.Rule: If the attacker defeats a player of a higher rank, their ranks will be swapped.

5.Rule: The attacker fails if the battle times out.

6.Rule: Final rankings are determined during the calculation.

7.Rule: Points are awarded after each result calculation based on your current ranking.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: The leaderboard ranks adventurer teams based on their points: the higher the points, the higher the ranking.

2.Rule: Real-time rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: Leaderboard rewards are sent via mail during the tournament's calculation phase, adventurers on the same team will receive the same rewards.

4.Rule: When teams have equal scores, the team with the higher Combat Rating will be ranked higher.

1.Title: Dream Realms Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Dream Realms leaderboard ranks adventurers based on their highest damage dealt: the higher the damage, the higher the ranking.

2.Rule: Real-time rankings within the Dream Realms leaderboard are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: Dream Realms leaderboard points are automatically sent during the daily refresh.

1.Title: Zero Limit Leaderboard
1.Rule: Zero Limit leaderboard ranks adventurers based on the highest floor they've reached: the higher the floor, the higher the ranking. If multiple players reach the same floor, the one who did it faster will rank higher.

2.Rule: Real-time rankings within the Zero Limit leaderboard are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: Zero Limit leaderboard points are automatically sent during the daily refresh.

1.Title: Arena Challenge Leaderboard
1.Rule: If the attacker defeats a player of a higher rank, their ranks will be swapped.

2.Rule: Real-time rankings within the Arena Challenge leaderboard are subject to constant changes. Your final ranking will be determined at the end of each session.

3.Rule: Arena Challenge leaderboard points are automatically sent during the daily refresh.

1.Title: Dream Odyssey
1.Rule: Dream Odyssey has a duration of 28 days.

2.Rule: During the event, players can obtain Roaming Medals by completing daily, weekly, and challenge quests.

3.Rule: Daily quests refresh at UTC 0:00 every day, and weekly quests at 0:00 every Sunday. Challenge quests can only be completed once for each event.

4.Rule: Obtain more Roaming Medals to get more Dream Odyssey rewards during the event period.

5.Rule: Players can purchase Premium Pass to unlock more rewards during the event period.

6.Rule: With 7 days remaining in Dream Odyssey, players who've unlocked the Advanced Reward can purchase Roaming Medals with diamonds.

7.Rule: After reaching level 60, players can continue completing quests to earn Roaming Medals and unlock Dream Odyssey Chests.

8.Rule: Any claimable rewards that remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Dream Odyssey is reset.

1.Title: Travel Notes
1.Rule: Travel Notes lasts for 28 days.

2.Rule: During the event, players can obtain Travel Supplies by completing daily, weekly, and challenge quests.

3.Rule: Daily quests refresh at UTC 0:00 every day, and weekly quests at 0:00 every Sunday. Challenge quests can only be completed once.

4.Rule: During the event, obtain more Travel Supplies to unlock more rewards.

5.Rule: During the event, players can purchase Premium Pass to unlock more rewards.

6.Rule: With 7 days remaining in Travel Notes, players who've unlocked the Advanced Reward can purchase Travel Supplies with diamonds.

7.Rule: Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to the player's mail after the event.

1.Title: Coveted Invite
1.Rule: During the Coveted Invite event, you will receive a Fidelia seedling. By completing certain quests, you can acquire Water Drops to cultivate Fidelia.

2.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Sprout and Bud phases, you will receive corresponding rewards.

3.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Bloom phase, you can send a letter inviting your favorite hero to join your team!

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is adjusted to Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

4.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Pursuit of Treasures
1.Rule: During the event, players will get various rewards after accumulating a certain amount of Treasure Crystals.

2.Rule: Treasure Crystals can be obtained through the following methods: 1. AFK rewards in Campaign stages. 2. Daily Quest Chests. 3. The first 3 daily battles in the Arena of Heroes.

3.Rule: After joining a guild, players can open the Exquisite Giftbox with their guild members to get additional rewards.

4.Rule: Unlocking an Exquisite Giftbox requires 5 Runed Letters, and each guild member can only contribute 1 Runed Letter per Giftbox. Runed Letters can be obtained from the AFK rewards for Campaign stages.

5.Rule: When a player in a round of Exquisite Giftbox has contributed a Runed Letter or lacks enough Runed Letters, they can request their guild mates to contribute Runed Letters.

6.Rule: Each time an Exquisite Giftbox is unlocked, all guild members can claim rewards. However, there is a daily limit to how many times each member can claim these rewards.

7.Rule: Rewards from different Exquisite Giftboxes will differ, but the first several Giftboxes guarantee Treasure Crystals.

1.Title: Stellar Soul
1.Rule: You can get powerful Awakened Heroes from all factions in Stellar Soul.

2.Rule: You can unlock and obtain a faction's Awakened Hero by obtaining a certain number of heroes from the same faction that meet tier requirements.

3.Rule: The tier of the Awakened Hero can be increased by upgrading the tiers of other heroes within the same faction.

4.Rule: More Awakened Heroes will be introduced with version updates.

1.Title: Share for Rewards
1.Rule: During the event, share the event a certain number of times to unlock new Treasure Bag rewards after a certain amount of time.

2.Rule: Earn Regular Coupons by completing activity quests and Prime Coupons by successfully inviting new players. Both of these items can be used to refresh the rewards inside Treasure Bags, but using a Prime Coupon guarantees special rewards!

3.Rule: During the event, players can obtain up to 300 Regular Coupons from activity quests. There's no limit to how many Prime Coupons can be obtained.

4.Rule: Both you and the newly invited player must log in during the event and link the correct AFK Arena account to ensure that the event rewards are sent and claimed properly.

5.Rule: When you refresh the rewards, you can choose a reward you like, or you can continue to refresh to see new rewards. You can claim rewards at any time during the event, but after confirming the reward you want to claim, you can no longer refresh it. After the event ends, unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.

1.Title: Spire Contest
1.Rule: Adventurers who have completed Campaign Stage 3-36 and joined a Guild can participate in the Spire Contest event.

2.Rule: The event consists of an exploration phase and a calculation phase. In the 3-day exploration phase, guild members can start events of varying difficulties, with victories rewarding all members. This phase is followed by a 3-day calculation phase, where guild members receive treasures based on the distribution mechanism selected by their Guild Master.

3.Rule: During the exploration phase, the Guild Master can change the Guild treasure distribution mechanism at any time. All members will be notified via mail when the mechanism is changed. Members can tap on the treasure chest in the event's main interface to view their potential rewards based on the current mechanism. Once the calculation phase begins, the Guild Master cannot make any further changes to the distribution mechanism.

4.Rule: Guild members can earn Contribution Points (CP) in several ways, including bringing rewards to the Guild during exploration or supporting other members to achieve victory.

5.Rule: During the event, if an adventurer leaves the Guild, they will no longer be included in the original Guild's treasure distribution, and any treasures brought back will be deducted from the total pool. If the adventurer joins a new Guild, their CP will reset to zero, and treasures earned in the former Guild will not be transfered to the new one.

6.Rule: During the event, the Guild Master can designate 5 heroes as Guild Reinforcements, and their levels (including Martial Rating, tier, gear, and other progressions) are equal to those of the same heroes with the highest Combat Rating owned by any guild member. Adventurers can deploy up to 2 heroes as Guild Reinforcements in exploration combat events, but these Reinforcement heroes cannot be used for defense or support.

7.Rule: Each adventurer has 3 exploration attempts daily, with exploration attempts resetting at UTC 0:00 each day.

8.Rule: Each adventurer can provide support up to 6 times daily. If successful, the supported adventurer earns the event's CP, and the rewards are added to the Guild treasure pool, along with extra CP for the supporter. If the first support fails, it will increase the enemy's Exhaustion and weaken them, but the supporter will not receive a reward or lose any support attempts.

9.Rule: The rewards an adventurer receives for defeating members of other guilds during exploration are based on the total treasure pool value of the opposing Guild.

10.Rule: During the calculation phase, guild members can make a wish when opening the chest rewards. Wishing grants items of the corresponding type.

11.Rule: Any unclaimed rewards at the end of the calculation phase will be reissued via mail. If the rewards include a chest, it will automatically open and convert into the items you would have received.

1.Title: Noctis Animarum Festival
1.Rule: During the event, players can make Jack o'Lanterns according to specifications at "Custom Request" to receive a reward.

2.Rule: During the event, you can create Jack o'Lanterns at the Crafting Workshop. Your work, once submitted successfully, will be shown at the Display Gallery and can receive likes from other adventurers. DIY works can also be saved as stickers, which will be sent out after the event ends.

3.Rule: The accessories needed to make Jack-o'-Lanterns are available in the Fantasy Hut or Mischief Shop.

4.Rule: During the event, participate in fun Pumpkin Siege challenges to obtain rewards.

5.Rule: During the event, players can challenge powerful enemies in Hollow Harvest to earn candies, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Mischief Shop.

6.Rule: Complete a variety of quests to acquire Prank Candy. Accumulate Prank Candy to unlock the different rewards in Nocturnal Rhymes. The highest prize is Nara's limited-edition skin: Mad Hatter.

1.Title: Custom Request
1.Rule: During the event, players can make Jack o'Lanterns according to specifications at "Custom Request" to receive a reward.

2.Rule: Within the first 8 days of the event, players will receive 1 custom request per day. A previous request must be completed before the next one can be unlocked.

3.Rule: A submission that fits the request specifications more will receive a higher star rating. Before achieving 3 stars, a player can submit an unlimited number of works but can only earn the reward once.

4.Rule: For the first 3 requests, the player can apply accessories for the body, eyes, and mouth. From Request 4 onwards, the player can use accessories for the display base, headwear, and ornaments.

5.Rule: By default, each player is given 3 basic accessories for the body, 1 for the eyes, 1 for the mouth, and 1 for the display base. The other accessories can only be acquired in the Fantasy Hut.

1.Title: Crafting Workshop
1.Rule: During the event, you can create Jack o'Lanterns at the Crafting Workshop. Your work, once submitted successfully, will be shown at the Gallery and can receive likes from other adventurers.

2.Rule: At the Crafting Workshop, the body and base of a Jack o'Lantern cannot be moved, and you can use not more than 1 accessory for each of these two parts. In the other parts, you may place multiple accessories, but each accessory can only be placed once.

3.Rule: During the event, the latest DIY creations submitted by players will be automatically saved as stickers. You may choose one out of your 10 recently submitted DIY works to be saved as a sticker, which will be issued after the event. If the manual selection mode is enabled, you can modify your choice at any time during the event, but ultimately only one work can be selected to be a sticker.

4.Rule: During the event, you may view and like other players' DIY Jack o'Lanterns on their profile pages.

5.Rule: Like 3 players' DIY Jack o'Lanterns each day to get 1 Candy Key.

6.Rule: During the event, your accumulated likes will not be cleared when you switch your work on display.

7.Rule: You can only Like a specific player's work once a day. You can Like up to 15 players per day. Likes cannot be withdrawn.

8.Rule: [Statement]: At the Crafting Workshop, please do not submit any content that involves or implies racial, gender or religious discrimination, or that contains political, violent, horror or pornographic elements. Any player failing to adhere to this standard may be restricted from using these gaming services, including but not limited to forced removal of their DIY works, their forced log-out from the game, their game access being banned, or suspension of their account.

1.Title: Fantasy Hut
1.Rule: The accessories needed to make a Jack o'Lantern can be drawn from the chest in the Fantasy Hut or acquired with the Jack o'Lantern Accessories Card.

2.Rule: The "Expression Kit" contains accessories for the features "eyes" and "mouth", which are available to draw from the beginning.

3.Rule: The "Decoration Kit" contains accessories for the features "display base", "headwear" and "ornaments", which are available to draw after Request 4 is unlocked.

4.Rule: When drawing from the chest, an accessory that has been acquired before will no longer be available. You can only acquire accessories you have not received before when using the Jack o'Lantern Accessories Card.

5.Rule: Candy Keys for opening the chest can be obtained through the following: (i) Daily Quest Chests; (ii) By liking a DIY Jack-o'-Lantern; (iii) Pumpkin Siege.

6.Rule: You can redeem 1 Jack o'Lantern Accessory Card with 4 Candy Keys.

1.Title: Phantom Pursuit
1.Rule: There are 4 maps in Phantom Pursuit. Each map is divided into 2 areas, with a total of 8 areas.

2.Rule: One area will be unlocked each of the first 8 days of the event, but you must clear all stages in a preceding area in order to enter the next area.

3.Rule: An area contains battle stages and event stages. After completing a specified number of stages, you will receive the corresponding rewards.

4.Rule: Battles have varying levels of difficulty, but players are free to choose the order of challenges. After defeating a higher difficulty stage, players can directly sweep lower difficulty stages for rewards.

5.Rule: If you fail a battle, you may attempt it again. The event stages can only be unlocked by completing certain battle stages.

6.Rule: During a battle stage, the heroes available to use are provided by the system, and are not determined by your own heroes.

7.Rule: During a battle stage, you must deploy Thoran - The Fallen King.

8.Rule: You may spend Lost Crown to train Thoran - The Fallen King in the event, in order to clear more challenging battle stages. (The stats of Thoran - The Fallen King leveled up by spending Lost Crown is only effective during the event.)

9.Rule: When attempting a more challenging battle stage, the combat ratings of both the enemy and allied formations will be increased.

10.Rule: Completing event stages rewards players with Reminiscent Whispers. When you collect 3 Reminiscent Whispers, a section of Thoran's memories is unlocked. Collecting a certain number of Reminiscent Whispers allows players to receive different rewards.

1.Title: Ghostly Echoes
1.Rule: Ghostly Echoes will commence during the Noctis Animarum Festival, and will run for 14 days.

2.Rule: Complete quests in the Noctis Animarum Festival to acquire Phantom Memories. The more Phantom Memories earned, the greater the rewards unlocked.

3.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Ghostly Echoes, and have not claimed all your rewards within the 4 days before the end of Ghostly Echoes, you may purchase Phantom Memories with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock Ghostly Echoes to acquire 980 VIP Experience Points.

5.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Ghostly Echoes ends.

1.Title: Temple of Transcendent
1.Rule: When heroes reach 5-Star Ascended, you can continue to ascend them at the Temple of Transcendent.

2.Rule: When a player has enough Transcendent heroes, the Temple of Transcendent will be upgraded to a higher star level.

3.Rule: Heroes can only be upgraded to the Transcendent star level that matches the current star level of the Temple of Transcendent.

1.Title: Joyous Celebration
1.Rule: The Joyous Celebration event is open to all servers, where adventurers collaborate to create a cake. Adventurers in the test and official servers will share their progress separately.

2.Rule: You can assist with the cake preparation every day, for which you may receive a random reward of 100, 150, or 288 diamonds.

3.Rule: Each time you assist, your progress is increased by 100, 300, or 500 at random.

4.Rule: When the cake is completed to a certain level, all adventurers who have collaborated in its preparation will receive a reward.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: A player's Martial Rating is used to participate in this event. Heroes will retain their tier, and each hero's level will be set to 240.

6.Rule: During the event, all hero gear (including unadorned parts) is adjusted to Mythic T1 and include Faction Bonuses but are un-enhanced. If a hero is already equipping Mythic T3 gear or higher, their original Hero Bonuses will be retained.

7.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

8.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Guild Haggle
1.Rule: At the start of each event, the Guild Haggle Chest will offer different items. Guild members can purchase the chest to obtain these items.

2.Rule: All guild members can haggle to lower the chest price, sharing the final discount.

3.Rule: During the event, each adventurer has only one chance to haggle and one chance to purchase the Guild Haggle Chest, regardless of any guild changes.

4.Rule: At the start of the event, each guild can have up to two members designated as Haggle Masters, who will receive a higher fixed discount amount for haggling.

5.Rule: Aside from the Haggle Masters, guild members who haggle earlier will also reduce the price by a larger amount.

6.Rule: The lowest price for the Guild Haggle Chest is 0.

1.Title: Stage Rush
1.Rule: When a player's Combat Rating far exceeds that of the stage's enemies, Stage Rush activates.

2.Rule: Players can clear the stage instantly with one tap.

3.Rule: Stage Rush does not affect the rewards gained from the stage.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

7.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

8.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

9.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

12.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

13.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

14.Rule: If you choose Sweep, you will skip the battle and directly see the battle result.

15.Rule: In Sweep, if you check the auto-matching option, you will be automatically matched with opponents for consecutive challenges until you run out of reward-claiming attempts for the day.

1.Title: Change Wishlist
1.Rule: At the Noble Tavern, use the Popular Heroes feature from the wishlist to enter the Popular Heroes leaderboard.

2.Rule: From this leaderboard, the wishlist can be replaced with the most popular heroes.

3.Rule: By default, Celestial, Hypogean, Awakened, and max-starred heroes cannot be added to the wishlist.

4.Rule: If there are fewer than 5 popular heroes from a particular faction on the leaderboard, then they will be replaced from left to right, and then heroes from the player's original wishlist will be used to fill the remaining spots.

1.Title: Hero Returns Perks
1.Rule: In this AFK Arena account, returning players can view the highest tier of heroes ascended in the game, as well as the Targeted Summon chances for each hero in the Hero Returns event.

2.Rule: After activating Hero Returns Perks, you can use Chronos Summon Tickets to summon the heroes you want within a specified range.

3.Rule: Each account can only activate the perks once.

4.Rule: Each ticket grants you an Elite hero. Accounts with activated perks can use targeted hero summoning.

1.Title: Hero Returns Perks
1.Rule: In this AFK Arena account, returning players can view the highest tier of heroes ascended in the game, as well as the Targeted Summon chances for each hero in the Hero Returns event.

2.Rule: After activating Hero Returns Perks, you can use Chronos Summon Tickets to summon the heroes you want within a specified range.

3.Rule: Each account can only activate the perks once.

4.Rule: Each ticket grants you an Elite hero. Accounts with activated perks can use targeted hero summoning.

1.Title: Rebirth Aid
1.Rule: Players can be reborn after reaching two milestones: 120 days since character creation and clearing Campaign stages 24–48.

2.Rule: Players can then be reborn into the newest server that is not full.

3.Rule: After confirming the rebirth, the player's hero level progress will be added in the Hero Returns Event on the new server, and all of the player's data on their original server will be saved.

4.Rule: After confirming the rebirth, players can use the Quick Skip feature to skip some portions of the New Player Guide.

5.Rule: Characters can only be reborn once per server.

1.Title: Obsidian Finch Gift
1.Rule: During the event period, players who have cleared stages 3–36 can trigger the event and claim surprise rewards by accumulating purchases.

2.Rule: The event lasts 28 days from the trigger date, with a total of 3 phases that unlock over time.

3.Rule: Purchase all the bundles in the current phase to claim surprise rewards and unlock the ability to purchase the bundles in the next phase.

1.Title: Dreamy Wonderland
1.Rule: Join Estrilda and her companions as they meet Mira, a mysterious young girl. Together, you'll travel across the land gathering materials, crafting furniture, and decorating the cottage for a heartwarming Midwinter Festival.

2.Rule: During the first 7 days of the event, a new area will be unlocked each day. Explore areas to get core materials for its corresponding piece of furniture. You'll need to craft each piece of furniture in sequence to unlock the next area.

3.Rule: Explore to unlock Memorable Moments in Mira's Journal.

4.Rule: Explore to get core materials and crafting tools that can be used to craft furniture.

5.Rule: Explore to get reinforcements that can be used to help out in Frostbound Exile.

1.Title: Frostbound Exile
1.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

2.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies. Each team can only select up to 3 Heartfelt Boons.

3.Rule: In Frostbound Exile, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

4.Rule: You can use 1 team of heroes when fighting an area's Powerful Enemies, and you can use 2 teams when fighting the final Powerful Enemy "Eluard - Protector of Souls". The sum of the damage dealt by the 2 teams will be the final damage.

5.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

6.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

7.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

8.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chests shall be sent out when the leaderboard is calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Wintertide Trek
1.Rule: Wintertide Trek will be available for the duration of the Dreamy Wonderland event and expires when the event ends.

2.Rule: Complete quests in Dreamy Wonderland to obtain Arctic Starlight. The more Arctic Starlight earned, the greater the rewards unlocked.

3.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Wintertide Trek but have not claimed all your rewards within the 4 days before Wintertide Trek ends, you can purchase Arctic Starlight with diamonds.

4.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Wintertide Trek ends.

1.Title: Furniture Crafting
1.Rule: During the event, explore areas to acquire core materials for crafting. For each of the first 7 days of the event, a new piece of furniture will be unlocked. However, furniture must be crafted in the sequence in which they are unlocked.

2.Rule: The furniture will be judged based on 4 criteria: Creativity, Aesthetics, Tactility, and Durability. Each piece of furniture has its own inherent characteristics. Before crafting, you can allocate 10 resource points across the 4 criteria based on the furniture's description. The more consistent the point allocation is with the furniture's characteristics, the higher the crafting score you will get.

3.Rule: Each piece of basic furniture has a corresponding piece of secret furniture. You can unlock the secret furniture when crafting with a specific resource point combination. Unlocking the secret furniture does not affect your crafting score.

4.Rule: Craft basic furniture and secret furniture to get collection rewards (up to 1,400 diamonds). The collection entries for basic furniture contain clues for how to craft their corresponding secret furniture.

5.Rule: Mira's intimacy level is equal to the sum of the crafting score of your 7 highest-rated pieces of furniture. Improve your crafting scores to raise her intimacy and unlock Heartfelt Boons for Frostbound Exile challenges.

6.Rule: The higher a furniture's crafting score, the better the rating (from highest to lowest: S, A, B). When you craft a piece of high-level basic furniture, the corresponding low-level furniture will be automatically unlocked. Each furniture type has four different appearances (S, A, B, and Secret) which you can switch between in the Cottage. The selected appearance does not affect Mira's intimacy level.

7.Rule: Explore the Map to acquire crafting tools that can be used to improve your crafting result.

8.Rule: Players can use up to three crafting attempts a day to increase their proficiency, and unused attempts will roll over to the next day. Once these attempts are used up, crafting is still possible, but it will not yield proficiency gains. Every five successful crafting attempts will boost your proficiency, unlocking a higher crafting score.

9.Rule: There is a chance for a critical success to occur during crafting. When this happens, you receive a higher crafting score.

1.Title: Rebirth Aid
1.Rule: Players can then be reborn into the newest server that is not full.

2.Rule: After confirming the rebirth, the player's hero level progress will be added in the Hero Returns Event on the new server, and all of the player's data on their original server will be saved.

3.Rule: After confirming the rebirth, players can use the Quick Skip feature to skip some portions of the New Player Guide.

4.Rule: Characters can only be reborn once per server.

1.Title: Rebirth Perks
1.Rule: After your reborn, the Hero Returns event has offered Targeted Summons based on your hero tier progress on the original server.

1.Title: Graceful Melody
1.Rule: Purchasing the bundle below will also grant you the special event item "Darknight Rose". Collect a certain number of Darknight Roses to obtain rewards such as resources or avatar frames.

1.Title: Guild Treasure Hunt
1.Rule: Each Guild Treasure Hunt season lasts for 3 days. Players can create their team formations 1 day before the season begins.

2.Rule: Players are divided into Treasure Hunters and Battle Stars in the Guild Treasure Hunt. Players with a Combat Rating in the top 5 of the guild will become Battle Stars by default. A Battle Star can be replaced if the player is willing to vacate the position while another player has applied to fill it with the approval of the Guild Master. Replacements can only be made before the season begins.

3.Rule: Treasure Hunters can add different attributes for the guild's Battle Stars by escorting supplies, investigating intel, and occupying treasures.

4.Rule: Battle Stars earn Prestige by defeating Battle Stars from other guilds. The guild's points and ranking are based on its Battle Stars' Prestige and rankings.

5.Rule: When out for an operation, your heroes will only be matched with heroes of the same operation from other guilds.

6.Rule: During the Guild Treasure Hunt, each of your teams will explore and battle independently. Treasure Hunters will fight each Treasure Hunter from other guilds once on the same operation. Each Battle Stars' team can encounter enemies up to 100 times per day.

7.Rule: After you have participated in the event, your configured formation will be dispatched every day at 02:00, 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 UTC, subject to the actual operation undertaken. You can adjust your team formation at any time for the next dispatch within the season.

8.Rule: After heroes have been dispatched, their statuses remain locked. Combat calculations are based on the heroes' stats at the time they are dispatched.

9.Rule: Rewards in the Guild Treasure Hunt consist of Personal Quest rewards, Guild Rank rewards, and Fortune Chest rewards.

10.Rule: Guild rank rewards will be sent via mail after the season ends.

1.Title: Guild Treasure Hunt Leaderboard
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are determined by the Prestige of Battle Stars.

2.Rule: The rankings fluctuate daily, and are subject to daily battles. Final rank rewards are determined by the final calculation.

3.Rule: Rank rewards will be mailed as and when they have been calculated.

1.Title: Operation Rules
1.Rule: After you have confirmed an operation, it will be carried out once at 02:00, 08:00, 14:00, and 20:00 UTC respectively. Automatic operations will cease thereafter, and to undertake more operations, you need to dispatch your team again.

1.Title: Guild Points
1.Rule: Guild points are the sum of the individual points of all Battle Stars in that guild.

2.Rule: A Battle Stars member's individual points are the sum of their Prestige and additional leaderboard points.

1.Title: Battle Stars Rules
1.Rule: Your Battle Stars will fight the Battle Stars of the three other guilds on behalf of your guild.

2.Rule: Battle Stars earn Prestige by defeating Battle Stars from other factions.

3.Rule: The top 5 players in the guild with the highest overall hero Combat Rating will be the Battle Stars by default.

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: Martial Rating will be used to participate in the event, so heroes below Lvl 360 will be increased to Lvl 360. Heroes above Lvl 360 will be reduced to Lvl 360, and for every 10 levels in excess of 360, an extra level will be added to the adjusted level, up to Lvl 400.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

7.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Firefly Glow
1.Rule: Players can exchange Luminous Dew for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You can obtain lots of Luminous Dew from Daily Quest Chests.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: When the event ends, remaining Luminous Dew will be recalled for 50,000 Gold each.

1.Title: Whispers of Bloom
1.Rule: During the event, players can obtain Dreamsong Lilies from Dream Realms and gift them to other players on their Personal Info page.

2.Rule: Leaderboard rankings will be determined by the total number of Dreamsong Lilies players gift during the event. Based on your final ranking and lilies you sent, you will have a chance to be rewarded with a limited edition avatar frame. Frames will be sent to your inbox at the end of the event.

3.Rule: The more Dreamsong Lilies gifted by Guild members, the higher the Guild will rank on the regional Guild Gifts Leaderboard. Only the 30 top-ranked players in the Guild who gifted the most will be counted. When a player joins a new Guild, their previous gift-giving record will not be carried into the new Guild.

4.Rule: At the event's end, Guilds can earn avatar frames and emblems based on their ranking.

5.Rule: You will get extra Luminous Dew when you buy Dreamsong Lilies from the Merchant's page.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within. Some quests have two goals, where you only need to achieve either one of them to complete the quest.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Using the Stage Rush feature in Campaign or King's Tower battles will not count toward "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" quests.

6.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: The Dreamy Garden
1.Rule: Players can complete quests on the event page in exchange for a variety of rewards.

2.Rule: Every completed quest will further your progression towards unlocking a new chest. If a complete row or column of quests are completed, a chest will be unlocked and you may claim the rewards it holds within. Some quests have two goals, where you only need to achieve either one of them to complete the quest.

3.Rule: Mercenary heroes may be used to fulfil the Treasure Quests' hero requirements.

4.Rule: Once reaching Chapter 31, each multi-formation battle will be calculated individually, provided that the stage is cleared.

5.Rule: Using the Stage Rush feature in Campaign or King's Tower battles will not count toward "Achieve Victory with X Class Heroes in Formation" quests.

6.Rule: Players can acquire a Hero Choice Chest by completing all of the quests.

1.Title: Arena of Heroes
1.Rule: You must choose a tactic before starting a challenge in the Arena of Heroes. Your tactic will determine the formation and bonuses during battle.

2.Rule: In the Arena of Heroes, you can invite other players to form a team. Teammates can share heroes, but they cannot be used in defensive formations, and each teammate must choose a different tactic. You cannot change teammates or leave your team during a single Arena of Heroes calculation period.

3.Rule: If the attacker defeats a player of a higher rank, their ranks will be swapped.

4.Rule: Martial Rating is applied to heroes in the Arena of Heroes.

5.Rule: If the battle timer runs out of time, the team with the most of heroes on the battlefield will be victorious. If both teams have an equal number of heroes on the battlefield when the timer runs out of time, the team with the highest percentage of remaining health will be considered victorious. Once the victor has been determined, the losing team's remaining heroes will be classed as dead.

6.Rule: Adventurers have 5 free challenge attempts per day, which are reset daily.

7.Rule: One-time rank rewards will be available when an adventurer's all-time highest ranking reaches a certain threshold.

8.Rule: Arena of Heroes results are tallied once per week. Once you meet certain requirements, you'll obtain ranking rewards for both you and your teammate. If you fail to complete 20 challenges during the week, or if the gap between you and your teammate's rankings is too large, you won't receive rewards for your teammate's ranking.

9.Rule: In multi-team mode, the Arena of Heroes uses a Rotating Battle format, in which heroes that survive a battle will retain their health for the next round of combat. The number of teams depends on the number of days the server has been open.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Celestial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Antiquity Stones. When Antiquity Stones are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Crit, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Antiquity Stones respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Antiquity Stones can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 42k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Rule: Players can exchange Antiquity Stones for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

4.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

1.Title: Golden Frontier
1.Rule: Players will form 12 Leagues to fight for cities in Goldsand Province. The League that occupies the Gilded City and Gold Oak in the central zone at the end will be crowned victorious!

2.Rule: The Golden Frontier event is divided into 4 phases: Dawn of Discovery, Border Skirmish, Golden Frenzy, and Crown's Reckoning. Each phase will unlock new areas for players to fight over.

3.Rule: Each day will be divided into the following phases: Rally Phase (UTC 08:00 until 04:00 the next day); Declaration Phase (UTC 08:00-24:00); Siege Phase (UTC 04:00-06:00); and Calculation Phase (UTC 06:00-08:00). For Arcane Tower, the Declaration Phase runs from UTC 08:00-20:00.

4.Rule: The League Leader and Deputy must declare war on a city during the Declaration Phase. In the Rally Phase, players can add their teams to the rally queue, and then start battle during the Siege Phase. The Honor Spotlight will start after the battle ends.

5.Rule: Once your League has occupied a city, you can occupy the city's resource zones to gain production rewards periodically and over time, unlock treasures to gain powerful effects and even more rewards.

6.Rule: Players who perform exceptionally well during the Siege Phase will be on the stage during the Honor Spotlight and receive lots of rewards.

1.Title: Resource Zones
1.Rule: Once your League has occupied a city, League members can occupy the city's resource zones to gain production rewards periodically.

2.Rule: There are 4 types of resource zones: Diamond Lodes, Essence Pools, Phosphorus Veins, and Enlistment Halls. Each type produces different production rewards.

3.Rule: You can only occupy a limited number of resource zones at the same time. Enlistment Halls have their own separate cap. Other zones, like Diamond Lodes, Essence Pools, and Phosphorus Veins, share a combined cap. Unlocking treasures and advancing battle phases can raise your occupation limit.

4.Rule: Rewards from resource zones can be accumulated for up to 48 hours. If these rewards are not claimed after 48 hours, production will stop.

1.Title: Enrollment & Matching
1.Rule: The Expedition game mode opens 1 day after a new server launches, and enrollment begins once Stage 9-40 is cleared. During the 4-day enrollment period, you can choose to enroll individually or as a guild. You can also obtain more rewards from Expeditions via the Oath Pact system.

2.Rule: Players who enroll individually will be allocated into a map and League on their own. Players who enroll as a guild will be allocated into the same map as other guild members who also chose guild enrollment, and whenever possible, they'll be allocated into the same League.

3.Rule: During the enrollment period, players can spend diamonds to sign a pact within the Oath Pact system. Then, after meeting certain conditions, these players will obtain lots of diamonds as rewards when the Expedition ends.

4.Rule: Matchmaking begins when the enrollment period ends, and once matchmaking is complete, players will enter their map. Maps and features will be unlocked gradually during the gameplay phase, followed by a few days for calculations.

5.Rule: After final phase ends, the calculation phase begins, during which players may enroll for the next season on the map. Enrollment closes when the calculation phase ends, and matchmaking for the new season will begin immediately.

6.Rule: The new season will begin once matchmaking is complete. In the new season, all progress from the previous season will be cleared, and new mechanics or modes may become available. For details, please refer to announcements and in-game previews.

1.Title: Honor Spotlight
1.Rule: League members who earned medals on the previous day will have their names recorded in the Tome of Legends.

2.Rule: Tap a member's loot cart in the Tome of Legends to obtain rewards. The better that member's medals are, the better the loot they provide.

3.Rule: Each League member will be able to claim a different number of rewards based on the results and Activity Points they earned during the previous day's battle.

1.Title: League Legends
1.Rule: League rewards will be determined when the event ends.

2.Rule: When results are calculated, all members of Leagues occupying the corresponding cities will receive the corresponding rewards.

1.Title: League
1.Rule: When a League is formed, it will have a default name and avatar, which the League Leader can change.

2.Rule: Upon leaving a League, you will no longer be able to occupy resource zones or attack cities, etc. When you enter the event, you'll be automatically added to the League list menu.

3.Rule: After being expelled from your League during Border Skirmish or Golden Frenzy, you must wait 24 hours to rejoin your original League. This cooldown increases to 48 hours during the Crown's Reckoning phase.

4.Rule: Only League Leaders and League Deputies can perform operations such as declaring war and mobilizing teams, etc. For details, please refer to the permissions interface.

5.Rule: If the League Leader has not logged in for 3 days in a row, or if they have not declared war for 2 days in a row, then regular members whose total historical Contribution reaches a certain rank can initiate the "Dismiss League Leader" process. If the dismissal is successful, the member who initiated it will become the new League Leader.

6.Rule: A cooldown is triggered when the Dismiss League Leader process is initiated, and this cooldown applies to all members.

7.Rule: League Deputies can initiate the Dismiss League Leader process at any time, without being subject to the League Leader's activity requirements.

8.Rule: The Dismiss League Leader feature can only be initiated 1 day after the League Leader Election deadline, and will last for 10 days.

9.Rule: You cannot exit the League or expel League members between the event start and the completion of the League Leader election.

10.Rule: Members cannot be expelled during the last 2 days before the final phase ends.

11.Rule: The "Dismiss League Leader" feature cannot be used if the League has fewer than 20 members.

12.Rule: During Dawn of Discovery and Border Skirmish, if the League Leader and League Deputies do not declare war, war declaration will be automatically made against a city selected by the system.

13.Rule: The Guild with the highest total Contribution Ranking in the League will be designated as the Leading Guild, and its details will be displayed honorably in certain Expedition interfaces.

1.Title: Path to Riches
1.Rule: The Path to Riches will open alongside the Celestial Isles event.

2.Rule: During the event, players can unlock Path to Riches rewards by obtaining Deciphering Skills. Deciphering Skills can be obtained from Daily Quest Chests and event bundles.

3.Rule: Unlock more rewards by acquiring more Deciphering Skills.

4.Rule: Purchase the Path to Riches Splendorous Rewards to upgrade all rewards by 5x and get loads of diamonds!

5.Rule: Any Path to Riches rewards that were unlocked by the player, yet still remain unclaimed will be sent to the player's mailbox when the event ends.

1.Title: Path to Riches
1.Rule: Purchase the Path to Riches Splendorous Rewards to upgrade all rewards by 5x and get loads of diamonds!

2.Rule: The rewards displayed on the purchase page are 4x those unlocked by the player.

3.Rule: If a player has already claimed a portion of the rewards before purchasing the Path to Riches Splendorous Rewards, the player shall be compensated with the reward difference.

4.Rule: If a player has already unlocked a portion of the rewards before purchasing the Path to Riches Splendorous Rewards, the rewards shall be multiplied 5 times after purchasing the Splendorous Rewards deal, but must be claimed manually via the Path to Riches page.

1.Title: Combat Rating Leaderboard
1.Rule: The Combat Rating Leaderboard displays rankings based on the sum of the Combat Ratings of all of a League's members. Rankings are updated based on the cumulative Combat Ratings of the formations each player deploys.

2.Rule: When calculating Combat Rating, bonuses from treasures are not counted.

1.Title: Prosperity Ranking
1.Rule: The Prosperity Ranking ranks Leagues based on the sum of the Prosperity of the cities they occupy.

1.Title: Vault of Riches
1.Rule: The Vault of Riches contains all manner of treasures collected by pirates. You can obtain these legendary relics by meeting certain requirements.

2.Rule: The treasures in this vault have been sealed for a long time, so they'll need to be activated using magical power contained in Phosphorus Gems on the island. Only then can they perform their original function.

3.Rule: Treasures can only be obtained in a certain order. To unlock a treasure, the previous one must be unlocked first.

4.Rule: Some treasures possess additional effects that can only be activated by using Phosphorus Gems.

1.Title: Golden Frontier
1.Rule: The Declaration Phase occurs daily at UTC 08:00-24:00. During this time, League Leaders and League Deputies can declare war on cities. After war has been declared, League members can join the rally. For Arcane Tower, the Declaration Phase runs from UTC 08:00-20:00.

2.Rule: The Rally Phase starts daily at UTC 08:00 and lasts until UTC 04:00 the next day. After a League declares war, League members can dispatch teams to join the rally. Once the rally countdown ends, the city will be attacked.

3.Rule: The Siege Phase occurs daily at UTC 04:00-06:00. During this time, League members can attack declared cities and can enter cities to spectate.

4.Rule: The Calculation Phase occurs daily at UTC 06:00-08:00. At the Honor Spotlight, League members can congratulate their top performers for the day and claim rewards.

4.Rule: The Calculation Phase occurs daily at UTC 06:00-08:00. At the Honor Spotlight, League members can congratulate their top performers for the day and claim rewards.

1.Rule: The Declaration Phase occurs daily at (UTC+8) 23:00 until 15:00 the next day. During this time, League Leaders and League Deputies can declare war on cities. After war has been declared, League members can join the rally.

2.Rule: The Rally Phase occurs daily at (UTC+8) 23:00 until 19:00 the next day. After a League declares war, League members can dispatch teams to join the rally. Once the rally countdown ends, the city will be attacked.

3.Rule: The Siege Phase occurs daily at (UTC+8) 19:00-21:00. During this time, League members can attack declared cities and can enter cities to spectate.

4.Rule: The Calculation Phase occurs daily at (UTC+8) 21:00-23:00. At the Honor Spotlight, League members can congratulate their top performers for the day and claim rewards.

2.Rule: The Rally Phase occurs daily at (UTC+8) 23:00 until 19:00 the next day. After a League declares war, League members can dispatch teams to join the rally. Once the rally countdown ends, the city will be attacked.
