1.Title: Office Overhaul
1.Rule: The Office Overhaul event lasts 14 days. During the event, visit different departments of the "Infernal Enterprises" company and unite the Monster Staff underling workers to overthrow the tyrannical rule of their Overlord Supervisors.

2.Rule: The strength of enemies is based upon each player's own strength. Enemies' strength levels will not change during the event.

3.Rule: One area will be unlocked each of the first 7 days of the event, but you must complete all Performance Evaluations in the preceding area in order to enter the next area.

4.Rule: While exploring, you will encounter Monster Staff underling workers on the map. After Monster Staff join your team, they can be deployed in the Performance Evaluation game mode.

5.Rule: While exploring the map, you can obtain Slacking Tools, which can be used to upgrade your entire team in the Performance Evaluation game mode.

6.Rule: While exploring the map, you can also unlock Field Exposure, the contents of which will be included in Workplace Talk. After clearing an area, more Workplace Talk content will be unlocked.

1.Title: Executive Alignment
1.Rule: For each area you clear, you will unlock 2 Executive Alignment requirements. There are a total of 14 requirements.

2.Rule: You'll need to make choices to progress through requirements. If you make the right choice, you'll earn Monster Moolah and complete the requirement. If you make the wrong choice, you'll have to advance to the requirement again.

3.Rule: Monster Moolah can be used to purchase gear at the Supply Depot to upgrade your Monster Staff in the Performance Evaluation game mode.

1.Title: Loot Codex
1.Rule: The Loot Codex will be available during the Office Overhaul event, which lasts 14 days.

2.Rule: Complete Office Overhaul quests to increase your Campaign Score. The higher your Campaign Score, the more rewards you'll get.

3.Rule: Players who purchase and unlock the Loot Codex but have not claimed all rewards 4 days before the Loot Codex ends can use diamonds to increase their Campaign Score.

4.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Loot Codex ends.

1.Title: Performance Evaluation
1.Rule: For each area you clear, you will unlock the corresponding Overlord Supervisor's Performance Evaluation. Once you've completed all 7 Performance Evaluations, Zero Limit will be unlocked.

2.Rule: Each Overlord Supervisor's Performance Evaluation consists of 3 battles, including 2 Minion Liquidations and 1 Ultimate Assessment. The Minion Liquidations must be completed before you can advance to the Ultimate Assessment.

3.Rule: By completing Minion Liquidations, you'll earn Monster Moolah, which can be used to purchase gear at the Supply Depot and upgrade your Monster Staff. After completing all Performance Evaluations, you'll also earn a certain amount of Monster Moolah to help prepare for Zero Limit.

4.Rule: All Performance Evaluation battles are fully automated and turn-based. Each turn is considered finished when all units on both sides have completed an action. Failure to win within a certain number of turns will result in defeat.

5.Rule: In Performance Evaluation battles, you go first and the enemy goes next. The order of actions depends on each unit's position, and the targeted enemy is also based on positioning.

6.Rule: Your Star Level will be determined by the number of turns used to win the Ultimate Assessment battle in a Performance Evaluation. The fewer the turns used, the higher your Star Level will be and the more rewards you'll get.

7.Rule: In Zero Limit, the enemy has unlimited HP and there is a fixed number of turns. Players must try to deal as much damage as possible to the enemy within the limited number of turns.

8.Rule: In the Performance Evaluation game mode, there are 2 ways to upgrade your Monster Staff: ① Purchase gear at the Supply Depot and equip it on your Monster Staff. ② Explore the map to obtain Slacking Tools and upgrade your entire team.

9.Rule: The gear available at the Supply Depot will increase as you progress through Performance Evaluations.

10.Rule: Legendary gear pieces correspond to different Monster Staff. Equip gear on the right Monster Staff to unlock extra effects.

11.Rule: Each Monster Staff can equip up to 1 piece of Legendary gear.

1.Title: Spirit Powers
1.Rule: When the daily Rally Phase begins, you can spend Tide Shells to activate any one of a variety of Spirit Powers.

2.Rule: You can spend Tide Shells to refresh the available Spirit Powers.

3.Rule: You must select your Spirit Power during the Rally Phase. If you have not selected a Spirit Power by the time the Siege Phase begins, you won't be able to do so for the remainder of the day.

4.Rule: Once you've activated a Spirit Power, it cannot be changed. It will expire when the next Rally Phase begins.

1.Title: Arms Mobilization
1.Rule: After the daily Rally Phase begins, adventurers can mobilize arms in the Armory of their League's capital.

2.Rule: Adventurers can exchange Tide Shells for arms to obtain more Tide Shells after 4 hours. The League will also receive an equal amount of Gear Value when preparation begins.

3.Rule: Each player can only mobilize arms once during the Rally/Siege Phase. Players will be unable to mobilize arms within 4 hours before Siege Phase begins.

4.Rule: During arms mobilization, the more Tide Shells a player spends, the better returns they will get for their investment, but the amount they lose when looted will also increase accordingly.

5.Rule: When an adventurer begins mobilizing arms, they will be in the Disorganized state, and if they are looted during this time, their teams will be greatly weakened. Once looting reaches a certain value, they will become Inattentive, during which they are slightly weakened. Eventually, their state will return to normal.

6.Rule: Adventurers can loot enemy Leagues while they are mobilizing arms, gaining some of the Tide Shells the enemy lost.

7.Rule: When a player plunders another player's Tide Shells, the plundered player's League will also lose the corresponding amount of Gear Value.

8.Rule: Each looting attempt costs a certain amount of Stamina, which is restored to max every day when the Rally Phase begins.

9.Rule: When you lose a loot battle, you will receive a small amount of Tide Shells based on the number of enemy teams defeated.

10.Rule: When a League's Gear Value reaches a certain amount, all of their teams will be enhanced when attacking cities during the daily Siege Phase.

1.Title: Spirit Shop
1.Rule: The rewards at the Spirit Shop will be refreshed each season.

2.Rule: During this season, once you collect a certain number of Tide Shells via any channel, you can exchange them for a variety of rewards.

3.Rule: Any unused Tide Shells will be removed when the season ends, so be sure to exchange them in time!

1.Title: Veteran Supplies
1.Rule: The rewards at Veteran Supplies will be refreshed each season.

2.Rule: Spend Army Units and reach milestones during this season to unlock and claim various rewards.

3.Rule: After the season ends, the total Army Units spent will reset. Remember to claim your rewards in time.

1.Title: Flashy Finale
1.Rule: Purchasing the bundle below will grant you the special event item "Thorny Rose". Gather a certain number of Thorny Roses to obtain rewards such as resources or avatar frames.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: Martial Rating will be used to participate in the event, so heroes below Lvl 360 will be increased to Lvl 360. Heroes above Lvl 360 will be reduced to Lvl 360, and for every 10 levels in excess of 360, an extra level will be added to the adjusted level, up to Lvl 400.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

7.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Beast Wish
1.Rule: Use Wish Leaves to perform beast wishes and obtain rewards such as beasts, Spirit Dew, and emblems.

2.Rule: Wishes also have a chance to drop lots of diamonds.

3.Rule: The prizes pool's fabled beast is set to be the same as the player's Wish Beast.

1.Title: Oath Pact
1.Rule: Players can spend 5,000 diamonds to sign an Oath Pact.

2.Rule: After signing an Oath Pact and entering the season's map, the player will receive an Oath Bond.

3.Rule: While a player holds an Oath Bond, they will enjoy certain perks, including an exclusive emoji and an exclusive chat emblem, and they cannot be kicked out of the League as long as they participate actively.

4.Rule: If a player exits their League while holding an Oath Bond, it will disappear.

5.Rule: If a player holds the Oath Bond until the season ends, rewards will be sent based on whether their League occupied the Gilded City and/or the Gold Oak.

1.Title: Suntrail Banquet
1.Rule: The Suntrail Banquet will be available during the Predator's Advance event, which lasts 14 days.

2.Rule: Complete Predator's Advance quests to obtain Banquet Supplies. The more Banquet Supplies you earn, the more rewards you'll get.

3.Rule: Players who purchase and unlock the Suntrail Banquet but have not claimed all rewards 4 days before the Suntrail Banquet ends can use diamonds to obtain more Banquet Supplies.

4.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when the Suntrail Banquet ends.

1.Title: Surge Showdown
1.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

2.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies, and each team can only use a limited number of Hunter's Tokens.

3.Rule: In Surge Showdown, adventurers will receive rewards for reaching certain damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

5.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

6.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

7.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

8.Rule: Adventurers will receive Fortune Chests based on the ranking of their highest-ranked guild member on the leaderboard. Fortune Chests will be sent when leaderboards are calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: Adventurers can view replays of battles in which other adventurers dealt their highest damage. This can help adventurers learn about better formations.

3.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are subject to constant changes, so rewards will only be settled when the final rankings are calculated.

1.Title: A Shared Hunt
1.Rule: Esperia's annual summertime feast is about to kick off, and this year, adventurers will work with Alvida to organize the meal. A massive sea monster was spotted off the coast, so get ready to hunt it down for cooking ingredients! Gather your companions and set sail!

2.Rule: For the first 7 days of the event, 1 exploration voyage will be unlocked each day. After completing a voyage, that day's sea monster stage will be unlocked.

3.Rule: Explore to unlock Memorable Moments in the Captain's Log.

1.Title: Predator's Advance
1.Rule: For the first 7 days of the event, a new sea monster stage will be unlocked each day. You must complete the previous stage to challenge the next one.

2.Rule: Each stage contains sea monsters of various difficulties. Reaching Lvl 1 is considered completing the stage. Each stage can be replayed, but the rewards from each level can only be claimed once. The Hunter's Tokens obtained by completing stages can be used in Surge Showdown.

3.Rule: Adventurers must organize and combine supplies in the preparation area to prepare the supplies (clothing, weapons, food, etc.) that heroes need. Once the supplies are prepared, heroes can carry out attack commands to deal damage to sea monsters.

5.Rule: Tap to use the Supply Generator and spend Stamina to get random supplies. Once Stamina is exhausted and there are no more attack commands to deliver, supplies to combine, or supplies to use directly in the stage, the stage will end and the results will be calculated.

6.Rule: Adventurers may pause at any time during the voyage. If you exit, you can choose either to settle the current challenge or to save your progress and continue later. You can also restart the stage and try it again.

7.Rule: The first time you obtain a new type of supplies, the portrait for that type will be unlocked, as well as its portrait rewards. After unlocking all supplies, you'll obtain an avatar frame.

1.Title: League Quests
1.Rule: When the phase ends, rewards will be sent based on the League's quest completion status and each member's Phase Contribution Rankings.

2.Rule: When the phase ends, if the League has completed all quest objectives and the player ranks in the top 60 in League Phase Contribution, they will receive Elite Rewards.

3.Rule: When the phase ends, if the League has completed all quest objectives and the player ranks below 60th place in League Phase Contribution, they will receive Common Rewards.

1.Title: Personal Quests
1.Rule: Players earn points by completing personal quests, and once their points reach certain tiers, they can claim the corresponding rewards.

1.Title: Management Contest
1.Rule: Management Contest lasts until 10 minutes before the official start of the first round of siege battles.

2.Rule: When the countdown ends, the top 4 players in Total Combat Rating will become League Deputies.

3.Rule: The League Leader will be chosen by a subsequent election process.

1.Title: League Leader Election
1.Rule: League Leader elections last 72 hours, during which all League members may participate.

2.Rule: It costs 500 diamonds to participate in the election.

3.Rule: Each player may cast their vote during the election period, and when it ends, the player who got the most votes will become the League Leader.

4.Rule: If there is a tie in votes, the player with the highest Combat Rating will take precedence.

1.Title: Unlimited Summons
1.Rule: During the event, you can use an unlimited number of 10x summons, but you can only claim the results of a single 10x summon.

2.Rule: Recording summons: You can record a summoning result you're happy with before starting the next 10x summon. If you get a result you like more, then you can replace the old record with the new one.

3.Rule: Confirming summons: You can select and confirm a result from either Current Summons or Recorded Summons. Once confirmed, you will receive the corresponding rewards.

4.Rule: Once a summoning result has been confirmed, you can no longer summon in this event.

5.Rule: Summoning results that have been recorded but not confirmed will be sent via mail after the event ends.

6.Rule: In this Unlimited Summons event, players will not summon skins they already own.

7.Rule: After obtaining a skin, you'll need to activate it from your Bag. (Skins cannot be activated if you don't own the corresponding hero.)

8.Rule: In this Unlimited Summons event, the reward pool does not include Dimensional heroes, Awakened heroes, or any heroes launched after July 30, 2025.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: There are two leaderboards of rankings: League and Individual.

2.Rule: The League Leaderboard is ranked based on Prosperity, which Leagues can earn by occupying cities.

3.Rule: There are four Individual Leaderboards: Combat Rating, Kills, Medals, and Legions, which rank individual players based on their performance in each domain. The data in Individual Leaderboards will not be cleared if you exit your League.

4.Rule: The Kills Leaderboard is based on the total number of teams a player defeats during sieges. The top 200 rankings will be visible to all players, while lower rankings will only be visible to individuals themselves.

5.Rule: The Combat Rating Leaderboard is based on the total Combat Rating of all teams a player owns. The top 200 rankings will be visible to all players, while lower rankings will only be visible to individuals themselves.

6.Rule: The Medals Leaderboard is based on the total number of medals a player earns at the Honor Spotlight. Gold Medals are prioritized during ranking, and if two players have the same number of Gold Medals, then Silver Medals are compared. The top 200 rankings will be visible to all players, while lower rankings will only be visible to individuals themselves.

7.Rule: Legion Rankings are based on the total number of enemy Army Units spent during sieges. The top 200 rankings will be visible to all players, while lower rankings will only be visible to individuals themselves.

1.Title: Fresh Start
1.Rule: If a player hasn't logged in for 30 days, the Fresh Start event can be activated the next time they log in.

2.Rule: The Fresh Start event lasts for 14 days. You can choose "Continue Adventure" to carry on with your journey. Alternatively, you can select "Second Life" to visit a new server and embark on a new journey.

3.Rule: If you choose to continue your journey, you will begin the exclusive Noble Reunion event in which you can obtain generous rewards by earning daily Activity Points. You can also still select "Second Life" and visit a new server, and your progress on your original server will not be affected.

4.Rule: If you choose Second Life to embark on a new journey, you will be able to create a new character on a new server, skip some tutorials and Stages, and obtain the corresponding rewards. Players who meet certain requirements will also receive some Targeted Summons.

5.Rule: If you activate the Fresh Start event but you've already got an existing character on the newest server, then you won't be able to select Second Life. You'll need to wait until a newer server opens and select Second Life before the Fresh Start event ends.

1.Title: Realm of Shadows
1.Rule: The blaze of war in the Goldsand Province awakened an ancient seal, revealing a mysterious realm to the mortal world. Complete trials in this dangerous realm to earn treasures!

2.Rule: Each of the player's teams will start with 6 Blessed Flames, which can be used to challenge treasure guards. Every 10 hours, 6 torches will be regained.

3.Rule: Some cities contain Mystic Gates. After a player's League occupies such a city, they can challenge higher floors of the Realm of Shadows.

4.Rule: Inside Mystic Gates, guardians protect the treasures. Defeat them within a certain amount of time to receive a reward, and adventurers from your League who have not yet defeated that guardian will also receive a reward. Treasure guardians will leave after a certain amount of time, after which they cannot be fought.

1.Title: Hunter Perks
1.Rule: After activating perks, players will obtain additional powerful supply crates at the start of battle and as they progress through the map. These crates contain various enhancement resources and health recovery items.

2.Rule: The first time your medals are depleted, you'll receive Dura's Blessing. For a while, enemies won't attack you, and when it ends, you'll gain an extra medal.

3.Rule: Destroying ammo crates spawns stronger ammo crates.

4.Rule: Heroes start each stage with 3 extra lives.

5.Rule: After purchasing Hunter Perks, you'll obtain extra rewards for completing challenges.

1.Title: Demon Hunter Upgrade
1.Rule: Each demon-hunting hero has 4 exclusive skills, each with different unlock requirements. Tap a skill icon to view its effects and how to unlock it.

2.Rule: Skill 1: Unlocks automatically upon obtaining the hero.

3.Rule: Skill 2: Unlocks when the hero reaches a certain level.

4.Rule: Skill 3: Unlocks when the hero reaches a certain tier.

5.Rule: Skill 4: Unlocks upon obtaining the activation item "Gilded Dust", which has a certain chance of dropping from Aberrant Threat. Gilded Dust can also be purchased in limited-time bundles.

1.Title: Threat Realm Bounties
1.Rule: The Bounty Hunters Guild is constantly issuing Threat Realm bounties, enlisting all manner of Elite heroes to help purge the remaining demons that lurk in the shadows. Players can enter and challenge the corresponding Chapters once the Chapter requirements are met.

2.Rule: Stages will become unlocked based on the player's Campaign progress.

3.Rule: Players can claim one-time rewards every time they complete a stage for the first time.

4.Rule: The player can obtain stars in each stage by fulfilling certain requirements. After reaching a certain number of stars, the chest with extra rewards in the bottom right will be unlocked.

5.Rule: Players can unlock Aberrant Threat stages once they obtain a total of 24 stars.

6.Rule: Once Aberrant Threat is unlocked, an Aberrant Threat stage will spawn on the map each day, for a maximum of 3 Aberrant Threats. After reaching the maximum, adventurers must handle the current Aberrant Threats to spawn a new one.

7.Rule: Players can earn Special Stars by clearing Aberrant Threat stages. After collecting a certain number of Special Stars, players can open a chest to get even better rewards.

1.Title: Merit Crowning
1.Rule: Starting from the Border Skirmish phase, the League Leader can award medals to members. There are 2 tiers of medals: Dawnbringer Vanguard and Radiant Knight.

2.Rule: There is a limit on the number of times each tier of medals can be awarded during each phase. The limit will reset when starting a new phase.

3.Rule: A player can only be awarded 1 medal per phase.

4.Rule: If a player leaves their League after receiving a medal, the medal will be recalled, but the player will retain the other rewards. The League Leader will not be refunded the Merit Crowning attempts used.

5.Rule: If a player's rank is reduced after receiving a medal, they will retain the medal as well as the other rewards.

6.Rule: Medals awarded to players will be displayed on the League Members screen, Golden Frontier Chat, and City Garrison screen.

7.Rule: Players who have joined the League for fewer than 3 days are not eligible for medals, regardless of their rank.

8.Rule: Each player can only receive 1 medal per phase. This limit does not reset when switching Leagues.

9.Rule: Players with fewer than 10,000 Contribution Points for the current phase are not eligible for medals.

10.Rule: R1 players are not eligible for medals.

11.Rule: League Leaders cannot award medals to themselves.

1.Title: Misty Heist
1.Rule: Hazy Mist has set in, and resource zones of affected Cities can now be robbed by other Leagues.

2.Rule: When a resource zone is robbed, the rewards depend on which option is selected. High-risk options reduce the success rate of robberies, but yield better rewards when successful.

3.Rule: There is a daily limit on the number of robberies each player can perform. This limit resets every 24 hours, starting from the onset of Hazy Mist weather.

4.Rule: League Leaders and Deputies can tap the Recommend button to designate 1 City affected by Hazy Mist as a recommended target for robbery. That City will be displayed prominently at the top of the League's robbery interface.

5.Rule: Successful robberies reduce the Durability of the corresponding resource zone. When a resource zone's Durability reaches zero, it enters the "Production Halted" state and stops producing resources for 24 hours.

6.Rule: Players cannot rob their own League's resource zones.

1.Title: Celestial Celebrations
1.Rule: Celebratory Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players may acquire treasure or Dragonberries. Dragonberries have a chance to trigger a Critical Strike, which grants players double the amount of Dragonberries they can receive, and even more!

4.Rule: Dragonberries can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Dragonberries will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: When the event ends, any remaining Celebratory Keys will be recalled for 42,000 Gold per key.

1.Title: Celestial Celebrations
1.Rule: Celebratory Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

4.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Remaining Dragonberries will be recalled for 24k gold each one once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Recommended Heroes
1.Rule: Periodically, heroes will be recommended based on their performance in Expeditions.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: Martial Rating will be used to participate in the event, so heroes below Lvl 360 will be increased to Lvl 360. Heroes above Lvl 360 will be reduced to Lvl 360, and for every 10 levels in excess of 360, an extra level will be added to the adjusted level, up to Lvl 400.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

7.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Starlit Dream
1.Rule: During the event, players that have cleared Stage 2-4 may participate and purchase limited-time bundles.

1.Title: Domain Challenge
1.Rule: During the event, complete hero improvement quests to unlock limited-time Hunter's Challenge maps.

2.Rule: This event is a limited-time challenge. When the event ends, the map entrance will close and unlocked maps will be lost, so make sure to complete map challenges before the event ends.

3.Rule: Complete challenges on Hunter's Challenge maps to experience new mechanics and new enemies—and plentiful rewards, of course!

4.Rule: If you use a hero designated as an improvement target as upgrade material, the improvement quest progress will be reset, so please proceed with caution.

5.Rule: Only after completing all challenges on unlocked maps and meeting all improvement targets to unlock a new map may you enter the new map and complete its challenges.

1.Title: Nocturnal Rhymes
1.Rule: Nocturnal Rhymes will commence during the Noctis Animarum Festival, and will run for 14 days.

2.Rule: Complete quests in the Noctis Animarum Festival to acquire Prank Candy. The more Prank Candy earned, the greater the rewards unlocked.

3.Rule: Players who purchase and unlock Nocturnal Rhymes but have not claimed all rewards 4 days before Nocturnal Rhymes ends can use diamonds to obtain more Prank Candy.

4.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Nocturnal Rhymes ends.

1.Title: Mischief Shop
1.Rule: During the 14-day event period, you can exchange candy for various rewards.

2.Rule: You can earn tons of candy from Hollow Harvest! Challenge different bosses to earn different types of candy.

3.Rule: After the event, excess candy will be automatically recalled by the system.

1.Title: Pumpkin Siege
1.Rule: During the event, complete special themed challenges to earn rewards.

2.Rule: During the first 8 days of the event, 1 themed challenge will be unlocked each day. Note that you have to complete preceding challenges to unlock later ones.

3.Rule: Each themed challenge includes a training stage and a challenge stage. Complete the training stage to unlock the challenge stage.

4.Rule: In themed challenges, you can freely choose your lineup from a preset roster of heroes, regardless of the development progress of your heroes.

5.Rule: Within the challenge stage of a themed challenge, there are various Star Rating objectives. Take note of the mechanics and deploy suitable heroes to get higher Star Ratings in battles, resulting in more rewards.

6.Rule: You can play themed challenges as many times as you want, with no limit on challenge attempts.

1.Title: Hollow Harvest
1.Rule: Different bosses will be unlocked during different phases of the event.

2.Rule: You can challenge each boss 5 times daily for free, after which you'll have to spend diamonds to get more challenge attempts. One attempt is spent every time you enter a challenge.

3.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies.

4.Rule: You'll earn candy based on the highest damage you dealt each day. Candy can be exchanged for rewards at the Mischief Shop.

5.Rule: Only the highest damage you've dealt to each boss will be recorded and counted toward your real-time leaderboard ranking. Final rankings will be determined at the time of result calculations.

6.Rule: Each boss has its own result calculation time. Any damage dealt to the boss after this calculation time will not be counted in the rankings.

7.Rule: Ranking rewards include Individual Ranking Rewards and Guild Treasures. Ranking rewards will be sent via mail when leaderboard calculations are finalized.

8.Rule: During the event, all bosses that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Candy rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: Adventurers can view replays of battles in which other adventurers dealt their highest damage. This can help adventurers learn about better formations.

3.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are subject to constant changes, so rewards will only be settled when the final rankings are calculated.

1.Title: Champion's Clash
1.Rule: Declare war on various tower buildings on the map to initiate rallies for Champion's Clash. Declaring war for Champion's Clash follows the same rules as normal city sieges, and costs 1 War Banner.

2.Rule: Champion's Clash uses an assault force of up to 5 chariot commanders and 25 crew members.

3.Rule: When declaring war, the system will automatically select the 5 League members with the highest Combat Rating to serve as chariot commanders.

4.Rule: Crew members must be invited by the chariot commander to join the crew. The crew member will board immediately upon invitation—acceptance is not required. The commander may only invite their friends from the same League or League members in the queue.

5.Rule: League Leaders and Deputies have the authority to replace chariot commanders and invite others to take on the role. This invitation must be accepted to take effect.

6.Rule: In Champion's Clash battles, the 5 chariot commanders will engage in a rotating battle of 1-on-1 battles between all teams. The first team to win 3 of 5 battles will be declared the final winner. If a chariot loses its commander, it is considered defeated. In the event of a tie in points, the defending side wins.

7.Rule: During battle, for every crew member present, the commander gains 1 extra full-team respawn after defeat, enabling them to continue fighting in future battles.

8.Rule: The deployment order in Champion's Clash is determined by ranking all allied chariot commanders by Combat Rating, with those ranked higher entering battle earlier.

9.Rule: When multiple parties attack, duels will be performed one after another. The League with the lowest Total Combat Rating will fight first.

10.Rule: After occupying a tower, maintaining control for 2 days in a row will grant all participating players (chariot commanders and crew members) a one-time reward. Other League members can give a Like to claim a small number of Tide Shells.

11.Rule: After capturing multiple towers, you can still only claim rewards from any single tower once.

12.Rule: Participating in Champion's Clash, whether on offense or defense, will not affect the player's ability to join rallies for normal city sieges.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Rule: You can acquire factional sigils while The Lost Sigils event is underway.

2.Rule: Each victory you achieve will reward you with sigils that correspond to the factions of the heroes that were used in the battle.

3.Rule: Using Dimensional heroes will reward you with random sigils.

4.Rule: You may only receive sigils from a battle if you are victorious. You can undertake up to 6 battles per day that will reward you with event sigils.

5.Rule: In order to improve your gaming experience, several adjustments may be made to your matched opponent's formation strength to ensure balance.

6.Rule: You may lend mercenary heroes from your friends or guild mates without any limits on how many times they can be used.

7.Rule: Players may exchange sigils for rewards up until the event ends (for 14 days).

8.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

9.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Twisted Essence at the Elder Tree, which can be used to strengthen heroes after completing Stage 12-40.

10.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Dura's Artifact Fragment Choice Chests after completing stage 13-40.

11.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Bait after completing Stage 14-40.

12.Rule: You must complete Stage 16-40 to redeem Reset Scrolls. Reset Scrolls can be used to reset the factional bonuses of Mythic tier or higher gear.

13.Rule: Event items may be exchanged for Poe Coins after you unlock the Oak Inn feature.

14.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 20-60.

15.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Elemental Shards and Elemental Cores after completing Stage 21-60.

16.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

17.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 25-60.

18.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T3 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 29-60.

19.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T4 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 32-60.

20.Rule: Once the event has ended, Chests of Omnipotence and sigils will be recalled in exchange for the 50k Gold per chest.

21.Rule: If you choose Sweep, you will skip the battle and directly see the battle result.

22.Rule: In Sweep, if you check the auto-matching option, you will be automatically matched with opponents for consecutive challenges until you run out of reward-claiming attempts for the day.

1.Title: Rewards
1.Rule: In Temporal Rift, each floor has a certain point value, and reaching a floor shows that the player has attained that point value.

2.Rule: You can visit the rewards screen to claim rewards depending on your highest score.

3.Rule: There are "initial rewards" and "repeat rewards". Initial rewards can only be claimed one time, while repeat rewards can be claimed again the next time the event opens.

4.Rule: Each season, once a player reaches the minimum number of challenges (as shown on the rewards screen), they can receive duplicate rewards based on their highest historical score, but only once per season.

5.Rule: The higher the Infernal Chasm difficulty, the more floors it will contain and the more points it will award.

1.Title: Infernal Chasm
1.Rule: The Infernal Chasm has the same Temporal Beacon as the Normal tower, but the enemies will be much stronger.

2.Rule: The higher the difficulty and the higher the floor in Infernal Chasm, the more points you'll earn.

3.Rule: Each new season, you'll be assigned to an Infernal Chasm difficulty based on your performance during the previous season.

4.Rule: Players in the highest difficulty of Infernal Chasm this season will enter the leaderboard and compete for Honorable Rewards.

1.Title: Infernal Chasm
1.Rule: As the fabric of time is shredded, the infernal prison of illusion descends. Only the strongest can break free from that false realm.

2.Rule: Upon clearing Floor 300 of Temporal Rift, Infernal Chasm will be unlocked.

1.Title: Tapestry of Light
1.Rule: Purchasing the bundle below will also grant you the special event item "Arcane Stardust". Collect a certain amount of Arcane Stardust to obtain rewards such as resources or avatar frames.

1.Title: Army Units
1.Rule: A team can only rally or garrison if it has Army Units in its Army Unit Bar. Teams with 0 units will remain idle. They can't be deployed or join siege battles to protect their city.

2.Rule: Selecting a team will automatically add your available Army Units to its Army Unit Bar, but it won't be applied until you tap Rally or Garrison. If you cancel Rally/Garrison, the added Army Units will be refunded.

3.Rule: A team having a seasonal hero gains an Army Unit Bar cap bonus. The effect does not stack within the same team.

4.Rule: Once you enter a siege, you lose Army Units after every city battle, regardless of the outcome. When your Army Unit count falls to 1, it is considered depleted. Your team can still advance and occupy cities, and no further troop loss will occur, but you won't be able to beat enemies with more Army Units in a city battle.

5.Rule: The auto-replenish cap is 5,000 Army Units per team per Siege Phase.

1.Title: Arms Mobilization
1.Rule: After the daily Rally Phase begins, adventurers can mobilize arms in the Armory of their League's capital.

2.Rule: Adventurers can dispatch soldiers to recruit. After 4 hours, you'll get additional soldiers. When mobilization begins, your League will immediately gain an equal amount of Gear Value.

3.Rule: Each player can only mobilize arms once during the Rally/Siege Phase. Players will be unable to mobilize arms within 4 hours before Siege Phase begins.

4.Rule: During Arms Mobilization, the more soldiers you dispatch, the better returns you will get for your investment, but the amount you lose when looted will also increase accordingly.

5.Rule: When an adventurer begins mobilizing arms, they will be in the Disorganized state, and if they are looted during this time, their teams will be greatly weakened. Once looting reaches a certain value, they will become Inattentive, during which they are slightly weakened. Eventually, their state will return to normal.

6.Rule: Adventurers can loot enemy Leagues while they are mobilizing arms, gaining some enemy soldiers.

7.Rule: When a player plunders another player's Army Units, the plundered player's League will also lose the corresponding amount of Gear Value.

8.Rule: Each looting attempt costs a certain amount of Stamina, which is restored to max every day when the Rally Phase begins.

9.Rule: When you lose a loot battle, you will receive a small number of soldiers based on the number of enemy teams defeated.

10.Rule: When a League's Gear Value reaches a certain amount, all of their teams will be enhanced when attacking cities during the daily Siege Phase.

1.Title: Coveted Invite
1.Rule: During the Coveted Invite event, you will receive a Fidelia seedling. By completing certain quests, you can acquire Water Drops to cultivate Fidelia.

2.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Sprout and Bud phases, you will receive corresponding rewards.

3.Rule: Once your Fidelia has grown to the Bloom phase, you can send a letter inviting your favorite hero to join your team!

1.Title: Champion's Clash
1.Rule: Declare war on various tower buildings on the map to initiate rallies for Champion's Clash. Declaring war for Champion's Clash follows the same rules as normal city sieges, and costs 1 War Banner.

2.Rule: Champion's Clash uses an assault force of up to 5 chariot commanders and 25 crew members.

3.Rule: When declaring war, the system will automatically select the 5 League members with the highest Combat Rating to serve as chariot commanders.

4.Rule: Crew members must be invited by the chariot commander to join the crew. The crew member will board immediately upon invitation—acceptance is not required. The commander may only invite their friends from the same League or League members in the queue.

5.Rule: League Leaders and Deputies have the authority to replace chariot commanders and invite others to take on the role. This invitation must be accepted to take effect.

6.Rule: In Champion's Clash battles, the 5 chariot commanders will engage in a rotating battle of 1-on-1 battles between all teams. The first team to win 3 of 5 battles will be declared the final winner. If a chariot loses its commander, it is considered defeated. In the event of a tie in points, the defending side wins.

7.Rule: During battle, for every crew member present, the commander gains 1 extra full-team respawn after defeat, enabling them to continue fighting in future battles.

8.Rule: The deployment order in Champion's Clash is determined by ranking all allied chariot commanders by Combat Rating, with those ranked higher entering battle earlier.

9.Rule: When multiple parties attack, duels will be performed one after another. The League with the lowest Total Combat Rating will fight first.

10.Rule: After occupying a tower, maintaining control for 2 days in a row will grant all participating players (chariot commanders and crew members) a one-time reward. Other League members can give a Like to claim a small number of Phosphorus Gems.

11.Rule: After capturing multiple towers, you can still only claim rewards from any single tower once.

12.Rule: Participating in Champion's Clash, whether on offense or defense, will not affect the player's ability to join rallies for normal city sieges.

1.Title: Sealed Pledge
1.Rule: Players can exchange Sealing Wax for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You can obtain lots of Sealing Wax from Daily Quest Chests.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: When the event ends, remaining Sealing Waxes will be recalled for 50,000 Gold each.

1.Title: Everlasting Vows
1.Rule: During the event, you can obtain Oathbound Camellias from Dream Realms and gift them to other players on their Personal Info pages.

2.Rule: When the event ends, players will be ranked based on the number of Oathbound Camellias they received. You'll have a chance to obtain an event avatar frame based on the rankings and the number of Oathbound Camellias you gifted. The frame will be sent by mail, so don't forget to claim it!

3.Rule: The more Oathbound Camellias gifted by Guild members, the higher the Guild will rank on the regional Guild Gifts Leaderboard. Only the 30 top-ranked players in the Guild who gifted the most will be counted. When a player joins a new Guild, their previous gift-giving record will not be carried into the new Guild.

4.Rule: At the event's end, Guilds can earn avatar frames and emblems based on their ranking.

5.Rule: You will get extra Oathbound Camellias when you buy Sealing Wax from the Merchant's page.

1.Title: Crimsonflame Nightstalk
1.Rule: During the event, players that have cleared Stage 2-4 may participate and purchase limited-time bundles.

1.Title: Retire Heroes
1.Rule: Hero ascension uses a new resource: Faction Soul Gems.

2.Rule: The ascension interface has been moved from the Temple of Ascension to the Heroes screen.

3.Rule: You can convert old heroes to the new resource without losing any value.

1.Title: Radiant Revelry
1.Rule: As Esperia's annual springtime feast approaches, players will work with Gorren to prepare for the celebrations. Another gigantic sea monster has been spotted off the shore, a rare opportunity to gather premium meal ingredients. Rally your companions and set sail! Wait... "Another" sea monster?

2.Rule: For the first 10 days of the event, 1 sea monster stage will unlock per day. You must complete the previous stages and wait until the next stage unlocks before you can take it on.

3.Rule: Lumina Riches stages will be unlocked on Days 8 to 10 of the event. These stages provide more items, so your heroes will be inspired to fight, and their attack commands will deal increased damage. Get ready to give it a try, adventurers!

1.Title: Lumina Riches
1.Rule: Lumina Riches is a traditional custom during springtime, where adventurers and their heroes join forces to hunt monsters while they wish for prosperity in the coming new year.

2.Rule: On Days 8 to 10 of Radiant Revelry, 1 Lumina Riches stage will be unlocked each day. You must complete the previous stages and wait until the next stage unlocks before you can take it on.

3.Rule: In Lumina Riches stages, requests have a chance to gain a random multiplier bonus, dealing extra damage to monsters.

4.Rule: In Lumina Riches, aside from Stage Rewards, you can also get Bonus Rewards if your total best score across the 3 stages reaches certain thresholds.

1.Title: Lucky Wheel
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 6-40 can obtain Goldsheaf Tickets by completing daily quests.

2.Rule: Goldsheaf Tickets can be spent to spin the wheel and obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Random rewards include: First Prize, Second Prize, and Third Prize, with the lower-tier prizes having a higher drop rate. The Third Prize contains a fixed number of Lucky Medals, and after drawing it, it is returned to the prize pool. The Second Prize contains certain upgrade items, and after drawing it, it is returned to the prize pool. First Prizes consist of 3 types of rare rewards.

4.Rule: Each time a player draws a First Prize, they will receive 1 type of the First Prizes for the current event at random. Rare rewards are limited in quantity and will not be returned to the prize pool after being drawn. Once a player has drawn all 3 types of First Prize, subsequent First Prize draws will be converted into a large number of Lucky Medals.

5.Rule: Lucky Medals can be exchanged for the current event's First Prize at the Lucky Store, and First Prizes obtained from the Lucky Store can still be obtained from draws.

6.Rule: When drawing, there is a chance to trigger a discount that will reduce the number of Goldsheaf Tickets required for the next 10x draw.

7.Rule: When drawing, there is also a small chance to trigger a doubling effect that will double the rewards of the next draw. If the next draw is a 10x, then the doubling will only take effect for the first of the 10 draws.

8.Rule: If the player draws a First Prize with the doubling effect, the duplicate will be converted into a large number of Lucky Medals.

9.Rule: When the event ends, unused Goldsheaf Tickets and Lucky Medals will be converted into Gold.

1.Title: Lucky Store
1.Rule: During the event, players can exchange Lucky Medals for various rewards. The exchange will last for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can obtain lots of Lucky Medals from the Lucky Wheel prize-drawing event.

1.Title: Scarlet Soiree
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 2-1 can complete event quests to earn event items.

2.Rule: During the event, you can gift event items to heroes to increase their Affinity and earn rewards including Limited Edition Frames, Bubbles, and Emojis, as well as unlocking illustrations and interactions with them.

3.Rule: Each event item gifted will increase their Affinity by 1 point.

4.Rule: When gifting, there is a small chance to crit, doubling the Affinity gained.

5.Rule: When the event ends, any unused event items will be converted into Gold.

1.Title: Great Pursuit
1.Rule: During the event, players earn personal points by spending various items or participating in daily activities. Once you earn certain numbers of points, you can claim rewards from 6 tiers of personal chests.

2.Title: Great Pursuit
2.Rule: After joining a guild, you can also earn points together with guildmates. Once your combined points reach certain thresholds, you can claim rewards from guild chests.

3.Title: Great Pursuit
3.Rule: Personal points and personal chests reset daily during the event, but you can complete different quests to earn points and reopen personal chests. Guild chests also reset daily.

4.Title: Great Pursuit
4.Rule: Point rankings for the entire server will be calculated daily to distribute rewards. When the event ends, the final personal and guild point rankings will be tallied.

5.Title: Great Pursuit
5.Rule: Once the Final Results are calculated, all members of the top 8 guilds will receive special Expedition Perks: The Guild Master will become the Expedition League Leader and take command, while all guild members who enroll for the Expedition will form a single League and continue to fight alongside one another.

6.Title: Great Pursuit
6.Rule: Chests that remain unclaimed when the event ends will be sent via mail.

1.Title: Enrollment & Matching
1.Rule: The Expedition game mode opens 1 day after a new server launches, and enrollment begins once Stage 9-40 is cleared. During the 4-day enrollment period, you can choose to enroll as a Guild. You can also obtain more rewards from Expeditions via the Oath Pact system.

2.Rule: After choosing Guild Enrollment, you'll be assigned to the same map as other Guild members who also chose Guild Enrollment, and whenever possible, you'll also be allocated into the same League.

3.Rule: During the enrollment period, players can spend diamonds to sign a pact within the Oath Pact system. Then, after meeting certain conditions, these players will obtain lots of diamonds as rewards when the Expedition ends.

4.Rule: Matchmaking begins when the enrollment period ends, and once matchmaking is complete, players will enter their map. Maps and features will be unlocked gradually during the gameplay phase, followed by a few days for calculations.

5.Rule: After final phase ends, the calculation phase begins, during which players may enroll for the next season on the map. Enrollment closes when the calculation phase ends, and matchmaking for the new season will begin immediately.

6.Rule: The new season will begin once matchmaking is complete. In the new season, all progress from the previous season will be cleared, and new mechanics or modes may become available. For details, please refer to announcements and in-game previews.

1.Title: Hunter's Pass
1.Rule: During the event, players can obtain Hunter's Points by completing daily, weekly, and challenge quests.

2.Rule: Daily quests refresh at UTC 0:00 every day, and weekly quests at 0:00 every Sunday. Challenge quests can only be completed once for each event.

3.Rule: Obtain more Hunter's Points to unlock more rewards.

4.Rule: Players can purchase Premium Pass to unlock more rewards during the event period.

5.Rule: Players who have unlocked Premium Pass can immediately claim Lvl 10 rewards.

1.Title: Hunter Training
1.Rule: During the event, complete hero improvement quests to claim fantastic rewards.

2.Rule: If you use a hero designated as an improvement target as upgrade material, the improvement quest progress will be reset, so please proceed with caution.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Rule: The tour will be split into four different competitive performances. Earn prizes by defeating the stage masters! Getting all these brilliant magicians together would have been impossible were it not for Mr Wake's many connections!

2.Rule: Each of the 4 rounds will last for 3 days. Each round has its own respective leaderboard, wherein the top 10%, 30% and 50% of players can all claim different personal rewards. The top 150 players will receive an additional Fortune Chest!

3.Rule: The top 10%, 30% and 50% on each round's leaderboard will be able to claim Common Hero Scroll x10, Common Hero Scroll x5 and Common Hero Scroll x3, respectively. Rewards will be calculated at the end of each round and sent out via mail.

4.Rule: Players have 3 free challenges per day, of which completing the first 2 will reward players Magic Tickets. After the free challenges have been expended, players can purchase additional challenges with Diamonds. A challenge will be deducted immediately upon starting combat and will not be refunded if the challenge is ended prematurely.

5.Rule: Martial Rating will be used to participate in the event, so heroes below Lvl 360 will be increased to Lvl 360. Heroes above Lvl 360 will be reduced to Lvl 360, and for every 10 levels in excess of 360, an extra level will be added to the adjusted level, up to Lvl 400.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Bosses will count towards your final ranking. Your final ranking will be determined after each boss disappears.

7.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Rule: By completing daily quests or participating in the Circus Tour event, players can obtain Magic Tickets.

2.Rule: Players can use Magic Tickets to obtain random rewards.

3.Rule: Players will be awarded Circus Medals according to the number of draws made. Circus Medals can be exchanged at the Gift Cart for fabulous prizes.

4.Rule: Magic Tickets will be recalled for 5000 Gold per ticket once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Rule: Players may exchange Circus Medals for rewards up until the event ends (14 days).

2.Rule: Players can obtain a large number of Circus Medals in the Magician's Hall.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

4.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

5.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

9.Rule: Circus Medals will be recalled for 150k Gold per medal once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Otherworld Fishing
1.Rule: During the event, you can spend bait to start fishing. Bait can be earned by petting the Void Cocoon each day or purchased with diamonds.

2.Rule: How to fish: When fishing starts, tap the button to stop the moving needle. If it lands in the yellow zone, you complete a round. Finish all required rounds before time runs out to succeed. If you miss the yellow zone, the timer is slightly reduced. If time runs out before all rounds are completed, the attempt fails. Failed attempts don't consume bait, and a new session starts automatically.

3.Rule: Catch Points: You can catch all kinds of things while fishing. Catch fish or common items to earn Catch Points. Earn enough Catch Points to unlock rewards and a limited-edition frame.

4.Rule: Quality: Fish and common items come in different qualities. Higher quality catches grant more Catch Points.

5.Rule: Size: The same fish can appear in different sizes. Bigger fish grant more Catch Points.

6.Rule: Nurture Items: After gaining Lamb Blessing, you have a chance to get nurture items while fishing. These items can be used to increase the Void Cocoon's nurture progress. Lamb Blessing expires after you gain a nurture item. You must wait until the next day's Lamb Blessing before you can get more nurture items.

7.Rule: Interaction Items: You also have a chance to get interaction items when fishing. Interaction items can be used to interact and bond with the Void Cocoon.

8.Rule: Distant Sea Tales: While fishing, you have a chance to trigger Distant Sea Tales and receive diamonds.

9.Rule: If you catch a nurture item or interaction item, or trigger Distant Sea Tales, the bait used will be refunded.

10.Rule: Fishing Spot: Fishing spots are available in 3 levels. Each level has a different luck multiplier and its own pool of fish and common items. Before fishing, you can choose a luck multiplier, which determines how much bait is spent. The more bait you spend, the more Catch Points you earn.

11.Rule: Golden Rod: Purchase Angler's Selection to unlock the Golden Rod. Once unlocked, every fishing session grants bonus Catch Points.

12.Rule: Weather: Weather unlocks after you accept the cocoon nurture quest of Day 4. The default weather is Sunny. While the weather is Sunny, you can spend a certain amount of bait to trigger a weather change and activate special weather. Special weather grants bonus effects for fishing and lasts for a set number of fishing sessions. When special weather expires, the weather returns to Sunny.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard: Players are ranked by the total Catch Points they earn in Otherworld Fishing.

2.Rule: Players will receive Rank Plates based on their rankings after the event.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes depending on the players' Catch Points. Therefore, rankings will only be finalized when the final results are calculated.

1.Title: Wool Warden
1.Rule: During the event, you can pet the Void Cocoon once per day to get bait. For the first 7 days, petting it also grants Lamb Blessing.

2.Rule: After gaining Lamb Blessing, you have a chance to get nurture items while fishing. These items can be used to increase the Void Cocoon's nurture progress.

3.Rule: Once you gain a nurture item, that day's nurture event unlocks. Complete the event to increase the Void Cocoon's nurture progress.

4.Rule: After nurturing the Void Cocoon into a spirit lamb, you will receive a Fabled Beast Chest. When the Fabled Beast becomes available in the future, you can open this chest to acquire the Fabled Beast - Twinlum Spirit.

5.Rule: Your choices in nurture events do not affect progress or rewards. They only change the content of the Nurturing Diary.

6.Rule: During the event, you can get interaction items when fishing. Interaction items can be used to interact and bond with the Void Cocoon.

1.Title: Wings Unfurled
1.Rule: Wings Unfurled will be activated during the Shepherd of Stars event, and lasts for 14 days.

2.Rule: Players can obtain Growth Points by completing quests in Shepherd of Stars. The more Growth Points you collect, the more rewards you will unlock.

3.Rule: If you have purchased and unlocked Wings Unfurled but have not claimed all your rewards within the 4 days before Wings Unfurled ends, you can purchase Growth Points with diamonds.

4.Rule: Purchasing and activating Wings Unfurled grants 980 VIP Experience.

5.Rule: Any rewards that were unlocked but remain unclaimed will be sent to your mailbox when Wings Unfurled ends.

1.Title: Powerful Enemies
1.Rule: When fighting Powerful Enemies, you can equip different Heirlooms to increase your team's strength. Heirlooms can be obtained by nourishing Void Cocoons.

2.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

3.Rule: Mercenaries cannot be used in battles against Powerful Enemies.

4.Rule: During the event, you will receive rewards for achieving specific damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

5.Rule: You can use 1 team of heroes when fighting an area's Powerful Enemies, and you can use 2 teams when fighting the final Powerful Enemy "Zaphrael - The Righteous". The sum of the damage dealt by the 2 teams will be the final damage.

6.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

7.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

8.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

9.Rule: Players can receive Fortune Chests based on their highest guild mate's leaderboard ranking. Fortune Chests shall be sent out when the leaderboard is calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each Powerful Enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.

1.Title: Sunlit Ascent
1.Rule: During the event, players that have cleared Stage 2-4 may participate and purchase limited-time bundles.

1.Title: Scarlet Soiree
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 2-1 can complete event quests to earn event items.

2.Rule: During the event, you can gift event items to heroes to increase their Affinity and earn rewards including Limited Edition Frames, Bubbles, and Emojis, as well as unlocking illustrations and interactions with them.

3.Rule: Each event item gifted will increase their Affinity by 1 point.

4.Rule: When gifting, there is a small chance to crit, doubling the Affinity gained.

1.Title: Hunter's Reward
1.Rule: During the event, players perform bounty hunts to earn Bounty Score.

2.Rule: When a player earns Bounty Score, it will be added to Guild Tributes. The more bounties the guild earns as a whole, the more rewards will be unlocked.

3.Rule: Event stages will be unlocked over time. As stages are completed, special stages and Powerful Enemies will be unlocked.

4.Rule: The rewards for special stages are more generous than for regular stages.

5.Rule: Once a Powerful Enemy is unlocked, you can challenge it anytime, and there is no limit on the number of attempts or total time you can spend. You'll receive rewards based on your total damage dealt.

6.Rule: Once your damage against a Powerful Enemy reaches a certain amount, items will no longer be included in the rewards. Instead, you'll receive bounties that count toward Guild Tributes. Choose your challenges carefully based on your strength!

7.Rule: Complete stages without losing any Light Medals to earn Superb Starsigns. Once you collect enough Superb Starsigns, you can claim rewards in Prime Hunter.

8.Rule: Collect all Superb Starsigns to earn the limited-time Rank Plate: Lone Wolf Hero, which expires 30 days after the event ends.

9.Rule: Guild bounty progress is shared among all guild members.

10.Rule: Any rewards that remain unclaimed when the event ends will be sent via mail.

11.Rule: Leaving a guild will not reduce your guild bounty.

12.Rule: Each time a player earns a bounty, the same bounty value is added to the guild's total.

1.Title: Bounty Pass
1.Rule: The Bounty Pass will be available during the Hunter's Reward event, which lasts 13 days.

2.Rule: Players can earn Bounty Medals by completing Bounty Pass quests. The more Bounty Medals you earn, the more rewards you'll unlock.

3.Rule: Players who purchased Bounty Pass but have not claimed all rewards before the event ends can spend diamonds to obtain Bounty Medals.

4.Rule: Purchase and unlock the Bounty Pass to earn 300 VIP Experience.

5.Rule: When the Bounty Pass ends, all rewards that are claimable but unclaimed will be sent via mail.

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: The Hunter's Reward leaderboard ranks guild members by the amount of bounty they have earned. It is for reference only, and does not affect reward earnings.

1.Title: Guild Hunting
1.Rule: The event lasts 7 days, advancing through the Matchmaking Phase, Preparation Phase, Hunting Phase, and Settlement Phase in that order.

2.Rule: During the Matchmaking Phase, 4 guilds with similar activity levels will be grouped together.

3.Rule: Inactive guilds will miss out on this matchmaking and will have to wait for the next round of the event.

4.Rule: During the Preparation Phase, players can donate items to upgrade their chariot, gaining more attack attempts and combat buffs for the Battle Phase.

5.Rule: During the Hunting Phase, players can challenge bosses to earn Individual Rewards, while each attack by a guild member also counts toward the guild's total damage.

6.Rule: The chest level increases based on total damage dealt to the boss by all guild members.

7.Rule: During the Calculation Phase, players can view activity data for the current event round, and may still donate items.

1.Title: Rules
1.Rule: Guild Total Damage Rankings are calculated among guilds in the same group.

2.Rule: Guild rank rewards will be sent via mail after the season ends.

1.Title: Tides of Renewal
1.Rule: During the event, spend Marine Cores to restore damaged sea areas and earn rewards.

2.Rule: Earn up to 2 Marine Cores per day by completing Daily Quests.

3.Rule: Tap a highlighted sea area while you have a Marine Core to restore it.

4.Rule: Each stage contains 2 steps. Complete both to claim stage rewards. Finish all stages to get the exclusive sticker!

5.Rule: When the event ends, any unused Marine Cores will automatically be recycled.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Rule: Celestial Keys can be acquired by completing daily quests while the event is underway.

2.Rule: Players must select three treasure items per floor before they can begin their search. Players can modify their treasure items at any time, so long as they have not already discovered the treasure.

3.Rule: While searching for treasure, players can acquire treasure or Antiquity Stones. When Antiquity Stones are found, the player has a probability of triggering a Crit, which can grant them 2, 3, or 5 Antiquity Stones respectively.

4.Rule: During the event, Antiquity Stones can be exchanged at the Store in return for rewards. Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

5.Rule: Once one of the floor's treasures has been discovered, players can choose to advance to the next floor or may also continue to stay searching on the current floor. However, if players choose to advance, the remaining slots on the current floor will disappear.

6.Rule: Remaining Celestial Keys will be recalled for 42k gold per key once the event has concluded.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Rule: Players can exchange Antiquity Stones for various rewards during the 14-day event.

2.Rule: You can exchange event items for Destiny Summon Scrolls after unlocking Destiny Summon.

3.Rule: You can exchange event items for Stargazer Scrolls after unlocking Stargazer.

4.Rule: You must possess at least 1 Mythic hero in order to be able to redeem items for activating or enhancing Signature Items.

5.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for Mythic Variety Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

6.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T1 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

7.Rule: Event items can be exchanged for T2 Stone Choice Chests after completing Stage 23-60.

8.Rule: Surplus Antiquity Stones will be recalled for 24k Gold each once the event has ended.

1.Title: Endgame Eclipse
1.Rule: Purchasing the bundle below will also grant you the special event item "Blackgleam Core". Collect a certain number of Blackgleam Cores to obtain rewards such as resources or avatar frames.

1.Title: Reserve Attributes
1.Rule: Heroes with Reserve effects provide attribute bonuses to all heroes—even if the Reserve hero is not deployed!

2.Rule: Reserves that boost the same attribute will not stack.

3.Rule: For duplicate Reserve heroes, only the attribute boost belonging to the highest-tier hero will take effect.

1.Title: Great Pursuit
1.Rule: Players participate as a guild. Only guilds created before matchmaking begins may participate, and only guild members who have logged in within the last 7 days may participate.

2.Title: Great Pursuit
2.Rule: During the event, players earn personal points by spending various items or participating in daily activities. Once you earn certain numbers of points, you can claim rewards from 6 tiers of personal chests.

3.Title: Great Pursuit
3.Rule: After joining a guild, you can also earn points together with guildmates. Once your combined points reach certain thresholds, you can claim rewards from guild chests.

4.Title: Great Pursuit
4.Rule: Personal points and personal chests reset daily during the event, but you can complete different quests to earn points and reopen personal chests. Guild chests also reset daily.

5.Title: Great Pursuit
5.Rule: Point rankings for the entire server will be calculated daily to distribute rewards. When the event ends, the final personal and guild point rankings will be tallied.

6.Title: Great Pursuit
6.Rule: If you leave your guild during the event, you will not be eligible for any rewards besides personal chests for 48 hours, so consider carefully before leaving your guild.

7.Title: Great Pursuit
7.Rule: Chests that remain unclaimed when the event ends will be sent via mail.

1.Title: Unfulfilled Promise
1.Rule: During the event, players who have cleared Stage 2-1 can complete event quests to earn event items.

2.Rule: During the event, you can gift event items to heroes to increase Sacred Pact progress and earn rewards including Limited Avatar Frames, Bubbles, and Emojis, as well as unlocking interactions with them.

3.Rule: Each event item gifted will increase their Sacred Pact by 1 point.

4.Rule: When gifting, there is a small chance to crit, doubling the Sacred Pact gained.

5.Rule: Gift event items to heroes to ascend the corresponding heroes and change their form.

6.Rule: When the event ends, any unused event items will automatically be recycled.

1.Title: Phantom Tide
1.Rule: Players can challenge Powerful Enemies five times daily for free. After that, they would have to spend diamonds to refresh their challenges. Entering a battle uses up one challenge.

2.Rule: In Phantom Tide, you'll receive rewards for reaching certain damage values during Powerful Enemy challenges.

3.Rule: Only the highest recorded damage dealt against Powerful Enemies will count towards your ranking in real-time. Your final ranking will be determined after calculation.

4.Rule: Each Powerful Enemy has its own separate damage calculation time. If a Powerful Enemy's calculation time has finished, any damage dealt to them will not be counted on the leaderboard.

5.Rule: During the event, all Powerful Enemies that have been unlocked can be challenged normally. Individual rewards are unaffected by calculation times.

6.Rule: Adventurers will receive Fortune Chests based on the ranking of their highest-ranked guild member on the leaderboard. Fortune Chests will be sent when leaderboards are calculated. Results for each Powerful Enemy are only calculated once.

1.Title: Whimsical Pass
1.Rule: The Whimsical Pass will be available during the Fantastical Summer event, which lasts 21 days.

2.Rule: Players can earn Summer EXP by completing Whimsical Pass quests. The more Summer EXP you earn, the more rewards you'll unlock.

3.Rule: Players who purchased Whimsical Pass but have not claimed all rewards before the event ends can spend diamonds to obtain Summer EXP.

4.Rule: When the Whimsical Pass ends, all rewards that are claimable but unclaimed will be sent via mail.

1.Title: Whimsical Farmstead
1.Rule: During the event, heroes will collect supplies, which you can claim daily. Any supplies you miss due to not logging in will be issued all together the next time you log in.

2.Rule: You can plant Magic Seeds to grow Young Magic Flora, which will mature into Whimsical Flora after a certain duration. The higher the level of your Farm, the more land is unlocked, the higher the yields per harvest, and the longer the wait time.

3.Rule: If no type has been selected for a plot of land, a random Magic Flora will grow there. Once you select a type, the corresponding Magic Flora will grow there.

4.Rule: You can use Enchanted Dew to instantly grow Young Magic Flora into Whimsical Flora.

5.Rule: Magic Flora will produce Summer Products of various rarities. The higher the rarity, the lower the drop chance.

6.Rule: Once you obtain a Product, its portrait will be unlocked, and each unlocked portrait grants rewards. After you've collected all portraits of the same type, you'll get an additional reward.

7.Rule: Heroes will make random visits and grant buffs to your fields. These buffs are limited in both duration and number.

8.Rule: When you obtain a Summer Product, it can be exchanged for different numbers of Ocean Turbines based on its rarity. Ocean Turbines are used in the Windchaser event.

9.Rule: Windchaser requires Ocean Turbines. Each time you dash, you will move a random distance and encounter random obstacles. After dashing a certain number of times, you'll receive all rewards.

10.Rule: After collecting all rewards, you can keep dashing, but you'll only move a fixed distance and obtain fixed rewards.

11.Rule: After planting a Magic Seed, a Pest Control or Fertile Soil event may occur at random. Complete them to guarantee the highest-rarity Product of that Magic Flora type, helping you to obtain all portraits!

1.Title: Rankings
1.Rule: Phantom Tide leaderboard rankings are based on the highest amount of damage dealt to each powerful enemy.

2.Rule: It is possible to view the replay of the battle in which other players achieved their highest damage record.

3.Rule: Rankings within the leaderboards are subject to constant changes, thus, leaderboard rewards will only be finalized at the end of the leaderboard session.
